title: AVP - Product
description:
**Role: AVP - Product**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Experience: 8+ years**

**About the Role: The Trader Segment Mandate**

As a
**Senior Product Manager**
at InCred Money, you will be a critical leader responsible for owning the strategy, development, and growth of our product offerings specifically targeting the
**active trader segment**
, with a deep focus on
**Futures & Options (F&O)**
and other trading instruments.

This role requires a blend of strategic market understanding, product execution expertise, and a genuine passion for the nuances of financial trading. Your primary mandate will be to define and deliver a
**world-class, high-performance, and compliant trading platform**
that meets the sophisticated needs of professional and active retail traders, driving trading volume and market share for InCred Money.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Strategy & Vision:**
  Define the long-term vision, strategy, and roadmap for the trader-focused product suite, with a primary emphasis on
  **Futures & Options (F&O)**
  , margin trading, and advanced order types.
* **Domain Expertise & Execution:**
  Deeply understand the specific workflows, pain points, and feature needs of the active trader (e.g., charting tools, low-latency execution, real-time data feeds, risk management features). Translate these needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:**
  Serve as the product owner, working closely with
  **Engineering, Design, Risk, Compliance, and Business Development**
  teams to manage the product development lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch iteration.
* **Business & Financial Acumen:**
  Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the trader segment (e.g., trading volume, order conversion rate, active trader count, revenue per user). Ensure the product strategy aligns with InCred Money's overall business goals.
* **Competitive Analysis & Market Insights:**
  Continuously monitor the competitive landscape, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies in the trading and brokerage space to identify opportunities for differentiation and market leadership.
* **User Research & Feedback:**
  Establish strong feedback loops with active traders through interviews, surveys, and usage data analysis to ensure the product consistently delivers exceptional value and a high-trust experience.
* **Operational Excellence:**
  Oversee the efficient rollout of new features and products, ensuring clarity in documentation, training for internal teams, and seamless integration with existing systems.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **Total Experience:**
  8+ years of professional experience in Product Management, with at least
  **4+ years specifically managing products within the Fintech, Wealth Management, or Capital Markets domain.**
* **Domain Specialization (highly desired):**
  **Demonstrated, in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience with the active trader segment**
  and financial instruments, particularly
  **Futures & Options (F&O), Listed Equities, and advanced trading platforms.**
* **Product Management Expertise:**
  Proven success in defining, developing, and launching complex digital products in an agile environment.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams, understanding technical trade-offs, scalability issues, and API integrations for high-volume, low-latency applications.
* **Communication & Leadership:**
  Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
* **Educational Background:**
  Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Finance, Business, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

title: Product Manager – Flexem

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
**Who are we looking for?**

We are hiring a technical owner for our in-house AI products. This is a mid-layer engineering role. You will own the products we have already built, upgrade them, take them through to deployment, and stay close enough to users that the product actually gets adopted.

You are a technical resource first. You write, review, and ship. You understand the stack, the models, the infra, and the business problem well enough to make the right build decisions yourself.

**What you will own**

* In-house AI products: architecture, upgrades, quality, and release until deployment
* Technical execution for AI development happening inside the company
* Software and hardware infrastructure the products run on (hosting, servers, environments, usage, cost, reliability)
* Product adoption from a technical side: rollout, stability, usability, and feedback into the next build

**What will be your key responsibilities?**

**Build, upgrade, deploy**

* Own development and upgrades from design through testing to production
* Work in the codebase: architecture, AI tooling, integrations, and release quality
* Definition of done is deployment. Code that is written but not live is not done
* Keep the product stable: fewer regressions, less leftover WIP, faster path from change to live

**Technical ownership**

* Own the in-house AI product(s) as a builder: what we ship, how it is built, and whether it holds up in production
* Turn business problems into technical solutions, not a list of tickets for someone else
* Make build vs buy vs ignore calls on AI tools, models, and frameworks

**Infrastructure**

* Stay hands-on with hosting, servers, environments, usage, and cost
* Size infra to the product. Reliability and spend are part of the job, not a side conversation
* Keep product decisions and server reality aligned

**AI and technology**

* Stay current on AI tools, models, frameworks, and how the market is moving
* Recommend what we should adopt, what we should skip, and what we should build ourselves
* Keep the stack current without chasing every new tool

**Adoption and business lens**

* Treat adoption as a core outcome. A product that is live but unused has failed
* Support internal rollout with a product that is stable, fast, and easy to use in real workflows
* Measure usage and drop-off, then feed that back into what you build next
* Entrepreneurial mindset: ownership, speed, trade-offs, and whether this makes the business better

**What are the key requirements for the role?**

* 4-6yrs of strong technical base: architecture, APIs, data flow, models, and deployment. You can build, not only describe
* Hands-on with AI products and the current AI toolchain (LLMs, embeddings, agents, evaluation, orchestration)
* Working knowledge of software and hardware/infra: hosting, servers, environments, basic networking and usage
* Experience taking a product from build to live yourself, ideally an internal tool or AI product in a services / professional-firm environment
* Cloud hosting, cost optimisation, and production monitoring experience
* Product sense with a business lens: adoption, value, and cost, not only shipping features
* Entrepreneurial mindset: ownership, bias to action, comfort with incomplete information
* Clear communicator with engineers and with the business
* Comfort helping people move from old workflows onto a new product
* Mid-level: you can run this without being managed day to day

title: Product Manager, IoT India

title: Associate Product Manager - AI
description:
SOVOS
  
  
Associate Product Manager (AI-First)
  
  
Product Management·Full-Time·India
  
  
Build Your Future With Us
  
  
The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
  
  
We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
  
  
AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
  
  
Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
  
  
The Role
  
  
At Sovos, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager who will support product strategy and execution for a product area whilst taking on Product Owner responsibilities day to day. AI fluency is a core part of this role. You'll own the backlog, write sprint-ready stories, and leverage AI tools daily to research, analyse, draft, and prototype faster and more effectively. This is a global posting for India.
  
  
**More Specifically, You Will**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog; keep it groomed two sprints ahead and write Jira stories with clear user story, context, acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then), and explicit out-of-scope details.
* Run sprint planning, refinement, and demos with engineering, QA, and design; accept or reject delivered work against acceptance criteria and coordinate UAT and release readiness.
* Support the Senior Product Manager on roadmaps, PRDs, and business cases; analyse usage data, support tickets, and customer feedback to identify problems worth solving.
* Work with customer success and sales to turn customer requests into validated requirements; track delivery, risks, and dependencies and report status clearly and honestly.
* Use AI tools (Claude or similar) daily for research, synthesis, drafting PRDs and stories, and analysing data; build repeatable AI workflows such as story-drafting templates or connected tools to save team time.
* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes or small internal tools using AI-assisted design or coding tools; demonstrate AI product sense by understanding LLM limits and specifying AI features with evaluation criteria and fallback behaviour.

What You Bring to Sovos
  
  

* You've built solid experience (typically 2–3 years) in product, business analysis, or product ownership, with prior hands-on experience as both a Product Owner and in a product management role.

digital analytics, email marketing, and platforming and automation.

innovate and improve our digital offerings.

title: Senior , Tax Services -Global Trade Service + ABAP - Hyderabad, Gurugram ,Chennai, Kolkata, Bangalore
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Do you have a passion to support Deloitte Tax in helping global clients transform their Global Trade solution? Are you a team player with a practical, business-oriented mindset? Do you enjoy working in an ever-changing global environment with fast-moving markets and evolving business models? If the answer to all the above is “Yes,” come join us in the International Tax group.
  
  
We are a recognized leader in solving some of the complex business problems for our clients, differentiated by our ability to execute on the insights we provide. Our multi-disciplinary competencies allow us to address CXO issues from several angles.
  
  
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through USI Tax practice. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a sought-after career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace by offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to their clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
Work You'll Do - Intro: Our team specializes in effective technology-enabled methodologies and providing leading practices for global trade programs that address both international and local requirements, as well as embed international trade controls into day-to-day business operations.
  
  
Work You'll Do -:
  
  

* Collaborate with clients and stakeholders to gather and document detailed business requirements for GTS projects.
* In your role, you will lead and/or facilitate business process definition and modeling.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications for development and configuration.
* Coordinate with project teams, clients, and stakeholders to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation within SAP GTS solutions.
* You will guide a team to implement and configure the software to replicate the required business processes and analytical/reporting needs.
* Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for end-users and client teams.
* Ensure that SAP GTS solutions comply with relevant regulations, standards, and organizational policies.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including development, infrastructure, and business teams, to ensure seamless service delivery and support.
* You will contribute to the development and growth of the SAP GTS practice globally.

The Team:
  
  
The GTA practice is composed of operations specialists, Global Trade Management technology specialists, customs brokers, auditors, and trade management professionals who help importers and exporters achieve worldwide compliance and realize efficiencies and advantages in their global supply chain. You will be based in India and support Deloitte Tax to serve clients with international operations and supports their global trade compliance requirements.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai, Hyderabad, Gurugram, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM
  
  
**Qualifications - Required:**

* Bachelor / Master degree in relation to Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business or similar
* Minimum 5 years of experience in SAP GTS project implementation, and thus have significant knowledge of the SAP GTS Solution, in one of the following domains: Compliance Management, Customs Management, Trade Preference
* Good understanding of supply chain management processes
* Ability to travel up to 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Experience in other SAP modules than SAP GTS is an asset
* Technical knowledge (e.g. ABAP, SAP PI) is an asset
* Good analytical and modeling skills
* Team player with strong communication skills
* Strong written and verbal communication in English
* Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that requires professionals to co-locate in person 2-3 days per week

Qualifications - Preferred:
  
  

* Education with SAP focus (S/4 or ECC Sales and Distribution, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Material Master, Transportation Management)
* Software aptitude in PowerPoint, MS Project, Access, Excel, and/or Visio
* Experience presenting to clients or other decision makers
* Knowledge of export regulations including ITAR/EAR
* Demonstrated interest in international trade or international business
* Strong research, writing, verbal communication, and project management skills
* Ability to bring out-of-the-box solution design aligned to leading practices and differentiated business outcome
* Understanding of end-to-end processes and attention to detailed design
* Strong team and organizational skills, ability to self-manage time and tasks
* Ability to manage client and cross functional team expectations

#TAXGTS
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**
You are responsible for ensuring that projects are successfully completed on time and on budget. This includes project governance, budget and timeline development, build quality, testing and operational readiness, and the completed project’s readiness to go live.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will:
  
  

* Drive consistency and quality in the execution of projects using the appropriate methodology and tools
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks and escalate them to global leads and/ or the program manager when needed
* Provide project reporting and status updates using scorecards, status reports and monthly review meetings and leading stakeholder meetings
* Lead budget management, resource planning and utilization
* Confirm the completion and consistency of projects and their readiness to go live
* Own the relationship with the external vendors including quality assurance in all phases of project delivery

**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
  
  

* Proven experience in project management methodology
* Excellent communication skills and able to drive effective discussions with project resources from tactical execution level up to steering committee members
* Excellent project planning and proactiveness in identifying risks and mitigations and managing strict timelines
* Strong focus on cost, schedule and quality of project delivery
* Knowledge of relevant business processes and related technology solutions
* Stakeholder management and ability to influence positively in decision making
* Proven ability in building effective teams across internal and external partners
* Strong conceptual and analytic skills – enjoys problem solving

**About The Role**
The CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) Product Lead owns the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Mondelez International's CLM platform. Operating primarily within the DocuSign CLM ecosystem and connected procurement tools, this role bridges Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and business stakeholders to drive adoption, optimize contract processes, and deliver measurable commercial value.
  
  
**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Define and communicate the CLM product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with enterprise goals and MDLZ procurement transformation objectives.
* Establish product KPIs and success metrics, and report progress to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the Contract Product roadmap and strategy, translating business needs into a prioritized delivery plan.
* Drive CLM deployment across Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and other business functions, ensuring consistent adoption and change management.
* Oversee ongoing platform support, including issue resolution, enhancement requests, and release management.
* Lead contract compliance management by ensuring contractual obligations are tracked and fulfilled, proactively identifying and preventing contract value leakage.
* Manage and develop a team focused on achieving zero contract value leakage across the enterprise through the Statement Review Process.
* Develop a Strategy for deploying Amazon Quick Agents for CLM.
* Stakeholder Management.
* Partner with Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and business units to gather requirements, prioritize features, and manage expectations.
* Facilitate governance forums (Steering committees, Product Councils) to build consensus around roadmap trade-offs.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of the full contract lifecycle: authoring, negotiation, approval workflows, execution, obligation management, and renewal.
* Familiarity with procurement and sourcing processes as they relate to contract creation and management.
* Hands-on experience with CLM platforms and comfort with API/MCP integrations, data migration, and metadata modelling.
* Understanding of eSignature tools and requirements across geographies.
* Ability to engage credibly with IT architects and developers.
* Adjacent Procurement Tools: Experience with Coupa, Hicx, Sievo for spend analytics, and process orchestration platforms such as Pega or ServiceNow.
* AI/ML-Driven Contract Analytics: Exposure to clause extraction, obligation tracking, risk scoring, and GenAI-assisted contract authoring.
* Experience in SAP and integrations is a plus.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Manage the relationship with the CLM vendor - evaluate new modules, AI features, integrations, and licensing.
* Represent MDLZ in vendor roadmap sessions and user community forums to influence product direction.

No Relocation support available

title: Manager, Financial Products & Partnerships, Accion Advisory
description:
**About Accion**
Accion is a global nonprofit on a mission to create a fair and inclusive economy for the 1.6 billion people who are failed by the global financial system. We develop and scale responsible digital financial solutions for small business owners, smallholder farmers, and women, so they can make informed decisions and improve their lives. Through targeted investment strategies, advisory solutions, and expert thought leadership, we work with local partners to develop and scale cheaper, more accessible, and customer-friendly financial solutions. Since 1961, Accion has helped build 299 financial service providers serving low-income clients in 77 countries, reaching over 500 million people. More at https://www.accion.org.
  
  
**About Accion Advisory**
Accion Advisory is a global team helping companies deliver innovative, affordable financial solutions for underserved customers in emerging markets. We work with local ecosystem partners, leveraging philanthropic capital and new technologies, to test, improve, and scale solutions that strengthen economic well‑being.
  
  
Our 60+ advisors deliver 30+ active projects across Africa, Asia, and the Americas, collaborating with financial service providers, fintech companies, digital platforms, and other stakeholders to demonstrate the viability of reaching end customers often considered too risky or costly to serve. Through AI- and data-driven digital transformation and embedded financial products, we drive impact across four key pillars: livelihoods, agriculture, climate, and women's economic empowerment.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Accion Advisory is seeking a Manager, Financial Products & Partnerships to expand access to credit and risk-sharing products for smallholder farmers, agricultural MSMEs, and climate-vulnerable communities across India and beyond. You will build and lead Accion's relationships with financial service providers: MFIs, fintechs, small finance banks, and NBFCs. Taking partnerships from first conversation through executed agreement and into live pilots, and shaping the financial products those partnerships deliver. The role also supports donor and commercial fundraising for Accion's climate and agricultural finance agenda.
  
  
Based in Mumbai on a hybrid basis with two days on site, this is an open-ended position reporting to the Senior Director, Global Agri & Climate Lead, Accion Advisory. You will work closely with regional delivery teams across India, Sub-Saharan Africa, and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**
**Product Design and Development**

* Lead the design and commercial structuring of financial products for smallholder farmers and agricultural MSMEs, including risk frameworks, credit guarantees, de-risking instruments, and blended finance incentives.
* Assess market opportunity, partner viability, and product pricing using existing models and analytical inputs, working with technical specialists where detailed financial modeling is required.
* Conduct market and customer research to identify unmet needs and opportunities for product innovation across agricultural value chains.

**Capacity Building and Knowledge Sharing**

* Build legal and regulatory structuring capacity, in-house or retained, across active markets including India, Sub-Saharan Africa, and Southeast Asia.
* Represent Accion Advisory at conferences and industry forums, contribute to knowledge products and publications, and deliver training and technical assistance to staff and partners on product development and partnership approaches.

**Financial Service Provider (FSP) Partnership and Engagement**

title: Assistant General Manager - Digital Commerce & MarTech Application Management
description:
The Assistant General Manager – Digital Commerce & MarTech Application Management will lead the technology ecosystem supporting Skechers India’s digital commerce, customer engagement and omnichannel operations.
  
  
The role will own the application roadmap, delivery and ongoing management of Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, campaign microsites, and Vinculum Order Management System. It will ensure these platforms operate as a connected, secure, and scalable ecosystem, enabling seamless customer experiences and supporting online revenue growth, conversion, and retention.
  
  
The incumbent will partner with Digital Commerce, Marketing, Retail, Supply Chain, Finance, and global and local IT teams to translate business priorities into technology solutions.
  
  
**Designation:**
Assistant General Manager
  
  
**Role:**
Lead – Digital Commerce & MarTech Application Management
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai – Head Office (Andheri East)
  
  
**Experience:**
12–15 years
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Associate Director - IT
  
  
**Direct reports:**
2 — Business Analyst and Application Support
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Digital Commerce — Salesforce Commerce Cloud
* Own the SFCC B2C storefront roadmap, application enhancements, releases, availability, performance, and security.
* Lead development across SFRA and PWA Kit/headless architectures, covering catalogue, pricing, promotions, search, checkout, and customer accounts.
* Partner with business teams on site speed, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, A/B testing, and personalization.
* Manage cartridges and third-party integrations, including payments, tax, fraud prevention, ratings and reviews, search, and customer support tools.
* Ensure readiness for peak trading periods through load testing, capacity planning, release controls, and coordinated production support.
* Marketing Technology — Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* Lead SFMC architecture and operations across Email Studio, Mobile Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Contact Builder and Data Extensions.
* Enable customer lifecycle journeys, including welcome, cart and browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back, loyalty and transactional communications.
* Integrate SFMC with commerce, CRM, and customer data platforms to support event-driven engagement and consistent customer profiles.
* Oversee deliverability, consent, preference management, and applicable privacy requirements.
* Manage complementary platforms for WhatsApp, conversational commerce, analytics, and tag management.
* Customer Data Platform — Salesforce Data Cloud
* Lead end-to-end Data Cloud implementation, from business case and use-case prioritization through architecture, deployment, and adoption.
* Establish ingestion from commerce, marketing, OMS, POS, loyalty, ERP, marketplace, and web/app data sources.
* Define data models, Data Model Objects, data spaces, calculated insights, and streaming insights.
* Configure identity resolution to unify customer profiles across online and offline channels.
* Enable audience segmentation and activation across marketing, advertising, and commerce platforms.
* Support approved Einstein and Agentforce use cases, including next-best offers, churn insights, and propensity modelling.
* Govern data quality, consent, access, and platform consumption, while tracking license costs and business impact.
* Campaign Microsites & Digital Properties
* Deliver campaign, product-launch and brand microsites using SFCC or suitable headless CMS platforms.
* Establish reusable templates, components, and hosting standards to improve delivery speed and consistency.
* Ensure each launch meets tracking, technical SEO, accessibility, performance, and security requirements.
* Omnichannel Order Management — Vinculum
* Own Vinculum OMS application delivery and support as the backbone for order and inventory orchestration.
* Enable ship-from-store, click-and-collect, endless aisle, store returns, and split-shipment capabilities.
* Manage integrations with marketplaces, warehouses, stores, and logistics partners.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Retail teams to improve inventory accuracy, fulfilment performance, order-to-delivery timelines, and return-to-origin rates.
* Enterprise Integration & Architecture
* Govern integrations across ERP, PIM, OMS, WMS, POS, CRM, loyalty, payments, logistics and analytics platforms.
* Lead API and middleware design using REST/SOAP services, webhooks, event streams and batch interfaces.
* Define data contracts, monitoring, error handling, retries and reconciliation controls.
* Ensure reliable product, pricing, inventory, order, customer, and finance data flows across systems.
* Leadership, Delivery & Application Governance
* Lead the Business Analyst and Application Support team, with responsibility for capability development, resource planning and performance management.
* Manage implementation partners, agencies, and SaaS vendors through clear scopes of work, SLAs and performance reviews.
* Own application budgets, licenses, total cost of ownership and build-versus-buy evaluations.
* Drive Agile delivery, release governance, CI/CD practices and L2/L3 production support.
* Establish effective incident management, root-cause analysis, and preventive action processes.
* Coordinate security assessments, vulnerability remediation, payment security, and applicable data privacy controls.
* Manage global and local technology initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and effective business adoption.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science or Information Technology, MCA, or a relevant postgraduate IT qualification. An MBA is an advantage.
* 12–15 years of IT experience, with substantial responsibility for retail, digital commerce or omnichannel technology programmes.
* Demonstrated delivery experience across SFCC, SFMC, Salesforce Data Cloud and OMS, including at least one end-to-end Salesforce Data Cloud implementation.
* Experience in consumer brands, retail, fashion, lifestyle or D2C businesses is preferred.
* Proven experience leading teams and managing vendors, budgets, and senior business stakeholders.
* Relevant Salesforce Commerce, Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud certifications are preferred.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of digital commerce, customer lifecycle marketing and omnichannel retail processes.
* Knowledge of retail operations, POS, inventory, replenishment, fulfilment, and enterprise system integration.
* Experience with APIs, middleware, data modelling, identity resolution, and application monitoring.
* Familiarity with Vinculum or comparable OMS platforms; exposure to Ginesys POS or Oracle Retail Xstore is an advantage.
* Strong programme management, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to balance application stability, delivery priorities, cost efficiency, and business outcomes.

**Key Success Measures**

* Website availability of at least 99.9% and stable performance during peak sales.
* Improvements in page speed, conversion, and checkout success.
* Reliable inventory synchronization, reduced order failures, and adherence to fulfilment SLAs.
* Reduced integration failures and reconciliation gaps.
* Improved customer engagement, lifecycle journey performance, and retention.
* Effective customer profile unification, audience activation, and measurable business impact from Data Cloud.
* On-time, on-budget roadmap delivery, vendor SLA adherence, and controlled platform costs.

**About Skechers**
Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Business IT Systems Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Business Analyst's role is to elicit, analyze, specify, and validate the business needs of project stakeholders, be they customers or end-users. This includes interviewing stakeholders and gathering and compiling user requirements to create functional design specifications that can be used by development teams throughout the software lifecycle. In addition it is the responsibility of this role to plan, design, develop, and launch efficient business, financial, and operations systems in support of core organizational functions and business processes. This includes gathering and analyzing data in support of business cases, proposed projects, and systems requirements. The Business Analyst is also responsible for generating and compiling reports based on their findings, complete with probable causes and possible solutions to systems issues. This individual will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help maximize the benefit of IT system investments. Moreover the Business Analyst will initiate the creation of test cases and lead business users through the testing of new solutions. Works with the QA and Training team to document system scenarios and identifies roles impacted
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with project managers and project sponsors to determine project scope.
* Clearly identify project stakeholders and establish user classes, as well as their characteristics.
* Conduct interviews and product analysis to gather user requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Meet with decision makers, systems owners, and end users to define business, financial, and operations requirements and systems goals, and identify and resolve systems issues.
* Develop and utilize standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirement specifications.
* Translate conceptual user requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Where necessary, develop prototypes of interfaces and attributes based on findings. Lead design sessions in prototyping new systems for the purpose of enhancing business processes, operations, and information process flow
* Analyze and verify requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Identify and establish scope and parameters of requirements analysis in order to define impact, outcome criteria, and measure-taking actions.
* Work with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Create process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Manage and track the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicate changes, enhancements, and modifications - verbally or through written documentation project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* Review and analyze the effectiveness and efficiency of existing systems and develop strategies for improving or further leveraging these systems.
* Perform cost-benefit and return on investment analyses for proposed systems to aid management in making implementation decisions.
* Coordinate and perform in-depth tests, including end-user reviews, for modified and new systems, and other post-implementation support.
* Ensure compatibility and interoperability of in-house computing systems.
* Assist in conducting research on software and hardware products to justify recommendations and to support purchasing efforts.
* Provide orientation and training to end users for all modified and new systems
* Provide guidance and/or instruction to junior staff members.

**Knowledge Skills And Experience**

* College diploma or university degree in the field of business administration, computer science, finance, or information systems and 5+ years related work experience.
* Proven experience in overseeing the design, development, and implementation of software and hardware solutions, systems, or products
* Ability to create systematic and consistent requirements specifications in both technical and user-friendly language.
* Ability to apply statistical and other research methods into systems issues and products as required.
* Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including MS Project.
* Working technical knowledge of scripting languages, network and PC operating systems.
* Able to exercise independent judgement and take action on it.
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills.
* Excellent understanding of the organization's goals and objectives.
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
* Highly self motivated and directed.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks while under pressure.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Excellent English language skills

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
  
  
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
  
  
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). * Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.
* Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

**You're Our Person If...**

* Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

title: Product Manager - Partnerships
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Role Purpose**
The Product Manager - Partnerships will be responsible for end-to-end management of strategic partnership programs, ensuring seamless onboarding, operational excellence, product implementation, partner engagement, and business activation. The role will act as the central coordination point between external partners, lending businesses, operations, technology, finance, compliance, and sales teams to drive partner productivity and business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Partner Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with partner leadership and operational teams.
* Conduct regular business reviews and governance meetings with partners.
* Resolve partner escalations and ensure high service standards.

**Partner Onboarding & Implementation**

* Manage end-to-end onboarding of new partners.
* Coordinate with Compliance, Legal, Risk, Operations, Finance, Product, and Technology teams for partner onboarding.
* Ensure timely completion of agreements, process approvals, and system integrations.
* Drive implementation timelines and track onboarding milestones.

**Product & Technology Coordination**

* Work closely with all lending product teams including Home Loans, LAP, Business Loans, Personal Loans, Microfinance, Rural Lending, and other business units.
* Coordinate with IT and digital teams for partner integration, workflow creation, API implementation, lead management systems, and process automation.
* Identify process gaps and drive technology-led enhancements.

**VLE/Agent Activation & Business Growth**

* Drive activation and productivity of VLEs (Village Level Entrepreneurs), agents, and partner resources.
* Coordinate with lending sales teams for training, activation, lead generation, and business conversion.
* Monitor productivity metrics and develop action plans to improve performance.
* Design and execute engagement initiatives to increase partner participation and business contribution.

**Payouts & Financial Management**

* Ensure timely and accurate processing of partner payouts, incentives, and commissions.
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations teams to resolve payout-related issues.
* Maintain payout MIS and reconciliation reports.
* Ensure adherence to approved commercial agreements.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Sales, Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Marketing, and Technology teams.
* Drive closure of partner requirements within agreed timelines.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and partner expectations.

**Performance Monitoring & MIS**

* Track business performance against agreed KPIs.
* Prepare and present dashboards, business reviews, activation reports, payout summaries, and productivity analysis.
* Identify growth opportunities and recommend corrective actions.

**Training & Enablement**

* Coordinate training programs for partner teams and sales teams.
* Develop partner onboarding kits, product guides, process manuals, and communication material.
* Ensure continuous capability building of partner resources.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Partner onboarding TAT
* Partner activation rate
* Active VLE/Agent percentage
* Business sourced through partnerships
* Lead conversion ratio
* Partner satisfaction score
* Payout processing accuracy and TAT
* Technology implementation milestones
* Productivity per active partner/VLE
* Revenue and portfolio contribution from partnerships

**Desired Candidate Profile**
**Education**

* MBA/PGDM from a reputed institute preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or related field.

**Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of experience in Partnerships, Product Management, Lending, Business Development, Fintech, Rural Banking, or Channel Management.
* Experience in managing large distribution or partnership networks.
* Exposure to Banking, NBFC, Fintech, CSC ecosystem, or Rural Financial Services preferred.

**Skills Required**

* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Understanding of lending products and distribution channels.
* Project management and execution excellence.
* Analytical and MIS reporting capabilities.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Process improvement and problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to work across multiple departments and drive outcomes without direct authority.

**Preferred Background**
Candidates from Banking, NBFCs, Fintechs, CSC ecosystem, Business Correspondent networks, Rural Distribution organizations, or Digital Partnership roles with experience in managing partner onboarding, activation, and business growth programs will be preferred.

title: Jewellery Product Manager
description:
**Company Description**
AMG DYNAMICS Limited is a technology and innovation company dedicated to transforming industries through cutting-edge solutions. The organization operates as an innovation hub, supporting entrepreneurs and businesses with services in AI, 3D visualization, software development, and market commercialization. By nurturing ideas from concept to market-ready products, AMG DYNAMICS helps partners navigate the digital landscape and solve complex challenges across diverse sectors. The Jewellery Product Manager is a full-time, remote role responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of jewellery products, from concept and design through development, launch, and ongoing optimization. This role involves coordinating with designers, technologists, and commercial teams to define product requirements, ensure product quality, and align offerings with market trends and customer needs. The Jewellery Product Manager will analyze market data and customer feedback, manage product roadmaps, and support pricing, positioning, and go-to-market strategies for jewellery collections. Day-to-day tasks include setting product priorities, managing timelines, reviewing prototypes and digital visualizations, preparing product documentation, and collaborating with marketing and sales to drive product performance. * Experience in product management or category management, ideally within jewellery E-Commerce, fashion, luxury goods, or related consumer products.
* Strong skills in market research, trend analysis, and competitive benchmarking to inform jewellery product strategy and assortment planning.
* Ability to work with designers, engineers, and digital teams to translate concepts and customer insights into clear product requirements and roadmaps.
* Comfort with technology-driven environments, including familiarity with digital tools such as 3D visualization, CAD or design software, and product lifecycle management systems.
* Skills in project management, prioritization, and coordination of cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery.
* Knowledge of pricing, positioning, and basic commercial analytics to support revenue, margin, and portfolio performance targets.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present product plans, rationales, and insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, quality orientation, and an eye for aesthetics, craftsmanship, and design within jewellery or related categories.
* Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple projects, and maintain alignment with team members across time zones.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, product design, engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience in product management or jewellery industry roles is also valued.

title: Product Intern - Stratzy (Raise)
description:
**Role Summary**

Raise is built on this core philosophy, we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user

experience and best-in-class customer service to our users. We started with our first consumer product, Dhan, an investment and trading platform launched in November 2021.

Today,
**Dhan ranks #8 amongst stock brokers in India**
and continues to be one of the fastest-growing platforms in the investment and trading ecosystem.

In September 2026,
**Dhan was also recognised as Fintech Startup of the Year at the Global Fintech Festival,**
reflecting the innovation, product excellence and customer focus that continue to shape the platform. Backed by a passionate team of builders, believers, designers and problem-solvers, we are building a trusted ecosystem of financial products that empowers millions of users to make smarter financial decisions.

**Stratzy**
is an algorithmic investing and trading platform that makes rule-based, system-driven trading accessible to everyday investors. The platform offers 100+ ready-made, approved algorithmic strategies across equities, indices, F&O, and commodities, letting users pick and deploy structured strategies instead of having to build and monitor trades themselves.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and ownership-driven
**Product Intern**
to join the Stratzy Product team. This is an opportunity to work on real product challenges, contribute ideas, collaborate directly with the leadership team and help build features that solve actual user problems. You will gain hands-on experience in product management, user research, data analysis and product development.

This is a
**3 to 6 month internship**
, with a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high performers, based on performance and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of product features, improvements and experiments, from ideation to launch.
* Understand user needs and pain points, identify opportunities and suggest solutions to improve the product experience.
* Work closely with the leadership team to understand business priorities, share ideas and contribute to product decisions.
* Translate ideas and business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys and actionable tasks.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing and customer support teams to bring product ideas to life.
* Analyse user behaviour, product data and customer feedback to identify opportunities and measure the impact of product improvements.
* Research competitors, market trends and emerging developments in fintech, investing and algorithmic trading.
* Interact with users, understand their experiences and bring actionable insights to the product roadmap.
* Track feature performance after launch and recommend improvements based on user feedback and data.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in any discipline. Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or related backgrounds are welcome, but not mandatory.
* Strong curiosity about digital products, technology, user behaviour and how businesses solve customer problems.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think logically and break down complex problems into simpler solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to share ideas and collaborate with different teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and ability to take ownership in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable with numbers, analysing information and using data to support decisions.
* An interest in finance, stock markets, investing, trading or fintech is an advantage; prior knowledge of algorithmic trading is not mandatory.
* Prior internships, college projects, personal projects, product case studies or startup experience are welcome, but not essential.

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to

work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

**If you are curious, enjoy solving problems and want hands-on experience building real products, we would love to hear from you!**

**Our People & Culture:**

People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.

We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and

demonstrate following personality traits:

•
**Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.**

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)

•
**We have a single opportunity to serve.**

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,

uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)

•
**Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.**

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)

•
**Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.**

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)

•
**Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.**

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our

customers, not to prove a point.)

•
**Quality over quantity.**

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)

•
**Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.**

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)

•
**Talent and Competency over Credentials.**

•
**Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.**

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)

•
**Less words, more action.**

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)

•
**Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.**

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)

•
**Passionate about the business you are a part of.**

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)

**Why Join Raise?**

We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We

celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.

**About Raise Financial Services**

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers. Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform.

Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Stratzy, Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms.

Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make

investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible. Our philosophy is simple:

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai

Explore More:

* Connect with us: www.raiseholding.co
* Learn more about our Algo Trading platform - https://stratzy.in/
* Learn more about our Investing & Trading Platform – www.dhan.co

Follow our Instagram page
**#LifeatRaise**
for a glimpse into our people and latest culture

happenings.

**Apply for the Role:**

If you are excited about building and scaling one of India's most ambitious consumer fintech

ecosystems, we would love to hear from you. Send your resume to:
**careers@dhan.co**

Raise is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an

inclusive workplace.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

That is why Third Bridge is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Our best-in-class offering includes accounting and investors services, portfolio analytics, middle-office functions, regulatory and financial reporting, and tax services. The role will work closely with Channels, Operations, Technology and Program Management office during the roll-out phase.
  
  
Key Result Areas
  
• Drive Overall Financial Performance – drive the overall financial performance of cash management products by launching new products and driving initiatives for existing products to grow volumes and liabilities whilst establishing strategies to optimize fee pricing, Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and Net Interest Margins (NIMs). Work with Technology and Operations to digitise processes and lower costs
  
• Develop the Product Strategy – work with the product management team to develop a comprehensive strategy for all cash management products by clearly defining the market landscape and drivers, core product proposition, target market and client segments, addressable market size, projected share of wallet and associated volumes/revenues, competitor capability assessment, product development roadmap, and commercialization strategy

Track and monitor execution of these plans through regular reviews and identify any issues where help is required to remove roadblocks. Review changes in the market landscape to understand the impact on the product bench, including changes in the regulatory horizon, and ensure the team pro-actively implement changes to mitigate risks and stay within the risk appetite of the Bank. Set up programs to promote awareness of risk and compliance issues associated with cash management products within GTB and with Sales and Coverage partners
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
• Minimum 10-12 years cash management product experience including at least 5 years senior management experience covering India market with full P&L accountability
  
• Strong understanding of all cash management products ideally in India/ global or large regional bank
  
• Track record developing and successfully commercialising multiple new products
  
• Experience in agile product and technology development approaches
  
• Strong people management skills
  
• Strong analytical and data rationale mindset
  
• Strong communication ability and executive impact

title: Assistant Manager - Product Delivery
description:
Assistant Manager – Product Delivery
  
  
Location: Mumbai
  
  
At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands - deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. As our Assistant Manager – Product Delivery, you'll be the person who makes that happen: turning client requirements into working solutions, translating messy real-world problems into clean product outcomes, and owning delivery end-to-end from the first conversation to go-live. If you love figuring out "what the client actually needs, how to solve it, and how to ship it" - this role is built for you.
  
  
**We're The Perfect Match If You**

* Have 1–3 years of experience in a client-facing implementation, SaaS delivery, solutioning, or technical project role.
* Have worked directly with enterprise clients and juggled multiple stakeholders and workstreams without dropping the ball.
* Are AI-first and hands-on - you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and solve smarter.
* Bring a can-do attitude - when someone says "this is tricky," your first instinct is "let's figure it out."
* Communicate with clarity and influence - equally comfortable aligning a client's HR team and rallying internal Product & Engineering.
* Thrive on ownership and ambiguity - you'd rather run a thread yourself than wait for a map.

**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like**

* Own end-to-end delivery of IDfy's products for clients - from requirement understanding through solutioning, UAT, and go-live - within agreed timelines.
* Get deep into the client's employee onboarding journey and HRTech ecosystem to spot process and product gaps before they become delivery issues.

* Partner across teams to balance what the client wants against what's buildable, scalable, and on-time.
