title: Senior Consultant – Digital Strategy
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Consultant – Digital Strategy**
WSP is seeking a
**Senior Consultant – Digital Strategy**
to join our growing Smart & Digital team in India. The role sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, data, AI and the built environment, helping clients define and deliver practical digital solutions that create measurable business and operational value.
  
  
As a Senior Consultant, you will work across major infrastructure, buildings, cities and real estate projects, supporting clients from strategy development and business case creation through solution definition, implementation planning and adoption. The successful candidate will combine strong consulting and analytical skills with a broad understanding of digital technologies and transformation approaches.
  
  
You will be expected to independently lead project workstreams, engage with senior client stakeholders, develop high-quality deliverables, and contribute to the growth of WSP's Smart & Digital offering.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Tech Strategy Advisory

+ Develop digital strategies and frameworks, smart city and smart asset strategies, digital roadmaps, operating models, business cases, and implementation plans.
+ Work directly with clients to understand business, operational, and asset-related challenges and translate them into practical digital solutions and transformation initiatives.
+ Assess opportunities across areas such as AI, data & analytics, digital twins, IoT, connected assets, automation, intelligent buildings, and digital platforms.
+ Conduct current-state assessments, stakeholder consultations, benchmarking studies, capability assessments, and technology evaluations.
+ Translate complex technology concepts into clear business propositions, executive recommendations and actionable implementation plans.
+ Conduct primary and secondary research, synthesize findings, and develop data-driven insights and perspectives for clients.

* Project Delivery

+ Lead and manage Smart & Digital consulting workstreams, from problem definition through recommendations and implementation planning.
+ Develop business requirements, use cases, and high-level solution concepts in collaboration with WSP technical specialists and delivery teams.
+ Prepare high-quality executive presentations, reports, business cases, and proposals.
+ Ensure deliverables are produced to a high standard of quality, accuracy and client relevance.

* Client and Stakeholder Management

+ Lead client workshops, interviews, and working sessions with senior stakeholders, project teams and multidisciplinary groups.
+ Build strong relationships with clients and act as a trusted advisor throughout project delivery.
+ Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate alignment across diverse project teams and client organizations.

* Business Development

+ Support business development activities, proposal preparation, and client pursuits across Smart & Digital opportunities.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, market research, and the development of new Smart & Digital service offerings.
+ Identify opportunities to expand client relationships and support account growth.
+ Stay current with developments in AI, digital twins, smart cities, data platforms, automation and related technologies, assessing their practical applicability and business value across sectors.

**Qualifications**
**Requirements:**

* 4-6 years of experience in management consulting, digital strategy, technology advisory, smart cities, smart buildings, or related fields.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business, or a related discipline. MBA from a reputed institution, and prior consulting experience within a Big4 or leading management consulting firm, are advantageous.
* Demonstrated experience developing digital strategies and frameworks, transformation roadmaps, business cases, operating models or technology-enabled solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and structured thinking capabilities.
* Proficiency in secondary research, and experience conducting workshops, stakeholder interviews and executive-level client engagements.
* Proven ability to prepare high-quality presentations, reports, and client deliverables with an eye for design and cohesive storyboarding.
* Ability to independently manage workstreams and deliver projects in a client-facing environment.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across geographies and cultures.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
**Our Hybrid Working Module**
With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
  
  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
  
  
**Inclusivity and Diversity**
WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
  
  
**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
  
  
**With us, you can.
  
  
Apply today.**

Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. title: Device Manager
description:
At Adalvo, we're not just a company - we're a team of passionate people driven by our mission to consistently deliver high-quality products and services to our partners. We are positive, fast and always on target, we are Adalvo! 🎯 🚀

We are looking for an enthusiastic
**Device Manager**
to join our dynamic Strategic Scientific Affairs team. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves tackling new challenges, then this is the perfect opportunity for you.

**SUMMARY OF POSITION**

The Device Manager will be responsible for the technical, development, regulatory, and lifecycle management activities related to Adalvo's Drug-Device Combination Products (DDCPs) and Medical Devices. This role will act as the subject matter expert for device technologies, supporting product selection, development, licensing evaluations, regulatory submissions, technology transfers, and commercial launches.

Working closely with R&D, Portfolio, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Intellectual Property, Business Development, Supply Chain, and external device partners, the Device Manager will ensure that all device-related activities are executed in compliance with global regulatory requirements while supporting Adalvo's strategic growth objectives.

**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

The position will report directly to the Senior Director / Head of R&D.

Key cross-functional interfaces include:

· Formulation Development

· Regulatory Affairs

· Quality Assurance

· Portfolio Management

· Business Development

· Intellectual Property

· Supply Chain

· Project Management

· External Device Manufacturers and Technology Partners

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Primary responsibilities of this role include the following:

**Device Strategy & Technical Leadership**

· Serve as Adalvo's technical lead for medical devices and drug-device combination products.

· Support product selection, due diligence activities, and technical evaluations of potential licensing opportunities.

· Define device development strategies aligned with regulatory, commercial, and patient requirements.

· Provide expert guidance on device selection, usability, human factors, and risk management activities.

**Device Development & Lifecycle Management**

· Lead development activities for autoinjectors, pen injectors, prefilled syringes, inhalation devices, nasal delivery systems, and other combination products.

· Prepare and review device development plans, specifications, technical documentation, and design verification reports.

· Oversee Design History Files (DHF), risk assessments, device change controls, and lifecycle management activities.

· Support troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the product lifecycle.

**Regulatory & Compliance**

· Ensure compliance with applicable global regulations and standards including MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 11608, ISO 11040, FDA 21 CFR, and other relevant medical device requirements.

· Support regulatory submissions, deficiency responses, variations, and lifecycle maintenance activities.

· Review technical files, design documentation, risk management files, and usability engineering documentation.

· Stay informed of emerging global device regulations and industry expectations.

**External Partner & Vendor Management**

· Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage device manufacturers and development partners.

· Participate in technical due diligence of suppliers, development organizations, and manufacturing sites.

· Support quality audits and supplier qualification activities together with Quality teams.

· Drive collaboration and alignment across internal stakeholders and external partners.

**Technology Transfer & Commercial Launch**

· Support scale-up and technology transfer projects from development through commercialization.

· Ensure readiness of device components, assembly processes, testing methods, and packaging systems.

· Support manufacturing site implementation, validation activities, FAT/SAT reviews, and launch activities.

· Collaborate with Project Management to ensure timely execution of milestones and deliverables.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

· Work closely with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Portfolio, Business Development, and Commercial teams to deliver successful projects.

· Provide device expertise during partner meetings, customer discussions, and licensing evaluations.

· Support training and knowledge transfer related to device technologies across Adalvo.

**QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Packaging Technology, or a related scientific discipline.

• Minimum 8 years of pharmaceutical and/or medical device industry experience.

• Demonstrated experience with Drug-Device Combination Products and Medical Devices.

• Strong knowledge of device development principles, risk management, human factors engineering, and usability studies.

title: Principal Functional Consultant
description:

* Ensure optimal test coverage and test execution, enabling a smooth and timely transition to production.
* Mentor and share product knowledge with other consultants.
* Help deliver successful project outcomes and lasting customer relationships.
* Great team player

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field**
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). title: Product Manager
description:
**Role: Product Manager, Trading Infrastructure**

You will own the professional and algo trading surface of Arrow: the products where latency, data depth and execution quality are the whole point. Five areas sit in your remit, and each one is a product in its own right.

* TBT charts: In-house tick-by-tick charting: sub-second candles, order-flow and footprint views, replay, with chart latency held close to feed latency
* HFT algos: In-house algos and a strategy marketplace retail traders can deploy on co-located infrastructure, with risk guardrails and exchange approvals built in
* API latency: The trading and market-data APIs: round-trip order latency at p50/p95/p99, WebSocket feed delivery, SDK ergonomics, rate limits, sandbox
* Colocation access: Productizing exchange co-lo for clients: rack and VM offerings, provisioning, cross-connects, pricing and compliance
* Tick-level data: Dissemination of full-depth, tick-by-tick market data: live feeds, snapshots, historical tick archives, entitlements and fan-out at scale

This is the first dedicated Product Manager on the Arrow team. You will work directly with the CTO, the HFT desk, the quant team and exchange-connectivity engineers, and you will set the product process as much as run it. Expect to spend as much time with latency histograms and order-book data as with roadmap documents.

**You'll do:**

* Own the TBT charting roadmap. Define what a tick-by-tick chart must do for a scalper that a one-second chart cannot: sub-second aggregation, order-flow and footprint views, volume-at-price, replay, and multi-instrument sync. Set and track the chart-update latency budget against the raw feed.
* Bring in-house HFT algos to retail. Scope the first algos and the strategy marketplace: which strategies ship first, how traders discover, configure and deploy them on co-located infrastructure, what the kill switches and position limits look like, and how each algo clears SEBI and exchange approval before launch.
* Own API latency as a product metric. Define the order round-trip and feed-delivery SLOs at p50, p95 and p99, instrument them end to end (client, gateway, OMS, exchange), publish them transparently, and drive the engineering backlog that moves them.
* Run the developer experience for the trading API: Go and Python SDKs, WebSocket market-data streams, docs, sandbox, rate limits, static-IP and algo-tagging requirements, and onboarding for API clients from first key to first live order.
* Productise colocation access. Turn exchange co-lo into something a professional client can buy: rack, VM and managed-server tiers, provisioning SLAs, cross-connects, pricing, and the compliance and audit trail each exchange requires.
* Own tick-level data dissemination. Define the market-data products: full-depth live feeds, TBT versus snapshot tiers, historical tick archives, entitlements and billing, and the fan-out architecture needed to serve thousands of clients without adding latency.
* Talk to professional traders every week: scalpers, option market-makers, quants and API users. Turn what they say and what their order flow shows into specs engineers can build from without a second meeting.
* Write crisp PRDs with success metrics, latency budgets, failure modes and exchange-rule constraints (algo approval, order-to-trade ratios, throttles, circuit limits, square-off timings) spelled out.
* Partner with the CTO, the HFT desk and exchange-connectivity engineers on trade-offs between latency, throughput, reliability and features; a feature that adds 200 µs to the hot path is a product decision, not just an engineering one.
* Define and track the metrics that matter: order latency and feed latency by percentile, API uptime, active API clients, algo deployments and their P&L distribution, co-lo utilisation, and tick-data subscriptions.

**What we're looking for:**

* 4-8 years in product, trading-systems engineering or quant/HFT trading, with at least 3 years owning a technical or fintech product end to end.
* You understand market microstructure. Order books, tick data, matching-engine behaviour, order-to-trade ratios, what co-lo buys you and what it does not. You know why a scalper cares about the difference between 1 ms and 3 ms.
* Hands-on with trading APIs. You have built or run something against a broker or exchange API, understand REST versus WebSocket versus binary protocols, and can read a latency histogram and say where the time went.
* Fluent with data. You can write SQL, pull your own latency and order-flow data, and argue a prioritisation call with numbers rather than opinions.
* Shipped in a regulated environment. You can read a SEBI or exchange circular on algo trading, API access or market data and turn it into a product requirement.
* Clear writer. Your PRDs, SLO definitions and API docs get read and acted on by engineers and traders alike.
* Bias for shipping. You have taken a feature from a trader complaint to production in weeks, not quarters, and iterated after launch.

**Nice to have:**

* Worked at an HFT or prop firm, an exchange, a market-data vendor or an algo trading platform.
* Familiarity with NSE/BSE TBT and snapshot feeds, exchange co-lo offerings and the NNF/API order-tagging framework.
* Have run a live strategy through a broker API, even a small one.
* Options knowledge beyond the basics: Greeks, market-making, hedged-position margin.
* Python or Go, enough to prototype an API call, parse a tick file or build your own latency dashboard.

**What we Offer:**

* A real execution edge to build on: co-located infrastructure and a 17-year HFT track record that no other retail broker in India starts with.
* First dedicated PM in the seat. You define the role, the process and the roadmap, and you report to the CTO.
* Direct access to the HFT desk, quant team and exchange-connectivity engineers; the people who built the engine sit a few desks away.
* Offices in Mumbai (Andheri East); market hours mean an early start and a clear end to the day.

description:

You will use internal stakeholder feedback, user needs and operational insight to improve our platforms, enhance operational effectiveness and deliver value across the business.

As Product Owner, the role is responsible for defining release plans, managing and prioritising the product backlog, and working closely with development teams and stakeholders to support successful delivery, product launches and continuous improvement. title: Consumer Product Development & Brand Launch Manager
description:
**About Lion & Child**

Lion & Child is an independent creative and venture studio building original consumer brands, media and entertainment projects.

We're developing a portfolio of consumer products across lifestyle and other categories, taking ideas from initial concept through product development, manufacturing, branding and commercial launch.

We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial professional to work directly with the founder and help bring these products to market.

**The Role**

This is a hands-on, end-to-end role for someone who understands how physical consumer products are developed, manufactured and launched.

You'll help turn early-stage product concepts into commercially viable, market-ready products, coordinating everything from manufacturer sourcing and sampling to packaging, costing and launch execution.

We're a small, founder-led company, so you'll need to be resourceful, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership without a large team or established infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, evaluate and negotiate with manufacturers, suppliers and production partners.
* Manage product development from initial concept through prototyping, sampling, refinement and final production.
* Coordinate product specifications, materials, packaging, quality standards and production timelines.
* Develop product costing, pricing structures, margins and minimum order quantity (MOQ) strategies.
* Work with external designers, branding agencies and creative partners to bring products to life.
* Coordinate the setup and launch of D2C sales channels, including Shopify and relevant marketplaces.
* Manage external vendors across packaging, logistics, fulfilment and launch activities.
* Research consumer trends, competitor products and opportunities for new product categories.
* Build practical execution plans, manage budgets and ensure projects move from idea to launch.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in consumer product development, sourcing, merchandising, category management or brand launches. More experienced candidates are welcome.
* Demonstrated experience working with manufacturers and suppliers to develop or commercialize physical products.
* Strong understanding of product costing, margins, MOQs, packaging and production processes.
* Experience in consumer categories such as lifestyle, stationery, accessories, gifting, homeware, beauty or related products.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of how consumer brands are positioned, priced and brought to market.
* Ability to manage multiple external partners and execute independently.
* An entrepreneurial mindset and genuine interest in building new brands from scratch.

**Direct experience taking physical products from concept through sampling, manufacturing and commercial launch matters more to us than total years of experience.**

**What Makes This Opportunity Different**

You'll work directly with the founder, helping shape and launch original consumer brands rather than simply managing an established product portfolio.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys building things, solving practical problems and seeing their work go from an idea to a real product in customers' hands.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have personally been involved in developing and launching new physical products, not solely managing existing e-commerce operations or marketplace accounts.

title: Senior Lead - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
  
  
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
  
  
Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
  
  
**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in a Nutshell**

* Lead/Senior Lead, Business Strategy and Operations position will be responsible for partnering closely with functional leaders across Marketing and GTM to develop a shared set of priorities, growth strategy and operational plan. You will ensure our strategy is coordinated and cohesive, and supports our company objectives. As a key partner to Marketing leaders, you will act as a liaison between Marketing and the wider GTM teams, including Sales, GTM Strategy & Planning, and Financial Planning teams.
* In this role you will be required to meet our goals of supporting & optimizing all operations & technology to enable effective marketing at BrowserStack. This role will be a critical partner to the Marketing organisation for leading strategic planning and generating insights that drive Marketing performance.
* You will also conduct and support primary and secondary research projects and create relevant insights on market trends, market sizing, market forecasting, company bench- marking, customer needs, and competition that inform product, customer, and go-to-market strategies.

**What Will You Do?**

* Strategic Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of market trends, industry developments, and competitive landscapes to provide valuable insights that inform our corporate Strategy and executive decision-making.
* Data-driven Insights: Utilise data analytics and business intelligence tools to extract meaningful insights from various data sources, enabling informed strategic choices at the executive level.
* Market Opportunities: Identify new market opportunities and emerging trends that align with the organization's goals, enabling proactive decision-making to capitaliize on these opportunities.
* Competitive Intelligence: Monitor and analyse competitor activities, market positioning, and product offerings to help the organisation maintain a competitive edge.

description:

**Our Company:**

Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. title: Product Manager 2
description:
**Product Manager | TrustStack | Mumbai**
**Function:**
Product – TrustStack
  
  
**Level:**
Product Manager 2
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
At IDfy, TrustStack isn't a back-end utility — it's the trust and data platform that sits underneath every IDfy product. It verifies people and businesses against authoritative sources, reads and checks documents, confirms that a face is real and belongs to the right person, and detects fraud and tampering. Every IDfy product, and hundreds of banks, NBFCs, and fintechs, rely on it every day.
  
  
This role owns the roadmap for a set of areas within TrustStack and takes them to their next stage — from what to build and why, to how it reaches customers and whether it moved the needle. You'll spend real time with clients, lead Engineering, DevOps, and Data Science without formal authority, and build prototypes yourself when that's the fastest way to an answer. This is an individual-contributor role: hands-on, high ownership, high impact.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
You'll own the roadmap and outcomes for areas within TrustStack, matched to your strengths:
  
  

* Fraud Intelligence — detecting fraud and tampering across documents, faces, and identities, and turning those signals into products clients rely on
* AI-Native Access — making our capabilities easy for developers, partner platforms, and AI agents to discover and use
* Model Quality & Reliability — knowing how our models and data sources perform in production, and acting before a client feels a problem
* Document Intelligence — helping clients and internal teams read, understand, and verify any document faster
* Global Coverage — taking capabilities to new markets and cross-border use cases, and building geography-specific capabilities

**We're The Right Match If You**

* Have a B.Tech from a Tier-1 engineering institute (IIT / NIT / BITS)
* Have 4–5 years of experience, with hands-on product management on technical, integration-heavy, or data-centric B2B products — developer platforms, data infrastructure, ML-powered products, or B2B SaaS (product and consulting backgrounds both welcome)
* Have worked on implementing GenAI or agentic models — and have built something with AI tools yourself: a prototype, an internal tool, an agent, or a script you actually used. Bring it to the interview.
* Are strongly analytical — comfortable crunching data, working with SQL, logs, dashboards, and model evaluation metrics, and making a call from evidence
* Have built 0→1, or genuinely want to — you're comfortable starting from a blank page and shaping the answer
* Have high agency and a bias for action — you'd rather ship a version on Friday and learn than debate it for a month, and you can show us examples
* Speak Engineering, DevOps, and Data Science fluently — engineers trust your judgement on integrations, data pipelines, and trade-offs
* Are client-facing by instinct — you can run a discovery session with a client team and present a roadmap to its leadership with equal ease
* Have led without authority — you've rallied engineers and data scientists who didn't report to you around a shared deadline and outcome
* Write clearly — your specs, updates, and decision notes are short, sharp, and actually get read

**Bonus Points If You've**

* Worked on B2B integrations (at any point in your career — not necessarily in your current role)
* Built or shipped work in identity verification, fraud, risk, or fintech for banks and NBFCs
* Worked closely with ML teams on model evaluation, monitoring, or releases
* Had a founding or early-stage startup stint, or worked as an engineer or data scientist before moving into product

**What Your Day Would Look Like**

* Owning the roadmap — setting priorities for your areas, sequencing the work, defining success metrics and what "done" means, and defending trade-offs to leadership
* Being in front of clients — leading discovery with clients and partners, joining integration reviews and escalations, and presenting new capabilities and roadmaps to client teams
* Turning ambiguity into action — breaking a fuzzy opportunity into a quick MVP, followed by an enterprise-grade plan with milestones, owners, and dates, then driving it week by week
* Prototyping before you spec — using AI coding tools to build a working prototype, demo, or dashboard and putting it in front of a client or engineer before writing a long document
* Going deep on model and product performance — instrumenting metrics, evaluating precision, recall, drift, and latency, and making data-driven trade-offs between accuracy, speed, and cost
* Leading cross-functionally — aligning Engineering, Data Science/ML, DevOps, Sales, Legal, and InfoSec teams that don't report to you, without letting anyone become a bottleneck
* Shipping and measuring — taking features from idea to production to adoption, and tracking whether what you shipped moved the goal
* Wearing the other hats — drafting the pricing note, the launch one-pager, the security questionnaire response, or the demo when no one else will

**Why IDfy**
Because this is where trust is built with data. At IDfy, you'll work on:
  
  

* Problems that don't have answers yet — fraud intelligence and AI-native trust infrastructure for financial services, across India and Asia
* Real scale from day one — your work runs under every IDfy product and inside the journeys of banks, NBFCs, and fintechs
* A strong technical bench — dedicated Engineering and Data Science teams
* Ownership, not tickets — you own outcomes end-to-end, with room to make mistakes along the way
* AI-native ways of working — we prototype with AI tools every day and expect you to push that further

title: Associate - Program Management
description:
**Job Description**
We are modernizing Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting, moving from legacy reporting platforms to a Databricks Lakehouse-based architecture and introducing artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working. We are hiring a hands-on Product Owner / Business Analyst who combines strong regulatory reporting and data analysis experience with a modern technology mindset. You will work across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions. The ideal candidate can understand the business problem, work through the data, translate requirements into technology delivery, test the outcome, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. To accelerate delivery and improve accuracy, the role leverages agentic artificial intelligence tools while maintaining strong human-in-the-loop controls and review discipline.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As an Associate in Program Management within Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting Modernization, you will own requirements delivery end-to-end—spanning regulatory change, business growth, general ledger optimization, technology modernization, and global alignment in data sourcing and consumption. You will partner closely with Asia Pacific Finance stakeholders (Senior Financial Officers, Legal Entity Controllers), Corporate Technology, and vendor consultants to deliver strategic reporting solutions, operate governance, and ensure high-quality, regulator-ready outputs. You will translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions and drive clear stakeholder communications. You will leverage agentic artificial intelligence tooling to support requirements extraction, impact assessment, test design, validation, and stakeholder-ready narratives, with strong review discipline.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Own product vision and roadmap, intake, prioritization, and change control; maintain the backlog (epics, features, user stories), define minimum viable products, sequence delivery, and drive trade-offs across regulatory change versus modernization.
* Drive delivery governance cadence by preparing committee materials and providing clear, concise stakeholder communications.
* Translate regulatory circulars and business rules into business requirements documentation, impact assessments, functional specifications, and Jira epics and stories.
* Perform impact assessments for upstream system changes and data sourcing changes; define scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Finance users, Corporate Technology, and vendor teams to align the operating model and delivery approach.
* Define and implement Medallion-layer reporting logic and controls across Bronze (raw and audit-preserving), Silver (standardize, deduplicate, join), and Gold (regulator-ready rules and submission aggregations).
* Own end-to-end lineage from Gold to Silver to Bronze to source using Unity Catalog.
* Implement validation controls and pre-submission quality gates, including anomaly and outlier detection.
* Define the testing approach, scope, and plan; lead user acceptance testing with Finance and Technology.
* Build test cases and expected results; execute end-to-end tests (including automated tools where applicable), identify issues early, propose mitigations, drive timely closure, and continuously improve processes and controls.
* Use agent workflows (for example, GitHub Copilot and Databricks Genie) to accelerate requirements extraction, mapping logic, rule definition, expected-result creation, and validation; perform structured reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and governance-ready (impact summaries, control narratives, committee-ready materials).

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Accountancy, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of overall Product Owner / Business Analyst experience, including 3+ years delivering Asia Pacific local regulatory reporting automation for a foreign bank.
* Proven delivery and project management experience in Finance Regulatory Reporting automation.
* Strong data analysis skills to gather and validate facts, define gaps, perform impact analysis, draft requirements, and translate complex needs into functional specifications.
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders and produce concise written updates and governance-ready materials.
* Strong planning and time management; ability to handle multiple assignments under deadlines with proactive risk and issue management.
* Collaborative and solution-focused approach; ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
* Practical prompt engineering to drive repeatable outputs (impact assessments, mapping rules, test scenarios, defect triage summaries, stakeholder narratives).
* Ability to review and validate artificial intelligence-generated outputs against source regulatory text, control rules, and expected results (human-in-the-loop).
* Comfort using Visual Studio Code with GitHub Copilot (including Agent Mode) to accelerate requirements and test asset creation while maintaining governance standards.
* Hands-on or working familiarity with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Agile backlog tooling (Jira and Confluence), and regulatory reporting vendor platforms (Nasdaq Axiom/Adenza, Wolters Kluwer, Reveleus, Resoft).

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate or Data Engineer Associate (or Generative AI Engineer Associate).
* GitHub certification (for example, GitHub Foundations or GitHub Actions) and/or formal Copilot training or enablement.
* Substitution: 2+ years of production, hands-on experience delivering end-to-end business requirements or testing using Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, and GitHub Copilot Agent Mode in banking.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

* Drive the development and launch of innovative ad products, formats, targeting capabilities and advertising experiences.
* Translate market trends, advertiser requirements and business opportunities into scalable product initiatives.

title: Founder's Office - EIR
description:
**Founder's Office - EIR**

**Function:**
Founder’s Office

**Location:**
Mumbai & Pune

**Employment Type:**
Full Time

**Reports To:**
Founders

**About RINGS & I**

RINGS & I is a
**seven-year-old made-to-order diamond jewellery brand**
, founded by engineers with a belief that jewellery does not need to be built around inventory.

We are building a technology-led jewellery experience where customers can:

* Access
  **live, dynamic pricing**
* **Personalize designs live in 3D**
* Build and configure jewellery through
  **Build Your Own**
  experiences
* Choose across multiple materials, diamonds and specifications without being restricted by stocked inventory
* Make informed decisions with
  **education and transparency at the centre of the buying journey**

Over the last year, RINGS & I has scaled rapidly, and we have an
**aggressive three-year growth plan across multiple cities.**

**Role Summary**

Founder’s Office is for people who enjoy
**figuring things out from zero**
.

You may have tried building something of your own before. You may have always wanted to. Or you may simply know that you are not someone who wants to spend years waiting for the next designation before taking on bigger problems.

This role will work directly with the founders on high-priority growth problems, initially across Marketing, Ops, Fulfilment, RevOps.

You will pick up a problem, understand it deeply, build the playbook, test it on ground and take it far enough that it can become a repeatable business function.

You can go ahead and pick the next problem or lead the vertical you solved for.

**Why this role exists?**

RINGS & I is scaling fast.

Founders cannot personally figure out every new market, channel, partnership, activation or growth opportunity as the organisation expands.

We therefore need people who can
**think like founders without needing to be founders immediately**
.

People who can take an ambiguous problem and move it from:

**Nothing → Hypothesis → Pilot → Learning → Repeatable Playbook**

The role exists to create that additional problem-solving capacity around the founders.

**What will you own?**

You will take ownership of
**one high-priority growth area at a time**
and be expected to create measurable progress within approximately six months.

Assignments may include:

* Achieving EBITDA % for the studio
* Increasing throughput of a single studio
* Test a new audience set
* Test and set a new marketing channel
* Help build LTV
* Set up fulfilment systems

The objective is not merely to coordinate these activities.

The objective is to
**figure out what works, prove it, and build something the organisation can scale.**

**What does success look like?**

Success in Founder’s Office is simple:

**Can you take an undefined business problem and turn it into a working, measurable playbook?**

The specific KPIs will depend on the problem you own.

**Who should join Founder's Office?**

This role is likely to work for you if:

* You have
  **relentless grit**
  and do not give up easily.
* You enjoy problems where the answer does not already exist.
* You naturally ask,
  **“How can we make this happen?”**
* You are comfortable getting your hands dirty and executing, not only strategising.
* You move fast and learn through doing.
* You want responsibility to grow much faster than your designation.
* You would rather build something meaningful in one organisation than repeatedly change companies for the next title.
* You take ownership even when multiple teams or external partners are involved.
* You do not restrict yourself to job role, location but marry outcome
* You have been Head Girl/Boy, Student or General Secretory at School/College and you are a natural leader

Having attempted entrepreneurship, built a side project, led something from zero, or shown similar evidence of a
**founder mindset**
would be highly valued.

**What is in it for you?**

Founder’s Office offers unusually high exposure early in your career.

You will get:

* **Direct strategic exposure to the founders & cross-functional aspect of Business**
* Freedom to test, learn and build
* Opportunities to work across functions rather than inside a narrow job boundary
* First-hand experience of scaling a consumer retail business across cities
* The opportunity to build a function or capability from zero
* A fast growth path when you demonstrate the ability to own larger outcomes

The intent is not for someone to remain in Founder’s Office indefinitely.

**Build something → prove it → own a larger mandate.**

Your next role should emerge from what you successfully build.

title: Strategy Manager
description:

title: Lead Data management
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
Our GCOO organisation is critical for HSBC. This team partners closely with business teams to drive simplification and deliver exceptional customer outcomes in Asia and the Middle East region which covers 26 markets, 600+ offices and branches, and more than 140,000 employees. By strengthening our control environment and enhancing risk management, we drive operational excellence and enable the bank to deliver focused and sustainable growth in this super-region.
  
  
**Role purpose**
(overall high level summary of the role)
  
  
HSBC Data & Architecture Office (DAO) promotes a data-driven culture across HSBC through our strategy of:
  
  

* Protect: To protect our data we need robust policies for data management and enhanced governance e.g. data that is consumed from a trusted source, meets quality standards, and complies with regulatory obligations.
* Connect: Move to a data-led culture through enhanced training including on the job opportunities. Our talent is the glue between protecting our data and unlocking value for our customers.
* Unlock. Value is unlocked when we deliver on the opportunities our well-managed data presents e.g. improving customer / colleague experience, increasing revenue, commercializing our data, optimizing capital, enhancing risk management or reducing costs.

The
**Data Management Lead**
primarily supports all the
**Protect and Connect**
pillars of the strategy.
  
  

* This role will work across all Business/Functions to ensure governance and alignment to the Group Data Strategy.

**Key Priorities In Scope For The Incumbent Would Include**

* Implementation of data programs and controls in alignment with country regulatory requirements
* Participate in country industry forums (USIBC, IBA) for common understanding of country data policies
* Owner and executor of RCA of DAO owned country data risks
* Data Controls Implementation covering including DMOV, DUSE and DSTO (ILM)
* Supporting the market in the adherence and compliance to Data Privacy (DPRIV) controls
* Data risk management oversight and oversight of related audit, regulatory and compliance activities

**Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities**
( e.g., for Business, Customers and Stakeholders; internal control environment, etc.)
  
  

* Operating in a high performing, valuable and scalable data management team to meet customer demand
* Lead collaboration and engagement with the multiple lines of business in HSBC India as well as the CIO, CCO and 2LOD teams, to communicate the Group Data Strategy and key regional and global Data & Analytics Office initiatives
* Lead in delivering the data strategy roadmap for HSBC India
* Act as a trusted advisor to HSBC India by becoming a subject matter expert in the Data Management practices, policies and procedures of the Group
* Manage Stakeholder engagement and expectations by supporting demand into the Global DAO utilities and driving transparency of backlogs and prioritisation
* Manage and monitor the Data Quality process, remediation, issues and reporting
* Accountable for reporting of progress, issues, dependencies, and risks to stakeholders, Country Data Executive Council and/or steering committees for programs led by DAO
* Become a trusted advisor, manage stakeholder’s expectations and build strong working relationship with local, regional and global Data & Analytics Office teams
* Champion the needs, priorities and regulatory requirements of India DAO in Regional and Global forums
* Manage and oversight control implementation across initiatives in India
* Accountable to ensure deliveries remain within agreed budgets.
* Act as SME on adhoc data projects as required, inc regulatory requests
* Support the uplift of data literacy in India
* Hosts country growth enablement forum

**Key Responsibilities Include Some Of But Not Limited To**

* Support the implementation of HSBC data governance and quality guidelines, procedures, methods etc.
* Ensure good practices in the management of data tools, standards, frameworks and templates
* Manage and monitor operational risk in the field of data management

**Collaboration**

* Ensure that the initiative (CTB or RTB) objectives are clearly understood and mutually agreed by the stakeholders.
* Generate strong and realistic business cases using business knowledge and ability to question and challenge etc.
* Develop and maintain effective stakeholder relationships across streams
* Ensure close coordination and collaboration with Support Functions.
* Engage the participants to deliver according to the plan irrespective of their reporting departments.

**Execution**

* Coordinate on cost benefit study and prepare proposal on data initiatives.
* Derive approach and prepare plan in a cost effective/efficient manner
* Providing timely and accurate status reporting to key stakeholders and sponsors.
* Ensure all activities are compliant with HSBC business standards

**Monitoring/ Transparency**

* Effectively manage all dependencies and interactions across associated and complimentary projects / activities.
* Monitor and track progress of all deliverables within the stream and ensure benefit realisation.
* Provide accurate and effective cost monitoring.
* Manage and escalate risks and issues in a timely manner
* For Risk and Issue management, detect and report risk and issue at timely manner, coordinate and identify solution with relevant parties and monitor progress to achieve the closure.
* Coordinate and provide rigorous Financial reporting around spend and benefit to business sponsors and Finance.

**Leadership & Teamwork**
Provides motivational leadership, sets team performance expectations and monitors progress
  
  

* Overall responsibility for supervising a department or a business unit/area team, or manages delivery for most complex assignments
* Attract and lead top talent to deliver data management services.
* Build and leverage strong relationships with senior leaders across HSBC and to understand, prioritise and meet demand for data management which supports overall business strategy.
* Maintain an effective Data operating model (organisation, people, process, and tools) across the Europe region

**Functional Knowledge**

* Track-record of developing and implementing a data strategy.
* Extensive experience of leading multi-disciplined teams to deliver exceptional customer service and value.
* Proven ability to deliver change globally across matrix-based organizations
* Thought-leader in data management.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skill.
* Experience in delivering in a highly regulated environment.
* Experience in data management, information lifecycle management or privacy preferable.

title: Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution Senior Manager, Vice President
description:
At Citi, we get to connect millions of people across hundreds of cities and countries every day. And we've been doing it for more than 200 years. We do this through our unparalleled global network. We provide a broad range of financial services and products to our clients – whether they be consumers, corporations, governments or institutions – to help them meet their biggest opportunities and face the world's toughest challenges.
  
  
We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as Vice President, Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution Senior Manager, Hybrid based in Mumbai, India. Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decision and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future. For instance:
  
  

* Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.
* We believe all parents deserve time to adjust to parenthood and bond with the newest members of their families. That’s why in early 2020 we began rolling out our expanded Paid Parental Leave Policy to include Citi employees around the world.
* We empower our employees to manage their financial well-being and help them plan for the future.
* Citi provides access to an array of learning and development resources to help broaden and deepen your skills and knowledge as your career progresses.
* We have a variety of programs that help employees balance their work and life, including generous paid time off packages.
* We offer our employees resources and tools to volunteer in the communities in which they live and work. In 2019, Citi employee volunteers contributed more than 1 million volunteer hours around the world.

The Program Advisory, Consulting & Execution (PACE) organization is Citi’s internal consulting and program execution team. Operating from Finance with a firmwide mandate, PACE serves as a strategic internal partner delivering management consulting, program advisory, and end-to-end execution support for Citi’s high-value initiatives and business transformation priorities. The organization partners closely with functional and business leadership to deliver significant, measurable business outcomes while retaining critical knowledge and reducing reliance on external consulting firms.
  
  
The PACE team is a global, interdisciplinary team comprised of seasoned professionals with deep financial services, program advisory, and management consulting expertise. With team members located in eight cities across five countries—Canada, Costa Rica, India, the United Kingdom, and the United States—PACE provides continuous global support, accelerated delivery, and rapid mobilization to solve the firm's most critical challenges.
  
  
**Summary**

* Lead the end-to-end execution of high-impact workstreams in cross-fun- ctional programs, driving process transformation, and operational improvements across the firm.
* Act as a subject matter expert in program and project management, leveraging structured PM practices to guide execution and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build and manage strong partnerships with senior project stakeholders and clients, serving as a key liaison to ensure alignment and facilitate collaboration.
* Drive accountability for project performance, holding both yourself and the team responsible for the quality of deliverables and adherence to established procedures.
* Operate effectively within a matrix management structure, reporting to senior leadership while collaborating closely with day-to-day engagement managers.
* Serve as an example of program management excellence, leveraging your experience to influence outcomes.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Drive analysis of complex data and business processes, developing initial hypotheses and turning ambiguous inputs into actionable, data-driven solutions.
* Support target operating model and process transformation initiatives by partnering with stakeholders to define business requirements and target states
* Work closely with Technology teams throughout delivery, helping teams apply business requirements in solution design, implementation, and testing.
* Define program requirements, objectives, and plans, establishing the structure and controls necessary to ensure successful delivery and mitigate ambiguity.
* Lead direct cross-functional teams within a complex global matrix environment, mobilizing diverse stakeholders toward a common goal. May assist on the program with training and coaching of junior staff with development needs.
* Collaborate and consult with executive leadership, stakeholders, project leads, executive leadership, sponsors, and business partners to clarify and define project requirements.
* Provide objective review and challenge for program deliverables, plans and other requirements.
* Prepare and deliver clear, impactful communications for project sponsors and senior stakeholders regarding analyses, project outcomes, and strategic recommendations.
* Act as a change catalyst by identifying opportunities for improvement and helping stakeholders understand how new ideas and solutions can benefit program objectives.
* Build and manage relationships with all key stakeholders, collaborating closely to define scope, manage expectations, and ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Continuously develop re-usable intellectual capital, contributing relevant content and research to the team’s knowledge base to be leveraged across the organization.

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* A minimum of 10 years of experience in management consulting and financial services, with a proven track record of managing complex, end-to-end projects and programs using a structured methodology.
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience is required; PMP or PRINCE2 certification is also preferred.
* Advanced proficiency in the MS Office Suite, including Excel for data analysis and PowerPoint for creating compelling, data-driven presentations.
* Experience working with complex financial services organizations delivering operating model and process transformation initiatives, authoring business requirements across Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies, and defining future-state operating models.
* Experience working with Technology teams across the delivery lifecycle, including requirements development, solution implementation, and testing support.
* Expertise in a range of analytical and project management competencies, including hypothesis generation, root cause identification, process mapping & improvement, operating model design, and business case development, applied within an Agile or similarly structured delivery framework.
* Strong familiarity with digitalization concepts, emerging technology trends including AI, and their practical application to transform business processes within a financial services context.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and influence a team-based, collaborative model, effectively guiding diverse stakeholders and project teams toward common goals in a complex, matrixed environment.
* A self-starter with a strong ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and solve complex problems by structuring analyses and turning incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively distill complex information and impactfully present analyses, plans, and recommendations to all levels of the organization.
* An innovative and curious mindset with a passion for improving the employee and customer experience.
* Able to act with a high sense of urgency and a detail-oriented approach to achieving goals.

title: Principal Product Manager, Recovery Orchestration
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
  
  
**What To Know**

* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
  
  
**About Commvault**
Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.
  
  
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the strategy and execution for our recovery orchestration platform — the layer that automates, sequences, and validates how enterprises bring critical systems back online after an outage, ransomware event, or disaster. This is a build-and-scale mandate: you'll be responsible for unifying what are today somewhat separate capabilities into a single, coherent platform story — with the pricing, packaging, and GTM discipline to make it a durable, high-margin product line, not just a feature bundle. You'll operate at the intersection of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture, working with engineering, pricing/finance, field enablement, and customer success to take this from current state to a major platform launch.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Strategy & Platform Vision
  
  

* Define and evolve the strategy for a unified recovery orchestration platform spanning multiple cloud workloads (compute, storage, databases) across AWS, Azure, and GCP
* Build the narrative for why orchestrated, tested recovery is a distinct platform capability — not a checkbox feature — for CISOs, infrastructure/DR leaders, and compliance stakeholders
* Own the roadmap sequencing across phased capability delivery

Pricing & Packaging
  
  

* Partner with Finance/Pricing to fix structural pricing issues (cost allocation across platform vs. product SKUs, bundle economics, SaaS vs. software parity) that directly affect adoption and retention
* Build the business case and options analysis for executive/CPO-level pricing decisions, using cost-vs-price framing
* Ensure packaging reflects real customer buying patterns rather than internal architecture boundaries

Cross-Functional Execution
  
  

* Drive a large, multi-team engineering workback (dozens of workstreams across workload teams, UI/UX, and platform) toward a release date
* Identify and escalate real schedule risk early and keep the leadership informed.
* Partner with field enablement and customer success to close the gap between product capability and what's actually sold, deployed, and renewed

Customer & Market Insight
  
  

* Validate positioning and pricing directly with field teams (solutions engineers, field CTOs) and customers — not just internal stakeholders
* Understand the two adjacent buyer personas this platform serves (security/CISO buyers focused on isolated recovery and forensics, and infrastructure/DR buyers focused on operational recovery) and make deliberate calls on how the platform positions to each without diluting either
* Identify new opportunities and problems to solve in the recovery space.

Executive Communication
  
  

* Write clear PRFAQs, business cases, and stakeholder updates for senior leadership audiences
* Present pricing and platform strategy directly to all stakeholders

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, or data resilience (backup/DR/ransomware recovery adjacent domains)
* Demonstrated experience owning pricing and packaging decisions with measurable business impact (not just feature roadmaps)
* Experience running large, cross-team technical programs with a hard external deadline (multiple engineering teams, dozens of dependencies, workback tracking)
* Strong grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, database recovery patterns
* Track record of building platform narratives for technical, security-conscious enterprise buyers (CISO, VP Infrastructure, Head of DR)
* Excellent written communication — comfortable producing PRDs, PRFAQs, and exec-level business cases independently

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Master's Degree preferred.
* Direct experience with backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware resilience products
* Familiarity with isolated recovery environment concepts (malware scanning, forensics-safe validation environments)
* Experience managing SKU/pricing structures across SaaS and on-prem/software delivery models
* Background partnering with channel/field enablement teams on complex technical products

Commvault is an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are always committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status and we will not discriminate against on the basis of such characteristics or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we work.

* Manage operational requirements for quick-commerce platforms, including catalogue setup, assortment, availability, purchase orders, promotional coordination and issue resolution.
* Coordinate website product listings, pricing, product content and operational requirements with the relevant teams and service providers.
* Identify channel-specific opportunities and improve execution across existing and new e-commerce channels.

**E. Team Management & Process Improvement**

* Lead and organise the existing e-commerce/operations team, with clearly defined responsibilities and performance metrics.
* Establish standard operating procedures for listings, inventory allocation, order processing, catalogue updates and marketplace escalations.
* Improve workflows, data accuracy and execution discipline.
* Work with the warehouse and logistics teams to improve dispatch accuracy, fulfilment performance and returns processing.
* Drive process automation and better utilisation of the existing warehouse management and e-commerce systems.

**F. Reporting & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Prepare a regular e-commerce dashboard covering sales, inventory, listing health, stock-outs, returns, cancellations and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Finance on marketplace reconciliation and channel-level performance.
* Work with Marketing on promotions, campaigns, product launches and content requirements.
* Escalate material risks, opportunities and decisions requiring founder intervention.

**Candidate Profile**

* 68 years of experience in e-commerce operations, marketplace management or e-commerce business management.
* Prior experience with a D2C, consumer-products, retail or marketplace-led brand is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Amazon and Flipkart; quick-commerce experience with platforms such as Blinkit, Instamart or Zepto is a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of catalogue management, listing health, inventory planning, marketplace operations and account escalations.
* Experience managing teams and coordinating with warehouses, logistics partners, advertising agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Strong Excel and data-analysis skills, with the ability to interpret SKU-wise and channel-wise performance.
* Familiarity with e-commerce management systems, ERP/WMS tools and marketplace seller portals.
* High ownership, problem-solving ability and willingness to work hands-on in a lean organisation.

**Key Success Measures**

* Improved sales-channel execution and availability.
* Reduction in avoidable stock-outs, listing errors and catalogue issues.
* Accurate SKU mapping, pricing and marketplace content.
* Improved inventory allocation and replenishment discipline.
* Timely resolution of marketplace escalations.
* Better team productivity and standardisation of operating processes.
* Reliable e-commerce dashboards and coordination with Finance and Marketing.

**Role Boundaries**

The E-commerce Manager will own marketplace operations, availability, catalogue hygiene, channel execution and e-commerce performance monitoring. Performance marketing agencies will continue to execute paid advertising, with the Brand & Content Manager owning brand communication and creative strategy.

The E-commerce Manager will work with Operations on warehouse and logistics execution and with Finance on reconciliations and profitability. The role must coordinate these functions without duplicating their core responsibilities.

title: Application Engineer, Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
BlackRock’s Post Trade & Accounting group is seeking a Vice President-level engineering leader to advance our enterprise Client Reporting platform. This role encompasses technical leadership, system design, and direct coding responsibilities, enabling the development of robust, event-driven platforms that deliver reliable solutions for institutional and Aladdin clients globally. You will lead development of core platform capabilities across distributed services and data systems, shaping long-term architecture for a mission-critical platform where scale, accuracy, resiliency, and auditability are essential. You will also partner across product and operations to drive modernization, automation, and AI-enabled engineering practices. About the Team The Client Reporting team delivers and manages BlackRock’s enterprise Client Reporting platform, providing end-to-end reporting solutions for a diverse global base of accounting and institutional clients. We oversee the full lifecycle of report production and distribution—ensuring quality, scalability, and operational excellence through advanced QC workflows, exception management tools (including the Aladdin dashboard), and robust monitoring frameworks. The team manages reporting inventory and KPIs, supports both standardized and highly customized data sets, and enables access to reporting-ready data through digital portals and reporting libraries. We also power a dynamic self-service experience, offering secure document delivery via API, SFTP, and Secure Links, along with flexible tools for client-driven report configuration and branding. By owning the critical systems and processes behind client reporting, the team plays a central role in shaping client experience, driving automation and innovation, and delivering scalable, resilient solutions for industry-leading clients. What You’ll Do Lead development, architecture, and design of distributed, event-driven systems (Java/Python) Evolve scalable microservices and API-first platforms aligned to enterprise strategy Architect high-throughput data systems integrating SQL/NoSQL, streaming, and caching technologies Drive performance, resiliency, observability, and production excellence Provide full-stack technical leadership across backend and frontend (Angular/React) Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and executable roadmaps Manage stakeholders and lead global teams to deliver against strategic milestones Lead adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices (Copilot, Claude, Windsurf, etc.) Design safe and scalable LLM integration patterns (prompt engineering, structured outputs, streaming, tool/function calling) Architect multi-step or agent-based workflows (e.g., LangChain, Google ADK or equivalent) Define shared prompts, agent contracts, and AI governance standards across teams Guide teams in translating ambiguous problems into structured, AI-augmentable execution plans What you'll bring B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). 7+ years of progressive software engineering experience with proven leadership of teams or major platforms Strong expertise in Java, Python, and distributed systems architecture Experience designing highly available, real-time enterprise systems Deep understanding of APIs, microservices, data modeling, and scalability patterns Experience with SQL, NoSQL, and streaming technologies (e.g., distributed event streaming and messaging platforms, Redis) Exposure to cloud-native and DevOps practices (Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, CI/CD) Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional influence skills Demonstrated experience integrating AI into engineering workflows and production platforms Nice to Have Experience with distributed event streaming and messaging platforms, Redis, or other distributed systems technologies Cloud-native experience (Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, Enterprise-grade container orchestration platform supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Azure/AWS/GCP) Exposure to CI/CD and observability tooling Interest in financial systems, reporting platforms, or investment processes
  
  
**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
