title: Carrot: Lead Product Management
description:
Full-Time
  
  

* Full-Time
* Anywhere
* Posted 1 day ago

**Headquarters:**
Remote
  
  
****About Carrot:****
Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot’s comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.
  
  
Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company’s ‘Most Innovative Companies’ and CNBC’s ‘100 Barrier Breaking Startups’. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Carrot is seeking a Lead, Product Management to help shape and scale one of our core product areas as Carrot’s platform continues to grow. In this role, you’ll operate as a strategic driver within the Product organization — owning a significant portion of the product roadmap, setting direction for cross-functional initiatives, and raising the bar for product craft across the team.
  
  
This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who has already demonstrated strong product judgment and is ready to take on greater scope: shaping strategy, mentoring other product managers, and partnering directly with senior leadership on the initiatives that matter most to our members and business.
  
  
If you’re energized by solving ambiguous, high-stakes problems and want to help define how Carrot builds products at scale, this role is for you!
  
  
****What You’ll Own****
In this role, you will:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for a key product area, translating company priorities into a clear, prioritized plan of execution
* Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial partners around a shared vision and set of goals
* Serve as a thought partner and informal mentor to other Product Managers, helping raise the bar on product process, discovery, and craft across the team
* Make and communicate high-judgment prioritization decisions, balancing member experience, business impact, and technical feasibility
* Partner directly with senior product and cross-functional leadership to shape quarterly and annual product strategy
* Identify and address systemic gaps in process, tooling, or team practices that limit the Product team’s effectiveness
* Represent the Product team in executive and cross-functional forums, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, and outcomes

****What Success Looks Like****
In your first 12–18 months, you will have:
  
  

* Delivered a body of work that measurably improved member outcomes, engagement, or business performance within your product area
* Built trusted, effective working relationships with cross-functional leaders across Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial/Customer Success
* Established yourself as a go-to product thought leader, with other PMs seeking out your input on strategy and process
* Shaped or improved a core product process (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization) that is now used more broadly across the team
* Successfully led at least one significant, ambiguous, cross-functional initiative from concept through launch

****About You****
You likely have:
  
  

* 5+ years of product management experience, including time at a fast-growing technology company; healthcare or digital health experience is a plus
* A track record of owning complex, cross-functional product initiatives from strategy through execution
* Strong product sense and the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints in your decision-making
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align both peers and senior leadership
* Experience mentoring or informally guiding less-experienced product managers

**Nice to Have**
**⭐**
While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:
  
  

* Experience in fertility, family-building, or broader digital health benefits
* Experience partnering with Clinical or Legal teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive products
* Familiarity with AI-enabled product features or workflows
* Experience operating in a fully distributed, remote-first organization

**Why This Role Matters**
As Carrot continues to scale, our Product team needs leaders who can operate with both strategic clarity and hands-on execution. This Lead, Product Management role is central to that effort — helping ensure our roadmap reflects the right priorities, our cross-functional partners are aligned, and our product practices scale sustainably as the team grows.
  
  
This is an opportunity to have an outsized impact: shaping not just a single product area, but the way Carrot’s Product organization operates as it matures.
  
  
**Interview Process**
We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.
  
  
**For This Role, Candidates Can Expect:**

* Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
* Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
* Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
* Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
* Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.
  
  
**Why Candidates Join Carrot**
Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.
  
  
**Highlights Include:**

* A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
* A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
* Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
* Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
* The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

****Compensation:****
Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. title: R&D Manager Hair Color India
description:
**About this Position**
The Asia Hair Color R&D team is dedicated to delivering innovative, high-quality hair color solutions that enhance consumer confidence and beauty. Guided by our slogan, “Let’s Color the World Together,” we drive product innovation and technical excellence across the region. This role is responsible for leading end-to-end formulation development activities, ensuring that the current and future needs of business units are effectively translated into short-, medium-, and long-term technical programs. The position plays a key role in developing innovative, consumer-focused hair color products that meet performance, quality, and market requirements while supporting business growth objectives.
  
  
**What You´ll Do**

* Lead and execute New Product Development (NPD) projects for the Hair Coloration portfolio, ensuring timely delivery, product quality, and successful commercialization, with a primary focus on the Indian market and consumer needs.
* Define technical timelines, conduct risk assessments, align with regional and global R&D teams, and drive cost-efficient product development locally and globally.
* Provide technical support for the Hair Coloration business portfolio, partnering with Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, and Quality teams to address product-related queries, troubleshoot issues, and ensure consistent product performance and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure regulatory compliance by collaborating with regulatory teams on product notifications, registrations, and adherence to local and global regulations and industry standards.
* Support commercial and operational activities through technical claims substantiation, product demonstrations, content development, technical training for Sales, Supply Chain, and export markets, and technical guidance to local contract manufacturers to ensure quality and manufacturing excellence.
* Act as the key R&D liaison for India, serving as the single point of contact between the regional R&D organization and local stakeholders, including Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and other cross-functional teams, to drive effective communication and business support across the Hair Coloration portfolio.

**What makes you a good fit**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Biology, or a related scientific discipline is required. A Ph.D. is considered an advantage.
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Research & Development, preferably within the hair color, personal care, cosmetics, consumer goods, or related industries, with hands-on experience in formulation development and product innovation.
* Strong understanding of product development processes, raw materials, regulatory requirements, quality standards, and commercialization activities.
* Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in additional languages will be considered an advantage, particularly in supporting regional and global collaboration.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional and multicultural teams, collaborating with R&D, Marketing, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and Manufacturing stakeholders.

**Some perks of joining Henkel**

* Diverse national and international growth opportunities
* Global wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs
* Gender-neutral parental leave for a minimum of 8 weeks
* Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares
* Best-in-class Group Medical Insurance policy covering employee, spouse and up to 2 children
* Competitive accident and term life policies for up to 3 times annual gross salary
* Progressive OPD policy of INR 30,000 for employee, spouse and up to 2 children

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We look for a diverse team of individuals who possess different backgrounds, experiences, personalities and mindsets.

title: AI Programme Engagement and Delivery - Vice President
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
  
  
Citi is looking for a Vice President, AI Programme Engagement & Delivery to join the Client Organisation AI Lead team — a group that directly supports revenue growth managing Credit, Marketing, Research, Client Delivery, and Ventures on behalf of Citi's businesses. In this role, you will coordinate and support the end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives, ensuring governance, stakeholder alignment, and programme reporting operate to the highest standard. Sitting at the intersection of project management, governance, technology, and artificial intelligence, this position offers significant exposure to senior leadership and meaningful contribution to Citi's AI transformation agenda.
  
  
**What We Offer:**
Joining Citi's Client Organisation AI Lead team means stepping into one of the most strategically significant programmes in global banking today. You will be part of a high-performing central team that directly shapes how AI is adopted and embedded across Citi's business activities — with real visibility, real influence, and real career momentum.
  
  

* Direct exposure to Citi's AI operating model and the opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI adoption in financial services, developing a highly sought-after skillset in a rapidly evolving field.
* Regular interaction with and visibility to senior leaders across the Client Organisation, the Office of AI, and broader Citi leadership.
* A platform for significant career growth, with the ability to build expertise across programme delivery, controls, analytics, and AI governance in a complex global organisation.
* Hybrid working arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, supporting a sustainable and productive work-life balance.
* Access to Citi's global learning and development resources, enabling continued professional growth across technical, leadership, and domain skills.
* Competitive financial wellbeing benefits and a comprehensive package aligned to your seniority and contribution.
* A collaborative, performance-driven team environment where your work has measurable impact on Citi's strategic AI agenda.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

* Coordinate the day-to-day delivery of the AI programme, managing multiple workstreams simultaneously and ensuring milestones are met on time and to a high standard.
* Organise governance practicalities of the AI Lead team, including tracking actions, maintaining decision logs, and ensuring controls documentation is accurate and up to date.
* Build and sustain trusted relationships with stakeholders across business, technology, risk, and control functions, keeping all parties aligned on programme status, priorities, and key decisions.
* Prepare and deliver clear, concise reporting on programme progress, issues, and risks to audiences ranging from working-level teams to senior management.
* Provide analytical support including data analysis, visualisation, and presentation-quality reports that inform decision-making at programme level – driving data informed decision making.
* Monitor adherence to relevant policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, and support the implementation of business-specific controls across the programme.
* Translate business needs into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that teams can act on directly.

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* Five to ten years of experience in programme delivery, business management, PMO, or controls within the financial services industry.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced, complex environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to produce clear, impactful presentations and reports for senior audiences.
* Skilled in data analysis and visualisation, with a strong analytical and evidence-based approach to problem-solving.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication, with experience engaging stakeholders from junior analysts through to senior management.
* Working knowledge of governance frameworks, internal controls, and documentation standards within financial services.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Finance, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience supporting cross-functional programmes within a large-scale, global organisation.
* Experience supporting AI, data, or technology initiatives within a complex, cross-functional organisation
* Familiarity with AI or machine learning concepts at a foundational level, with an interest in how these technologies are applied within financial services.
* Awareness of enterprise applications and business process frameworks relevant to financial services operations.
* Experience negotiating with or managing relationships with external parties such as vendors or third-party programme partners.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
* MBA or CFA or CA preferred

Apply now to bring your programme delivery expertise to one of the most impactful AI initiatives in global financial services — and help shape the future of Citi's client capabilities.

title: Manager - Programming Strategy and Insights (Quantitative), Hindi Movies
description:
**MANAGER – PROGRAMMING STRATEGY & INSIGHTS (QUANTITATIVE), HINDI MOVIES**
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
At JioStar, content decisions are no longer driven by instinct alone. They are powered by audience intelligence, behavioral insights, and data-led experimentation at scale.
  
  
We are looking for a high-calibre strategy and analytics professional to help shape the future of programming for Hindi Movies. This role sits at the intersection of consumer insights, business strategy, content performance and monetization; leveraging large-scale viewership data to influence what millions watch across TV.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role with a direct impact on viewership growth, advertising performance, and programming strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Audience Strategy & Consumer Intelligence**

* Translate audience and consumption data into strategic recommendations that drive viewership growth across channels
* Analyze viewership trends, consumer cohorts, market shifts and competitive programming landscapes to uncover growth opportunities.
* Drive data-led recommendations on scheduling, slot optimization, and programming interventions.
* Identify macro trends, seasonality, festivals, and external factors influencing audience behavior and consumption patterns.

**Growth, Monetization & Business Impact**

* Partner with Programming and Revenue teams to optimize audience delivery, advertising yield and content monetization.
* Recommend data-backed scheduling and inventory strategies to improve GRP performance while enhancing viewer experience.
* Support critical business moments including major sporting events, World television premieres and competitive programming periods through predictive analysis and strategic interventions.
* Balance consumer engagement goals with commercial outcomes to drive sustainable business impact.

**Strategic Business Partnering**

* Collaborate with senior stakeholders across Programming, Sales, Distribution, and Business teams to influence decision-making.
* Translate complex analytics into clear, compelling business narratives for leadership teams.
* Act as a strategic advisor by identifying risks, opportunities, and performance levers in a fast-paced environment.

title: Product Owner
description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
  
  
The Product Owner partners closely with
**Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams**
to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
**clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact**
in a complex, enterprise data environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership & Accountability**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Business Alignment**

* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.

**Backlog, Roadmap & Delivery Management**

* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

**Governance, Quality & Standards**

* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:

+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.

**Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.

**Why This Role Matters**
The Product Owner is a
**critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model**
, ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

title: Product Manager
description:
Discover & define. Talk to users, understand real workflows, identify pain points, and convert ambiguous asks into clear problem statements and requirements.

Shape solutions. Write crisp PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, edge cases, and MVP scopes. Partner closely with UI/UX.

Prioritize. Maintain the backlog and recommend priorities using user impact, business impact, effort, urgency, and strategic value.

Drive delivery. Work with engineering through development, clarify decisions, review builds, test workflows, and ensure release readiness.

Own adoption. Plan launches, demos, training, release communication, and follow-up improvements to drive user adoption.

Measure & improve. Track usage and adoption, identify drop-offs or friction, and translate data and feedback into product improvements.

AI-first product thinking. Use AI tools and LLM APIs throughout discovery and delivery to test ideas quickly, improve workflows, and identify high-value AI product opportunities.

AI PRDs. Define expected model behavior, inputs/outputs, guardrails, fallbacks, edge cases, success metrics, and human-in-the-loop requirements for AI features.

AI prototyping. Build fast proofs of concept using LLMs, agents, APIs, no-code/low-code tools, and AI-assisted coding before committing significant engineering effort.

AI evals. Create representative test cases and evaluation criteria for quality, relevance, reliability, latency, cost, and failure modes; use results to iterate before and after launch.

They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

title: Sr. Business Innovation Manager (Hyderabad/Bangalore/Mumbai)
description:
**Department:**
Finance
  
  
**Location:**
APAC-India-Mumbai
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Business Innovation to join Align's New Business Models & Services team in APAC. This is neither a sales role nor a pure strategy role. It’s a “build-and-execute” position for someone who wants to create with urgency, can influence without authority, and gets things done without a detailed brief. Fintech fluency is a must.
  
  
This is a newly created role sitting in a small, high-visibility team in the CFO organization, tasked with transforming how Align goes to market through innovative business models, services and solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director, New Business Models & Services APAC, this role sits as a core member of the India commercial leadership team.
  
  
You will be a key connector between the India market needs and our global Business Model Innovation strategy. Working closely with Align's local commercial leaders and building close partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal, you will diagnose growth blockers and design, test, and scale solutions that address them, translating market insight into scalable, revenue-generating programs. You will tweak and test existing solutions as well as identify and incubate new opportunities specific to India
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Embed yourself with the commercial team. Build trusted relationships. Become the person local leadership calls when they want to think about a problem differently.
* Run structured discovery to surface growth blockers.
* Understand existing innovation programs & priorities and figure out what they need to look like in India.
* Build business cases, develop business plans, and evaluate new business opportunities for investment by the organization.
* Design and run pilots. Iterate fast. Know when to kill something and when to double down.
* Execute with urgency. Turn validated ideas into live programs, working across internal teams and external partners to make sure what gets built gets adopted.
* Source, evaluate and manage third-party partners. Negotiate agreements. Own the relationships.
* Develop the internal materials (playbooks, training, commercial enablement) that will allow the local teams to adopt and deploy what’s been proven.
* Feed learnings back into the global innovation team so that what works in one market can be adapted and scaled elsewhere.

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* Strong business acumen, judgment, and maturity: you think naturally in terms of unit economics, incentive structures, and value exchange, not just features and benefits.
* Meaningful fintech experience: at least 3 years of hands-on experience in consumer lending, BNPL, payments, healthcare financing, or adjacent fintech domains. You understand how financing products are structured from both the provider and lender side, how to evaluate and negotiate with financial partners, and how to design solutions that work within the regulatory and consumer credit frameworks of India.
* Experience with iterative product or solution design: You know how to run a structured pilot, what good validation looks like, and how to make go/no-go decisions based on imperfect information.
* Ability to context-switch easily: One week you're deep in a fintech partnership negotiation, the next you're thinking of systems integrations or designing new revenue models.
* Soft power and collaboration skills: You have a track record of getting things done through your credibility, your relationships, and your ability to make people want to work with you.
* Comfort with ambiguity and independent working: This team is small, and the mandate is broad. You need to be able to prioritize and create structure where there isn't any.
* Affinity for AI: you use AI tools as a practical part of how you work: research, analysis, synthesis and building materials. You keep pushing the boundaries of how it can make you (and the company) more effective.
* Strong project management, organizational, and analytical skills:Ability to manage budget, resources and multiple workstreams simultaneously.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE**

* 10+ years of commercial / product management / consulting experience, of which at least 3 years in fintech, with a track record of building or scaling something (a product, a program, a market), not just executing a playbook.
* Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA or equivalent a plus but not required if the experience speaks for itself.

***Nice to Have***

* Experience in medtech, healthtech or any other regulated industry, in particular working within or alongside a DSO or multi-site dental or healthcare group.
* SaaS, platform or API product management experience, particularly relevant for systems integration work.
* Experience working in an overlay or matrix organization where influence without authority is the primary operating model.

title: Senior Manager/ Senior Advisor/ Consultant- Membership Portal Member Engagement
description:
**1. Position overview**

**Senior Manager/ Senior Advisor/ Consultant- Membership Portal and Member Engagement**
is accountable for the IC3 membership portal, the primary channel through which members receive their membership value. The role owns the portal's technology, information architecture, content program, operational upkeep and member engagement, serving schools and counsellors, universities, and organisations (NGOs, NFPs & corporates in education/ career counseling)

**2. Key responsibilities Indicative time allocation is shown against each area. Member engagement carries the largest share, reflecting its priority.**

**2.1 Platform and technology management (20%)**

* Serve as product owner for the membership portal, maintaining a prioritised feature backlog and a quarterly release plan.
* Manage the technology vendor or internal developers against agreed service levels, including uptime, defect resolution and change requests.
* Oversee integrations with payments, email, CRM etc.

**2.2 Information architecture and user experience (15%)**

* Define and maintain the portal structure, navigation and dedicated areas for each stakeholder group.
* Ensure a mobile-first experience, with pages that load reliably on lower-bandwidth connections (if applicable).
* Apply accessibility and brand standards consistently across all pages and templates.
* Use analytics and member feedback to run at least one usability improvement per quarter.

**2.3 Content quality (25%)**

* Own a 12-month content calendar covering all three stakeholder groups, reviewed monthly.
* Publish new content at least weekly, including resources, toolkits, webinar recordings, event updates, research and member news.
* Source content from IC3 programs, conferences, partner universities, member institutions, and the content committee and manage approvals and attributions.
* Maintain a content governance policy covering ownership, review dates, archiving and quality standards.

**2.4 Operations and maintenance (10%)**

* Monitor portal health weekly, including broken links, login issues, page performance and security updates.
* Maintain accurate member records, renewal dates and access rights in coordination.
* Manage the member helpdesk for portal queries, responding within two business days.
* Ensure compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and IC3 data policies, including consent and data retention.
* Retire or refresh outdated content in a quarterly content audit.

**2.5 Member engagement (25%)**

* Design structured onboarding journeys so that every new member activates core benefits within 30 days.
* Run a recurring engagement programme of newsletters, webinars, discussion forums, polls, member spotlights and recognition.
* Segment members by type, tier and activity, and tailor communication accordingly.
* Identify inactive members through usage data and run re-engagement campaigns ahead of renewal.
* Collect member feedback through surveys at least twice a year and report findings with recommended actions.
* Build communities of practice, for example among counsellors in the same city or universities recruiting from India.

**2.6 Contribution to membership growth (5%, secondary)**

Outreach and conversion are not primary responsibilities of this role. The incumbent will support the membership team by:

* Providing portal content, case studies and demo access for outreach campaigns.
* Sharing engagement and usage insights that inform renewal and acquisition strategy.

**3. Strategic priorities for the first 12 months**

The incumbent is expected to advance the following priorities.

* **Run the portal on data.**
   Establish an engagement dashboard within the first 90 days and use it to steer content, renewals and upgrades.
* **Build for scale.**
   Prepare processes, content and support to serve approximately 4,000 member institutions, the 12-month target in the membership plan.

4.
**Qualifications and competencies**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; a qualification in instructional design, educational content design, or career & college counseling is an advantage.
* 4 to 7 years of experience managing a learning portal or online community, including at least 2 years in an ownership role.
* Hands-on proficiency with content management or membership platforms (for example WordPress, a membership plugin, or a learning management system). Coding is not required.
* Experience managing technology vendors, defining requirements and running user acceptance testing.
* Working knowledge of web analytics, email platforms and CRM tools.
* Excellent written English and strong editorial judgement.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and deliver a content calendar on schedule.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the education sector, particularly school counseling, university admissions or international education.
* Familiarity with K-12 and the higher education landscape.

**Core competencies**

* Member-centric mindset and a service orientation.
* Analytical thinking and data-informed decision making.
* Attention to detail and quality.
* Stakeholder management across internal teams and external partners.
* Initiative, ownership and the ability to work with minimal supervision.

**5. Key performance indicators**

* Member onboarding
* Engagments
* Content quality & stakeholder relevance
* Member satisfaction & Renewals
* Service

**About Scale100x.ai**

Scale100x.ai is the world's first AI-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner expansion. Built by the founders of Expertrons, we are serial entrepreneurs and IIT Bombay alumni who have built and exited ventures and scaled 300+ franchise networks across industries.

We partner with high-potential brands to:

* Build 100+ offline outlets/partners per year
* Use AI agents to supercharge sales and marketing execution
* Improve profitability through data-driven operations
* Support fundraising, investor relations and IPO readiness

In the last year we've driven scale for brands across EV, F&B, Salon, Retail, EdTech, Play Areas and more, including helping one brand close a $5.4M Series A. Our sales engine runs on high-volume, WhatsApp-first lead flow, and we are rebuilding it to be AI-native.

**The Role**

We are moving from LeadSquared to an AI-native CRM and want to put AI agents at the center of how we sell, follow up, onboard and report. You will own that transformation end to end: choosing the platform, migrating without losing a single lead, and building the agents and automations that run on top of it, across our different verticals.

This is a builder's role. You will work directly with the founders, and you should be as comfortable in a CRM admin panel or an n8n workflow as in a leadership review.

**What You'll Own**

**1. CRM selection and migration (LeadSquared → AI-native CRM)**

* Evaluate AI-native CRM options against our needs (cost, WhatsApp and telephony support, agent capabilities, integrations) and make a clear recommendation.
* Plan and run the migration: data cleanup and mapping, pipeline redesign, integrations, cutover and parallel run.
* Drive team adoption so that data quality and usage improve after the switch, not just the tooling.

**2. AI agents and automation across verticals**

* Map the lead-to-onboarding journey (enquiry, qualification, commercials, agreement, onboarding) and identify what agents can own and where a human must stay in the loop.
* Build and deploy agents and automations for lead qualification, follow-ups, call summaries, CRM updates, reminders and reporting.
* Adapt and reuse these workflows across verticals such as EV, F&B, Salon, Retail and EdTech, and over time package them for client brands.
* Measure every automation on time saved, response time and conversion impact.

**3. Integrations and systems**

* Connect the CRM with WhatsApp Business API, telephony/IVR, e-sign, email, finance and internal tools using APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code platforms.
* Own reliability: monitoring, fallbacks and documentation.

**4. Analytics and ROI**

* Build dashboards for pipeline health, leakage by stage, agent performance and revenue outcomes.
* Build the business case for each initiative and report results to the founders.

**5. Ownership and execution**

* Run projects from problem definition to rollout with clear milestones and accountability.
* Work with sales, operations, product and tech teams, and flag risks and dependencies early.

**Must-Haves**

* 5+ years in CRM implementation, business systems, revenue operations, product operations or automation-led roles.
* Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a CRM (LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar), including at least one full data migration and cutover.
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-based automations in production. Please share a workflow you built and its outcome.
* Fluency with APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar).
* Experience integrating WhatsApp Business API and telephony/IVR into a sales workflow.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define metrics, build dashboards and quantify ROI.
* Ability to work independently with founders and cross-functional teams, with clear written and verbal communication.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with AI-native CRM platforms.
* Background in high-volume, lead-driven businesses such as franchising, edtech, real estate or D2C.
* Exposure to product strategy or product operations, and to financial modelling.
* Startup, consulting or SaaS experience.

**What We Expect**

* **Ownership:**
  you drive initiatives without continuous supervision.
* **Execution:**
  you move from recommendation to live implementation.
* **Business sense:**
  you connect every system and automation to a measurable outcome.
* **Structured problem-solving:**
  you frame the problem, test quickly and iterate.

**Who Should Apply**

Builders from CRM, revenue operations, automation, product operations or business systems backgrounds who have shipped real migrations and real automations, and want to do it at the intersection of AI, growth and franchising.

title: Manager – Customer Experience
description:
* Customer Experience Strategy & Economics
* Build and own the CX scorecard beyond NPS: OTIF (on-time-in-full), CPKO, resolution speed, escalation

rate, repeat-purchase behavior by customer tier — and tie every one of them to a revenue or retention
  
  
number leadership can act on.
  
  

* Quantify the cost and reorder impact of every major CX failure mode (damaged/missing items, delivery

issues, refund delays) and use it to prioritize fixes by rupee impact, not by ticket volume.
  
  

* Own resolution-policy decisions (e.g., redispatch vs. refund) with hard data on which choice actually

keeps a customer.
  
  
Data-Driven Program Management
  
  

* Be comfortable pulling and validating your own data (SQL, BigQuery or equivalent) rather than waiting

on a dashboard someone else maintains.
  
  

* Run root-cause analysis that survives scrutiny — right-sized samples, corrected logic, honest callouts

when two systems disagree, and a clear line between “verified” and “a model.”
  
  

* Segment customers by lifetime value and behavior (tiers, first-time vs. repeat, state/geography) to find

where the highest-leverage interventions are, not just the loudest complaints.
  
  

* AI &Automation
* Own the chatbot/IVR stack end to end: containment rate, cost per conversation, and — critically —

instrument what today isn't measured (does “closed” actually mean “resolved”?).
  
  

* Identify and build the next generation of AI-driven CX: proactive delivery-risk alerts, automated win-

back campaigns for lapsing customers, smarter self-serve flows — always backed by a quantified
  
  
opportunity size.
  
  

* Evaluate build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (chat, IVR, call-scoring platforms) on total cost and actual

capability, not the sales deck.
  
  
Team & Operating Model
  
  

* Build and lead a small, accountable team across three areas: CX Tools & Vendor Management, CX

Metrics & Voice of Customer, and Data & Automation.
  
  

* Replace informal, single-point-of-failure ownership with clear RACI, documented processes, and a team

that can operate without you in the room.
  
  

* Run structured win-back and retention initiatives (e.g., outbound campaigns for customers who've gone

quiet at 90/180 days) with proper reason-code diagnosis, not just reminder blasts.
  
  

* Voice of the Customer
* Personally read and act on customer feedback — the good, the near-miss, and the genuinely angry.

Every customer who takes the time to write in is a free, high-signal data point; treat it that way.
  
  

* Turn qualitative complaints into structured, quantified problems the business can prioritize.

This is an individual contributor role with end to end ownership of the B2B logistics roadmap and its business impact. You will work closely with backend engineering, the SAP team, operations, and logistics partners to deliver it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**B2B Logistics Product Ownership**

* Own the product roadmap for B2B logistics flows, including customer orders, stock transfers between locations, and B2B returns, prioritised by business impact.
* Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
* Lead initiatives such as automatic carrier enablement for B2B shipments and the CPG forward and returns flow, from problem definition to rollout and adoption.
* Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
* Maintain a separate B2B layer for carrier and logistics partner integrations, and coordinate with the B2C logistics owner on anything shared.

**Delivery Reliability and Network Performance**

* Own delivery promise reliability for B2B orders, defining and tracking the metrics that show whether commitments to customers are met.
* Improve network cost, capacity, and delivery performance across carriers and lanes through structured product changes.
* Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground and define improvements that scale.

**Compliance and ERP (SAP)**

* Own B2B compliance flows such as e-way bills and invoicing, and keep them aligned with SAP.
* Support integration and data consistency between the warehouse systems, logistics partners, and SAP for sales, stock movement, and returns.
* Work with engineering, finance, and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.

**Governance, Analytics, and Stakeholders**

* Drive operations governance and risk reduction by defining clear processes, escalation paths, and checks that prevent repeat failures.
* Use logistics data and dashboards to track performance, surface insights, and drive data-informed product decisions.
* Delegate and escalate effectively, and push repeatable manual work toward automation.
* Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to operations, business, and engineering stakeholders.

**Must-Have Skills And Requirements**

* 1+ years of experience in a product, analytics, or supply-chain technology role.
* BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
* Strong product fundamentals, including the ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, prioritise by impact, and work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Working understanding of ERP systems such as SAP and how sales, invoicing, and compliance data flow through them.
* Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, operations, and finance teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to logistics, 3PL, carrier management, or B2B supply chain operations.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
* Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
* Familiarity with e-way bill and GST compliance in the Indian supply chain context.
* Exposure to Warehouse Management Systems or quick-commerce operations.

**What You Will Gain**

* End to end ownership of the B2B logistics charter, from roadmap to measurable impact.
* A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
* Deep exposure to carrier integrations, compliance flows, and SAP across a high-volume e-commerce supply chain.
* A clear growth path from Associate Product Manager toward a full Product Manager role.

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: APM/PM - FMCG Supply & Demand Planning
description:

modern trade, e-commerce and quick commerce. To scale them, we need a planning system that puts

supply planning for our FMCG business.
  
  
**This is a high-impact, zero-to-one role.**

products, and own the execution and scale-up of our demand planning, S&OP and supply
  
  
planning products.
  
  

* Together, you'll replace spreadsheet-based planning with connected demand and supply

planning products that span our own plants and contract manufacturers.
  
  

* Your products will directly drive forecast accuracy, product availability across channels,

inventory efficiency and working capital, with a tangible impact on the company's bottom line
  
  
and on how fast our brands can grow.

title: Technology Product Manager – Design, Construction, Quality, Safety & Strategy
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About Godrej Industries Group (GIG)**
At the Godrej Industries Group, we serve over 1.4 billion people globally through a diverse portfolio of businesses, united by our purpose of Crafting tomorrow. With revenues of USD 7.2 billion in FY26 and a market capitalisation of USD 19 billion as of 31 March 2026, we operate across FMCG, real estate, financial services, agriculture, and chemicals. We are the leading player in India across several business categories, including residential real estate, animal feed, crude palm oil, oleochemicals, household insecticides, hair colour, and air care.
  
  
We are committed to building a more sustainable future through our Good & Green programme, with ambitions of net-zero operations by 2035 and responsible supply chains by 2047. In 2025, Godrej Consumer Products and Godrej Properties were both ranked number one globally in their respective categories on the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Sustainability Indices.
  
  
www.godrejindustries.com
  
  
**About Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)**
At Godrej Properties, part of the Godrej Industries Group, we are driven by a singular purpose: crafting joy. Over 100,000 families have found a home with us, making us India’s largest residential developer by both value and volume of homes sold.
  
  
Our approach is anchored in thoughtful design, sustainability, thriving communities, and uncompromising quality. As of December 2025, we were ranked the number one real estate company worldwide on both the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Sustainability Indices and the Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark.
  
  
www.godrejproperties.com
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Domain Champion & Front Door for Technology**

* Act as the single accountable point of contact for all technology applications, platforms and tools within Design, Construction, Quality, Safety & Strategy.
* Build deep domain and technical knowledge of the applications, integrations and data flows supporting the function.
* Own and maintain the application landscape map, roadmap and lifecycle plan for the domain.
* Serve as the trusted technology advisor to the function head and business stakeholders in the domain.

**Demand Management & Prioritisation**

* Manage the end-to-end demand funnel for the domain — intake, qualification, business case validation and prioritisation.
* Work with business stakeholders to translate requirements into clear, prioritised product/technology backlogs.
* Balance run-the-business (support, enhancements) and change-the-business (new initiatives) demand within capacity constraints.
* Facilitate governance forums to align stakeholders on priority calls and trade-offs.

**Delivery Orchestration & Quality**

* Orchestrate delivery across internal teams, vendors/SIs and platform teams to ensure committed timelines and quality are met.
* Track delivery milestones, dependencies and blockers, and drive resolution with delivery teams.
* Ensure adherence to defined SDLC, testing, security, UAT and release management standards prior to go-live.
* Own post-go-live stabilisation, adoption tracking and continuous improvement of solutions in the domain.

**Design, Construction, Quality, Safety & Strategy**

* Own the technology roadmap for design management (BIM/CAD collaboration), construction management, site progress monitoring, quality and safety (EHS) systems and strategic/business planning tools.
* Partner with Design, Construction, Quality, Safety and Strategy leadership to digitise project execution, quality audits and safety compliance workflows.
* Ensure integration between design, construction management, quality/safety and enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, project management platforms) for real-time project visibility.
* Drive adoption of site digitisation tools (e.g., drones, IoT sensors, mobile inspection apps) to improve construction quality and safety outcomes.
* Support strategy teams with technology-enabled planning, MIS and decision-support tools.

**Escalation Management**

* Serve as the first point of escalation for technical/application failures, outages or performance issues impacting the domain.
* Drive root-cause analysis with technical teams and ensure timely resolution and permanent fixes.
* Maintain a risk and issue log for the domain, and proactively flag risks before they impact business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management, Communication & Governance**

* Own and publish regular dashboards/status reports on demand, delivery progress, risks and issues to function heads and leadership.
* Run periodic governance reviews (steering committees, sprint reviews, monthly business reviews) with key stakeholders.
* Manage dependencies across other domains, enterprise technology teams (infrastructure, security, data, ERP) and external vendors.

Build strong working relationships with business leaders to ensure technology is seen as a trusted enabler of business outcomes.
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline (mandatory).
* MBA or equivalent management qualification is preferred from a premier B-school.

**Experience**

* 8–10 years of experience, including experience leading technology delivery for design/construction/quality/safety functions, with proven stakeholder and vendor management at a leadership level.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; ability to influence business and technical audiences.
* Sound understanding of product management, agile delivery and vendor/SI management practices.
* Ability to manage a demand funnel and prioritise competing requirements under constraint.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable driving root-cause analysis on technical issues.
* Experience with dashboarding/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Jira, Confluence) for governance reporting.
* Real estate or D2C/BFSI domain exposure is an advantage.

**Work Experience**
8–10 years
  
  
**Benefits**
**Be an equal parent**
Childcare benefits for the birthing parent, commissioning parent (in case of surrogacy) or adoptive parent, and their partners
  
  

* 6 months of paid leave for primary caregivers, flexible work options on return for primary caregivers
* 2 months paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Caregiver travel for primary caregivers to bring a caregiver and children under a year old, on work travel

Coverage for childbirth and fertility treatment
  
  
**No place for discrimination at Godrej**

* Gender-neutral anti-harassment policy
* Same sex partner benefits at par with married spouses
* Coverage for gender reassignment surgery and hormone replacement therapy
* Community partnerships and advocacy
* Persons with Disability (PwD) care

**We Are Selfish About Your Wellness**

* Comprehensive health insurance plans, as well as accident coverage for you and your family, with top-up options
* Elder care for those who might need to extend support to senior family members
* Preventative healthcare support
* Outpatient Department (OPD) coverage, including vaccinations, dental, vision, etc.
* Uncapped sick leave
* Flexible work options, including remote working and part-time work
* Mental wellness and self-care programmes, resources and counselling

**Celebrating wins, the Godrej Way**

* Structured recognition platforms for individual, team and business-level achievements
* Digital and offline instant recognition platforms.

**An inclusive Godrej**
Before you go, there is something important we want to highlight. There is no place for discrimination at Godrej. Diversity is the philosophy of who we are as a company. And it has been over a century. It’s not just in our DNA and nice to do. Being more diverse - especially having our team members reflect the diversity of our businesses and communities - helps us innovate better and grow faster. We hope this resonates with you.
  
  
We take pride in being an equal opportunities employer. We recognise merit and encourage diversity. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination on the basis of nationality, race, colour, religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or marital status and ensure equal opportunities for all our team members.
  
  
If this sounds like a role for you, apply now!
  
  
We look forward to meeting you.

title: Senior Manager - Fixed Income, Alternatives and Structured Products
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Vice President, Product Manager - Fixed Income, Structured Products & Alternatives**
**Division:**
International Wealth & Premier Banking – Wealth Management
  
  
**Entity:**
HSBC India
  
  
**Role purpose**
The role will lead the investment product strategy for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments across HSBC India’s wealth business.
  
  
The role will translate market opportunities, client needs and regulatory developments into a compelling, commercially viable and well-governed product shelf. This means ensuring that products are relevant for clients, practical for relationship managers to distribute and sustainable for the bank.
  
  
Working closely with Markets, Investment Advisory, Risk, Compliance, Legal and regional and global Wealth teams, the role will provide end-to-end ownership of product strategy, governance, commercialization and lifecycle management.
  
  
**Key Priorities Include**

* Accelerating the growth of Fixed Income Products, Alternative Investments and Structured Products.
* Integrating GIFT City offerings into the core investment proposition.
* Establishing Fixed Income as a central component of every relevant advisory conversation.
* Maintaining a high standard of product governance, suitability and risk management.
* The successful candidate will combine deep investment expertise with commercial judgement, disciplined execution and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product strategy and shelf architecture
* Define and execute the product strategy for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments across HSBC India’s wealth segments.
* Own the frameworks for product due diligence, approval, whitelisting, shelf sizing, review and retirement.
* Assess the shelf regularly to identify product gaps, client suitability considerations and opportunities to improve portfolio coverage.
* Maintain the right balance between product breadth, client relevance, governance requirements and commercial viability.
* Ensure the shelf reflects the needs and risk profiles of different client segments.
* Fixed Income
* Build and strengthen the Fixed Income proposition across government securities, corporate bonds and structured credit.
* Translate views on interest rates, yield curves and credit cycles into practical investment solutions.
* Develop propositions that support income generation, yield enhancement, diversification and capital preservation.
* Improve product availability, pricing, execution and servicing so that Fixed Income can be incorporated naturally into client portfolios.
* Partner with Investment Advisory and distribution teams to strengthen the role of Fixed Income in portfolio construction and client conversations.
* Structured Products
* Develop structured investment solutions designed to provide yield enhancement, capital protection or targeted market exposure.
* Work with Structuring, Treasury and Markets teams to create products aligned to defined client segments and investment objectives
* Evaluate underlying assets, payoff structures, liquidity, counterparty exposure and other relevant risks.
* Maintain a robust and transparent product pipeline, supported by appropriate approvals and governance.
* Ensure product documentation, client communication and distribution materials clearly explain features, risks and expected outcomes.
* Alternative Investments
* Grow the Alternative Investments shelf across Portfolio Management Services, Alternative Investment Funds and private-market strategies.
* Identify and assess investment managers based on track record, investment philosophy, process, risk management, governance and operational capability.
* Connect onshore and GIFT City alternatives propositions to provide clients with differentiated and complementary investment opportunities.
* Manage capacity, liquidity, operational and concentration considerations across the alternatives range.
* Increase adoption through relationship-manager engagement, targeted campaigns, training and clear investment narratives.
* Work with regional and global teams to identify relevant strategies and share best practice.
* Product lifecycle and commercialization
* Take investment themes and product opportunities from initial concept through business case, approval, launch, monitoring and, where appropriate, retirement.
* Develop clear commercial plans covering target clients, value proposition, pricing, distribution approach and expected financial contribution.
* Equip frontline teams across Private Banking, Premier and High Net Worth/Ultra High Net Worth segments with effective sales narratives, tools and launch support.
* Monitor assets under management, client penetration, revenue, profitability and product utilization.
* Take corrective action where commercial performance, client adoption or profitability does not meet expectations.
* Use client and frontline feedback to improve product design and distribution effectiveness.
* Governance, risk and regulation
* Act as the first line of defence for product integrity and ensure alignment with Group policy, applicable local regulation and HSBC’s internal governance standards.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance and Legal to assess suitability, liquidity, concentration, conduct, counterparty and other relevant risks.
* Lead product reviews, governance forums and remedial actions.
* Ensure issues are identified, escalated and resolved promptly.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their implications for the product shelf, distribution model and client experience.
* Promote a culture in which commercial ambition and responsible product management go hand in hand.
* Market intelligence and investment insight
* Monitor developments across global and Indian public and private markets.
* Assess the implications of changes in interest rates, credit conditions, market structure, regulation and investor demand.
* Convert market intelligence into clear recommendations for product strategy and shelf development.
* Work with Investment Insights teams to strengthen HSBC’s market positioning and advisory narrative.
* Provide concise, credible investment views to senior stakeholders and distribution teams.
* Leadership and stakeholder management
* Serve as the subject-matter expert and escalation point for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments in HSBC India.
* Build effective working relationships with control functions, distribution leaders, Markets teams, regional and global Wealth colleagues and external partners.
* Manage relationships with asset managers, issuers and other ecosystem participants.
* Influence senior leadership through sound commercial analysis, clear investment judgement and well-structured recommendations.
* Coach junior colleagues and contribute to a strong, collaborative product management culture.
* Encourage constructive challenge and bring together different perspectives to improve outcomes.
* Strategic initiatives
* Lead or contribute to strategic priorities, including:
* Expanding HSBC’s investment footprint in GIFT City.
* Building investment-led digital client journeys.
* Enhancing data, analytics and management information for product governance and performance monitoring.
* Developing strategic partnerships with asset managers and other ecosystem participants.
* Improving product discovery, client engagement and frontline enablement.
* Strengthening connectivity between local, regional and global investment capabilities.

**Candidate Profile**
This is a senior product leadership role at the intersection of investment strategy, commercial growth, client outcomes and risk management.
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will Bring**

* Deep technical knowledge of Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments.
* Experience in wealth management, investment product management, asset management, investment banking or a related financial-services environment.
* Strong understanding of product governance, due diligence, suitability and regulatory expectations.
* A track record of taking investment products from concept through approval, launch, distribution and ongoing review.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to connect investment propositions to client needs and business outcomes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder-management and influencing skills.
* The confidence to engage senior leaders and challenge constructively where required.
* A collaborative leadership style and a commitment to developing talent.
* The ability to operate effectively across local, regional and global teams.

**Pro-Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Product Delivery Manager - Account & SSI Platform - Vice President
description:

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic team in a fast-paced and challenging environment? This is a unique opportunity to join the Client Account Services Platform & Strategy team and partner with Product, Operations and Technology to deliver strategic Account and Standing Settlement Instruction Reference Data capabilities across the Commercial & Investment Bank

You will partner with Product Manager, Technology, Operations and Control teams to translate product strategy and roadmaps into well-defined delivery outcomes, executable release plans, operational adoption and measurable business value. You will maintain a strong product delivery cadence, address barriers to execution and provide transparency on release health, quality and risk. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Jr. Associate (Product)
description:
**Overview:**

DataQuark works across product management, solution design, pre-sales, and product marketing, translating business requirements into technology-led solutions. The role involves shaping product requirements, designing solution workflows, supporting client engagements, and contributing to product go-to-market strategies, content, and branding initiatives for DataQuark and its products. The candidate should combine business understanding with technical awareness, strong communication, and documentation skills to support both product development and market growth.

**Experience:**
1- 2 years

**Location:**
Navi Mumbai (Ghansoli)

title: Director of Product
description:
**Director of Product**

AI Cloud and Orchestration, Velocis Platform

**Reports to**
Chief Product Officer

**Location**
Mumbai

**Function**
Product Leadership, AI Infrastructure (Velocis)

**Why this role, why now?**

Neysa is building the AI cloud for the era where AI runs in production rather than in pilots. The promise we are claiming to deliver is operational confidence, the ability for an enterprise to run AI predictably, affordably and accountably. Infrastructure choices now decide which AI programmes are viable at all, and for us sovereignty means strategic control rather than a compliance checkbox.

Velocis is how we deliver that, across GPU as a service and our AI platform as a service. We are scaling from strong early proof into a platform that serves sovereign enterprise buyers in India and large offtake capacity globally. This role exists to help set product direction and to make it real.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Senior Director of Product to sit alongside the Chief Product Officer as a balanced strategist and operator, and to co-own the Velocis product ecosystem. You will help shape the two-year product strategy and you will own the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off that turn it into shipped platform. Engineering, infrastructure operations, design and go-to-market are your delivery partners, and product holds the pen on what gets built and in what order.

You will move between whiteboarding high-density cluster architecture with an executive buyer in one hour and running a deep specification review with a product manager in the next. Both are the job.

**What you will own?Product strategy and roadmap**

• Co-own the 12 and 24 month strategy for Velocis across GPU as a service and the AI platform, and hold the roadmap, prioritisation and specification sign-off end to end.

• Ship the Velocis AI platform stack and move straight into post-launch feature velocity, reliability, and the Day-0 and Day-1 user journey.

• Keep a live read on the global AI infrastructure landscape, across orchestration layers, sovereign cloud, inference economics and power and density, so Velocis holds its edge.

**Team and craft**

• Lead, mentor and hold accountable a team of four or more product managers across the core Velocis modules.

• Build a product culture of extreme ownership, technical precision and fast feedback, and raise the hiring bar as the team grows.

• Coach high-potential talent and step in where a track needs lift.

**Enterprise commercials and offtake**

• Partner with the CPO and CEO on offtake opportunities from 1,000 to 8,000 GPUs, shaping orchestration specs, tenant isolation and SLA commitments.

• Act as executive product sponsor for key Indian enterprise accounts.

• Turn bespoke offtake and enterprise requirements into platform capabilities the wider base can use, without fragmenting the core codebase. This is one of the hardest and most important parts of the role.

**Platform economics**

• Own core product economics with the CPO, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin, tenant density and feature monetisation.

• Treat onboarding time to value and expansion as first-order outcomes, since Velocis revenue behaves as consumption rather than subscription and expansion is the dominant growth lever.

**What you bring?**

• Ten or more years in product management, with four or more leading product teams. Hands-on experience in GPU computing, AI or ML orchestration or HPC is ideal, and strong candidates from adjacent large-scale cloud or general-purpose cloud infrastructure, with the ability to ramp fast, will be considered.

• A track record of shipping complex B2B infrastructure products from concept to meaningful revenue scale.

• Fluency across GPU infrastructure on NVIDIA and AMD, container and workload orchestration such as Kubernetes, Slurm and Ray, VPC and network topologies, object storage and dedicated inference pipelines.

• Working command of multi-tenancy and tenant isolation, observability and cost attribution, sovereign deployment patterns such as air-gapped clusters and customer-managed keys, and inference economics measured as cost per token and P99 latency.

• Commercial fluency, so that you connect product decisions to gross margin, resource efficiency and customer return.

**How you work?**

• You zoom out to market positioning and a two-year horizon, and zoom in to specifications, telemetry and the granular detail, without losing either.

• You have a default to action and high standards, and you pair them with the judgment to say no and to sequence well.

• You are a low-ego and articulate communicator who earns credibility quickly with engineers, enterprise CTOs and executive leadership.

• You are comfortable building in a category that is still being created.

**Your first 90 days**

• Take full ownership of the roadmap and prioritisation across the PM tracks, with clear ownership lines in place.

• Land the near-term Velocis milestones with clean telemetry on adoption and stability.

• Establish a working rhythm with engineering, operations and go-to-market that delivers predictably.

**Success in the first 6 to 12 months**

• Roadmap predictability and release velocity, with the Velocis milestones shipped and instrumented for adoption and reliability.

• Movement on the economics you own, across GPU utilisation efficiency, gross margin and tenant density.

• Time to production for offtake customers and time to value in onboarding, both trending down.

• Expansion on named enterprise and offtake accounts.

• A high-functioning product team with clear ownership and a rising bar.
