title: Senior Manager - NPI
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team**
Own the end-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) process, from design transfer to stable commercial production. Lead cross-functional stage-gate reviews, ensuring products progress only when readiness criteria for cost, quality, supply, and operational execution are met, delivering successful launches on time and in full.
  
  
This role provides leadership and governance for the NPI portfolio, owning launch outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and stage-gate decisions. While the NPI Planner manages operational execution across materials, capacity, builds, and inventory, this role is accountable for overall NPI success and commercialization readiness.
  
  
**Key Tasks**
NPI process ownership
  
  

* Define, run and continuously improve the stage-gate NPI process (concept, design, prototype, pilot, ramp, release to mass production), including gate criteria, templates and governance.
* Run the NPI portfolio: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across concurrent projects.
* Own the handover from Technology to Operations and the transition to steady-state manufacturing.

Cross-functional evaluation and gate decisions
  
  

* Chair NPI gate reviews with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing Engineering, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Finance and Commercial.
* Assess each product for manufacturability, test and quality readiness, supplier readiness, compliance, cost and launch risk.
* Make or escalate go / no-go / conditional-go recommendations with documented risks and mitigations.

NPI delivery
  
  

* Own schedule, budget, scope and risk for each project; maintain the master NPI plan and critical path.
* Drive risk management and resolve cross-functional conflicts quickly.
* Manage contract manufacturers and key suppliers for pilot builds and ramp, where applicable.

Cost, quality and supply readiness
  
  

* Agree target cost, yield and first-pass quality with Finance, Quality and Manufacturing; track the gap to target at every gate.
* Ensure the NPI Planner’s material, capacity and build plans support each gate date and launch volume.
* Ensure change control, BOM and documentation are complete and released before production.

Lead NPI Portfolio & Performance Management
  
  

* Maintain the consolidated NPI roadmap and publish dashboards covering project health, milestone adherence, launch readiness, action closure, and post-launch performance.

Lead Export Readiness for NPI PLanning
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment and close coordination with Export teams to establish inventory strategies, distribution networks, capacity plans, and market-specific supply requirements for successful export launches.
* Govern the transition of NPI projects into business-as-usual export operations, ensuring seamless handover, supply continuity, and service reliability across all destination markets.

Leadership and stakeholder management
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the NPI team; set objectives and manage performance.
* Report on project status, risks and decisions to senior leadership and the executive team.
* Capture lessons learned after each launch and feed them back into the process.

**Experience Required**

* Graduate degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Post Graduate Degree or MBA in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or Business Management will be an added advantage
* 10-12 years of Supply Chain experience with strong exposure to NPI, Planning, Product Lifecycle Management, Project Management, or Supply Chain Transformation.
* Proven experience in leading cross-functional NPI, commercialization, innovation, or product-transition programs.
* Strong understanding of Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Capacity Planning, S&OP, and phase-in/phase-out processes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across Marketing, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Quality, and Regulatory teams.
* Strong project management, risk management, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent launches.

We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*

Contractual – 6 months

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a senior Source-to-Pay (S2P) transformation expert to support the validation of an AI-first S2P platform implementation for a large, multi-entity manufacturing organisation.

The individual will work with business and technology stakeholders to validate the proposed future-state procurement processes, assess the platform design, and ensure that the solution reflects real-world procurement requirements across direct and indirect procurement, imports, and complex manufacturing supply chains.

This is a
**validation and design assurance role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **S2P Design Validation:**

* **Procurement Expertise:**
  Assess direct and indirect procurement processes, including raw material sourcing, imports, supplier management, purchasing, and procurement operations in a manufacturing environment.
* **Operating Model Assessment:**
  Validate the proposed division of responsibilities between the business and Global Business Services (GBS), identifying activities that should remain business-owned versus those suitable for centralisation or outsourcing.
* **Manufacturing Supply Chain Context:**
  Evaluate procurement scenarios involving industrial raw materials, chemicals, international sourcing, import/export processes, and complex supplier ecosystems.
* **Techno-Functional Assessment:**
  Bridge procurement business requirements and platform capabilities, ensuring the proposed workflows and automation adequately address operational realities.
* **Gap and Risk Identification:**
  Identify missing scenarios, process gaps, design assumptions, control weaknesses, and potential implementation risks; recommend practical corrective actions.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Work with procurement leaders, process owners, transformation teams, and technology partners during design reviews and workshops.
* **Sign-off and Recommendations:**
  Provide structured feedback, document findings, and support business validation and sign-off of the future-state design before production rollout.

* Strong expertise across
  **end-to-end Source-to-Pay / Procure-to-Pay**
  , particularly the procurement stages preceding invoice processing and payment.
* Proven experience in both direct and indirect procurement.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing procurement, including raw materials, supplier sourcing, purchasing operations, and complex supply chains.
* Experience with international sourcing, imports, exports, and associated procurement processes.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing or validating procurement process designs, target operating models, workflows, or procurement platform implementations.

title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements

Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

description:
**About The Team**
Purplle’s Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e-commerce platform. The team constantly ships new supply chain features that are scalable, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience. As a team, every individual is expected to make a significant, measurable impact on the business.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager who will own the product charter for our Warehouse Operations end to end, along with the SAP ERP flows that run through it. You will work at the intersection of product, operations, and finance systems, turning the needs of warehouse and business stakeholders into reliable, well-built features. This is an individual contributor role with full ownership of the roadmap, its business impact, and its escalations. You will work closely with backend engineering, the SAP team, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**WMS Product Ownership**

* Own the product roadmap for operations and the Warehouse Management System (WMS) workflows used by warehouse teams, prioritised by business impact.
* Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
* Own product work on inward, outward, cross dock, throughput, audits, inventory, driving each from problem identification to closure.
* Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
* Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground, then define structured improvements that scale.
* Act as the single owner for the WMS charter, including cross-functional escalations and stakeholder communication.

**ERP Systems (SAP)**

* Own the integration and data consistency between the WMS and SAP for sales, inventory, stock movement, and reconciliation flows.
* Work with the SAP team, engineering, finance, and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.
* Define, validate, and track the impact of SAP-related product changes on the WMS and on financial accuracy.
* Ensure SAP stays the reliable financial record for WMS inventory and movements.

**Business Impact and Execution**

* Define success metrics for every initiative and track their impact after launch.
* Use data to monitor warehouse health, surface insights, and drive data-informed product decisions.
* Run regular reviews with engineering and business teams to keep delivery on track and priorities clear.

**Must-Have Skills And Requirements**

* 3 to 6 years of experience in a product management role.
* BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
* Strong product fundamentals, including the ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, prioritise by impact, and ship in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Some exposure to WMS, DC operations, or SAP, with the ability to quickly learn how inventory and sales data flow across systems.
* Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
* Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, operations, and finance teams.
* High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Warehouse Management Systems and distribution center operations such as inbound, storage, and outbound flows.
* Experience with SAP or a similar enterprise ERP.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
* Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
* Exposure to inventory management, e-commerce fulfilment, or quick-commerce operations.

**What You Will Gain**

* End-to-end ownership of a business-critical WMS charter, from roadmap to impact.
* A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
* Deep exposure to SAP and ERP integration across a high-volume e-commerce supply chain.
* A clear growth path toward Senior Product Manager.

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

We seek those who embody the ‘will to get it done or do it myself’ attitude, a genuine willingness to take initiative, and the ability to hustle and own the product lifecycle from conception to scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Own and pioneer the next generation of products by connecting core business objectives with complex consumer and enterprise problems across our B2B2C platform.

• Set and drive AI product strategy: identify, evaluate, and embed Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and AI agents into product features to deliver highly personalized, predictive, and intelligent user experiences.

• Provide product leadership and direction: influence, mentor, and elevate product managers and cross- functional partners, setting a high bar for craft, judgment, and execution across the product organization.

• Quantify market white space, conduct deep qualitative and quantitative analysis, and translate these findings into a compelling product vision and an execution-focused roadmap.

• Author clear, data-driven product specifications and relentlessly manage product execution with finesse, ensuring product definition, goals, and requirements are backed by robust data and validation.

• Maintain a relentless customer focus: deeply engage with customers and partners, and dig into data to unearth insights and ‘hidden gems’ that inform innovative product development.

• Serve as a critical bridge, collaborating closely with Engineering, Design, Data Analytics, Marketing, and all relevant stakeholders to flawlessly execute the product roadmap.

• Navigate complex cross-functional challenges, proactively managing bottlenecks, making strategic trade-offs between technical constraints and business needs, and maximizing business value while building world-class customer experiences.

• Prioritize initiatives based on market dynamics and business impact, continuously evaluate product and feature performance against goals, and develop data-backed recommendations for iteration and improvement.

• Set, own, and dramatically move key performance indicators (KPIs) and meaningful metrics for product success.

• Effectively communicate product strategy, progress, and key initiatives across all levels of the organization, including preparation and presentation of executive management updates.

**Required Skills & Experience**

• Minimum 10+ years of total experience, with a strong track record in senior product roles, preferably in a fast-paced B2B2C, B2B, or B2C startup or company.

• Proven track record of building, scaling, and delivering growth in platform and consumer products- serving both business and end-consumer stakeholders (B2B2C) — based on critical business metrics.

• A true Tech and Product enthusiast with a strong understanding of modern technology stacks, eager to shape and drive the product vision.

• Working expertise in Agile/Scrum methodologies, focusing on high-velocity delivery.

• Good to have: experience with payments and payout integrations.

• Good to have: experience in Insurtech and/or embedded insurance.

• AI Product Strategy (must-have): demonstrated ability to understand, conceptualize, and drive products leveraging machine learning, deep learning, or generative AI technologies.

• Deep familiarity with the lifecycle of an AI/ML-powered feature, including data requirements, model deployment, and performance monitoring.

• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts, including AI/ML limitations and trade-offs, to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strongly preferred – hands-on AI: ability to personally build prototypes and work directly with AI agents, evaluations, observability, and prompt & context engineering.

Core PM Skills:

• Outcome-Obsessed: extremely outcome-oriented, capable of clearly articulating the expected outcome and

rallying cross-functional teams toward shared, measurable results.

• Data-Driven Decision Maker: possess exceptional analytical and numerical skills, leveraging metric-based

insights to make high-impact decisions.

• Entrepreneurial Drive: proven experience conceptualizing and delivering delightful products with an obsessive focus on user experience.

• Leadership & Communication: outstanding leadership capabilities, coupled with excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and clear verbal/written communication skills.

title: Assistant Vice President / Senior Associate, Lending Platform Lead, Consumer Banking Group
description:

* Drive digital onboarding, loan origination, servicing, and customer journey enhancements.

title: Manager - Product Innovation
description:

At the Godrej Industries Group, we are privileged to serve over 1.1 billion consumers globally through our businesses with market leadership positions in the consumer products, real estate, agriculture, financial services and chemicals industries

www.godrejindustries.com

www.godrejproperties.com

**Manager - Product Innovation**

title: Manager- Projects (NPD)
description:
**About Shalina Healthcare:**

Shalina Healthcare is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in sub-Saharan Africa. For the last 40 years we have made it our mission to provide quality medicines to those who need it the most. We manufacture and distribute branded prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical and consumer products, across a broad range of therapeutic groups, including anti-malarial, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory and nutrition. We have a track record few can match and our brands are among the most trusted in Africa.

We are proud of our history and have big ambitions for the future. Our vision for 2030 is to be the health champion of Sub-Saharan Africa. To achieve this, we are looking for the right people to join us and create a lasting impact not just within our company but on the communities we serve.

Everyone in our company has a crucial role to play, and we are looking for people who identify with our Core Values and are as passionate about our Mission as we are.

The Global Supply Organization is a multi-continental Function that comprises of the entire Value Chain from product conceptualization to delivery to the commercial front. Within the Global Supply Organization are included, Research & Development, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain Management and Logistics.

**Role:**
Manager – New Product Development (NPD)

**Designation**
: Manager

**Base location:**
Pawane, Navi Mumbai, India

**Reporting To:**
DGM- NPD

**Role Purpose**

1. End-to-End Project Management

* Manage end-to-end projects covering New Products (NP), Geographic Expansion (GE), and packaging changes.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely execution of project milestones and launch plans.
* Track individual product timelines, identify delays, resolve dependencies, and provide weekly project updates.
* Ensure adherence to defined processes, timelines, and project compliance requirements.

2. Product Feasibility & Portfolio Development

* Evaluate project feasibility based on Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), Gross Profit (GP%), and commercial viability.
* Prepare New Item Forms (NIFs) to initiate sourcing of new products in coordination with Operating Units (OUs).
* Collect and consolidate product information, assess data availability from sourcing teams, and support preparation of product proposals.
* Identify new product and value-improvement opportunities for the Medium-Term Plan (MTP) using EXIM and Sani Sphere data.
* Track the Consumer Products portfolio and support portfolio expansion initiatives.

3. New Product Launches & Market Coordination

* Coordinate with OUs and internal stakeholders to ensure timely delivery and launch of new products across markets.
* Track product launch readiness, dispatches, and supply status, and communicate updates to respective markets on time.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain for purchase requisition (PR) and purchase order (PO) releases to vendors and production teams.
* Follow up on launch-related dependencies to ensure products are available as per planned timelines.
* Coordinate medical content and French/Portuguese leaflet translations with relevant stakeholders.

4. Regulatory, Quality & Documentation

* Coordinate legal, technical, regulatory, and quality activities related to product development and launches.
* Initiate and follow up on Change Control Forms (CCFs) with Quality Assurance (QA), ensuring approvals and implementation within agreed timelines.
* Coordinate Finished Goods (FG) code creation by collecting relevant information from departments and initiating requests through SAP and EDUCE.
* Ensure required product documentation and administrative requirements, including Shalina Artwork Text (SAT) forms, are completed accurately and on time.
* Maintain project records and ensure documentation compliance throughout the product development lifecycle.

5. Packaging & Artwork Management

* Coordinate with the Artwork team for internal packaging and artwork development.
* Collect vendor specifications and obtain approvals from relevant departments for artwork and packaging implementation.
* Track packaging changes and ensure alignment between artwork, regulatory requirements, product specifications, and launch timelines.

6. MIS, Reporting & Performance Tracking

* Prepare monthly updates for the CEO report and track NPD sales performance using Qlik data.
* Maintain project trackers, launch reports, and other MIS within defined timelines.
* Provide regular visibility on project progress, pending actions, launch readiness, and potential delays.
* Track product dispatches and communicate shipment status to respective markets.
* Maintain accurate and updated tracking reports to support management reviews and decision-making.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Engineering, Management, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in New Product Development, project management, product launches, or portfolio management, preferably in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience coordinating with Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, Procurement, Artwork, and international Operating Units.
* Working knowledge of SAP, EDUCE, Qlik, MS Excel, and project tracking tools will be preferred.
* Exposure to geographic expansion, packaging changes, and consumer product portfolios will be an advantage.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* New Product Development & Launch Management
* Cross-Functional Project Coordination
* Project Planning and Timeline Management
* Product Feasibility, COGS & GP Analysis
* Regulatory and Quality Documentation
* Artwork and Packaging Change Management
* SAP, EDUCE & Qlik Reporting
* MIS Preparation and Data Analysis
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem-Solving and Execution Excellence

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of NPD, geographic expansion, and packaging change projects.
* Adherence to planned product launch timelines.
* Accuracy and timeliness of project trackers and management MIS.
* Timely completion of regulatory, quality, artwork, and documentation activities.
* Product feasibility and profitability assessment.
* Timely FG code creation and PR/PO coordination.
* Timely communication of product dispatches and launch status to markets.
* Effective tracking of NPD sales and the Consumer Products portfolio.

title: Associate Business Process Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
The Associate Business Process Analyst will work closely with cross‑functional teams to shape and evolve a core product offering. Acting as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the IT development team, you will translate business needs into technical specifications, prioritize enhancements, and ensure the product remains usable, scalable, and aligned with organizational goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Elicit, document, and validate business requirements for product enhancements.
* Translate requirements into functional specifications for the development team.
* Collaborate with IT to design, develop, and test new product features.
* Analyze existing product performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Prioritize backlog items based on business impact, feasibility, and ROI.
* Facilitate communication between business users and technical teams.
* Conduct user acceptance testing and ensure solutions meet quality standards.
* Provide recommendations for process automation and efficiency gains.
* Monitor product metrics post‑release and suggest iterative refinements.
* Maintain up‑to‑date documentation and knowledge base for stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in business analysis or product support roles.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a data‑driven mindset.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management abilities.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and requirement‑tracking tools.
* Basic understanding of software development lifecycle and technical concepts.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Visio, and diagramming tools; experience with JIRA or similar is a plus.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines.
* Detail‑oriented with a focus on delivering high‑quality, user‑centric solutions.

We encourage candidates to apply directly to our website and not through third-party sources.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**

**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. **About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
As an Engagement Delivery Director, you are a senior individual contributor and a foremost expert in delivering intended business value from the Salesforce platform. This is a fully-billable, high-impact role deployed as a Delivery Leader to our strategic and complex customer engagements.
  
  
You will be responsible for the end-to-end success of programs, with a primary focus on maximizing platform adoption, demonstrating ROI, and mitigating revenue or license attrition risk. **Required Skills & Experience**

* Team management: Prior experience leading the program pre-sales & delivery team by fostering continuous learning and ensuring members are well-trained, while supporting and driving career growth, personal and team development, well-being, diversity, and inclusion.
* Methodology: Demonstrated mastery of program management methodologies (Agile, Hybrid) and the ability to apply them to complex enterprise environments, including adapting agile frameworks to support the iterative testing and validation loops unique to generative AI solutions.
* Mindset: A self-starting, individual contributor mindset with the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and influence across matrixed organizations.

title: Product Manager – Automation
description:

Own Luna's servo, VFD, HMI, PLC and motion control lines end to end, from roadmap to revenue.

Work directly with Panasonic, Shihlin, Flexem and Fatek, and turn great products into wins for India's machine builders.

Location: Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane) HQ

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 4–8 years

The Role

You will be the product owner for Luna's automation portfolio: Panasonic servo motors and drives, Shihlin VFDs, Flexem HMIs, and Fatek PLCs and motion controllers. You will decide what we sell, how we position and price it, and how our sales team wins with it. You will work closely with our global principals and support key deals across India.

What You Will Do

• Own the strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for the servo, VFD, HMI, PLC and motion control lines in India.

• Map the market and competitors to find where Luna can win.

• Define positioning, value propositions and pricing recommendations, and launch new products on time.

• Act as the main contact for global principals on product plans, localisation and field feedback.

• Train the sales, application and dealer teams, and build the presentations, selection guides and application notes they use.

• Win key deals across India with technical presentations, demos and solution proposals.

• Track product performance and customer feedback, and refine the portfolio based on what you learn.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Mechatronics Engineering.

• 4–8 years in product management, application engineering or technical sales in industrial automation.

• Hands-on selection and sizing of servo systems and VFDs, plus working knowledge of HMI/PLC and motion control.

• Experience working with OEMs, machine builders and system integrators.

• Strong presentation and training skills, and willingness to travel across India.

Good to Have

• Experience with Siemens, Delta, Mitsubishi, Yaskawa, Schneider or similar brands is a plus.

• Experience working with overseas principals or at an automation distributor.

• Exposure to packaging, textile, plastics, CNC, HVAC, water or material handling applications.

Why Luna

• Real ownership: your roadmap and pricing calls move fast, with direct access to leadership and no red tape.

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a provider of industrial automation, mechatronics, motion control and robotics solutions, headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane). Luna is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house, so the opportunity to grow with us is priceless.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "Product Manager – Automation".

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Associate Product Manager 2
description:
Associate Product Manager 2 - Risk POD (OneRisk Platform)
  
  
At IDfy, Risk isn't a spreadsheet - it's a living, breathing decision engine. Every day, banks, lenders, marketplaces, and enterprises use our risk products to decide who to trust, who to onboard, and who to flag.
  
  
This role sits inside the Risk POD, working across IDfy's Risk Platform (OneRisk) - AML screening, Instascreen, Netscan, Entity Risk, and Individual Risk. We're looking for someone who can pick up a module, own it end-to-end, and ship it: someone who executes cleanly, sweats the details, and doesn't need a lot of hand-holding to get from "here's the problem" to "here's what shipped."
  
  
**We're The Right Match If You**

* Are hands-on - you'd rather be in the weeds fixing the actual problem than writing about it
* Have a strong track record of execution - you take a module from spec to release and see it through
* Show real ownership and accountability - things don't fall through the cracks on your watch
* Have a sharp eye for detail - you catch the edge case, the inconsistency, the thing that would've become a client escalation
* Are comfortable working with data - reading it, questioning it, using it to make a call (SQL/Excel proficiency is a strong plus, not a dealbreaker)
* Don't get rattled by ambiguity - you ask the right questions and get moving

Bonus points if you've been exposed to risk, fraud detection, AML/KYC workflows, or understand India's fintech/regulatory landscape (RBI, DPDP, KYC).
  
  
**What Your Day Would Look Like**

* Owning execution of specific modules within IDfy's Risk Platform
* Working with Engineering to take features from spec to shipped, and making sure what ships actually works
* Joining client calls to understand issues, explain product behaviour, and help drive resolutions with clarity and confidence
* Digging into risk data and case outcomes to spot patterns, gaps, and improvement areas
* Running the last mile on quality - testing, catching edge cases, and making sure nothing slips through before release
* Keeping Engineering, Data, and Ops aligned on what needs to happen and by when

Why IDfy
  
  
Because this is where trust is built with data. At IDfy, you'll work on:
  
  

* Real-world risk, fraud, and compliance problems that affect millions of decisions every day
* A homegrown AI-driven platform powering India's digital economy
* Products that influence lending, insurance, hiring, and onboarding at massive scale
* A team that moves fast, thinks deeply, and cares about outcomes

Interview Process & Competencies
  
  
R1 - Hiring Manager
  
  
Goal: Can this person execute independently and own a module end-to-end?
  
  

* Ownership & Execution
* Can describe a project or module they owned start to finish, including the messy parts
* Follows through without being chased - proactively flags blockers and closes loops
* Distinguishes "did the task" from "owned the outcome"
* Attention to Detail
* Catches inconsistencies, edge cases, or errors when walked through a sample problem
* Can describe a time a small detail they caught prevented a bigger issue
* Approach is structured and methodical - not just "I'm careful"
* Communication & Client-Readiness
* Can explain a technical or data concept clearly and simply
* Comfortable role-playing a client conversation - stays calm, doesn't waffle
* Listens for the actual question before answering

R2 - Platform Lead
  
  
Goal: Can this person plug into the Risk Platform and be trusted with real modules?
  
  

* Platform & Data Fluency
* Can reason about how a risk module fits into a larger workflow - what feeds it, what it feeds
* Comfortable with data - can read a dataset or report and draw a sensible conclusion
* Asks good clarifying questions about how systems and signals behave
* Structured Problem-Solving
* Breaks a messy, real-world risk or client problem down into clear steps
* Moves from ambiguity to a concrete next action without over-indexing on speed or perfection
* Shows reasoning, not just gut calls
* Delivery Discipline
* Talks concretely about how they'd scope, sequence, and ship a module
* Understands the trade-off between speed and correctness in a risk-sensitive context
* Shows awareness of what "done and reliable" looks like, not just "done"

R3 - Function Head
  
  
Goal: Culture, motivation, and offer fit

title: AML Data Product Owner
description:
**About Business Line/Function**
**Job Description – AML Data Product Owner**
The AML IT function within BNP Paribas CIB’s CEFS-technology delivers an end-to-end IT platform supporting the bank’s AML program. It converts regulatory and compliance rules into scalable, secure IT solutions to detect, investigate, and report suspicious activity globally.
  
  
As the technology backbone, it processes transaction data into actionable AML insights, ensuring regulatory compliance, operational resilience, and innovation.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
This next-gen AML role strengthens BNPP Group’s defences against financial crime by leveraging cutting-edge tech and innovation.
  
  
As AML Data Product Owner, you will own the vision, roadmap, and delivery of the AML Data Layer platform. The role blends AML and payments expertise with product ownership, stakeholder management, and agile delivery to meet regulatory, operational, and business objectives across the Group.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define product vision & roadmap – Set a clear strategy for the AML Data Layer, prioritizing requirements and aligning them with overall AML goals.
* Stakeholder management – Serve as the main liaison between compliance, operations, risk, technology, and regulators; run workshops and briefings to capture needs and secure buy in.
* Agile backlog ownership – Write and groom user stories (including Gherkin/BDD where appropriate), define acceptance criteria, and maintain a ready backlog for sprint planning.
* Regulatory & payments expertise – Translate FATF, EU AMLD, OFAC and payments industry rules (PCI DSS, PSD2, ISO 20022, etc.) into actionable product requirements.
* Solution design & validation – Work with architects and data engineers to validate data models, APIs, and integration patterns that support high throughput payment flows; lead PoCs and present outcomes to governance bodies.
* Performance & quality assurance – Define KPIs for data quality, latency and detection effectiveness; partner with QA to embed test automation (e.g., Selenium, Cucumber) and CI pipelines.
* Change management & adoption – Produce release communications, training materials and support plans to drive user adoption across compliance and payments teams.
* Continuous improvement – Champion agile best practices, BDD techniques and data governance standards; mentor junior team members on AML, payments and product ownership.

**Mandatory Skills**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Domain expertise: ≥ 5 years in AML or payments compliance, with deep knowledge of payment and other transaction flow data and related regulatory frameworks.
* Product ownership: Proven experience delivering data intensive platforms in an Agile environment, handling backlog definition and sprint delivery.
* Stakeholder influence: Demonstrated ability to work with senior business and technical leaders, translating ambiguous needs into clear product goals.
* Agile & BDD: Strong command of Scrum/Kanban, writing user stories, acceptance criteria and using BDD tools (Gherkin, Cucumber).
* Data modelling & APIs: Hands on experience with data model design, SQL/PL SQL, REST/Swagger API specifications and data lineage concepts.
* Analytical mindset: Skilled at data driven problem solving, monitoring performance metrics and turning insights into product decisions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills; able to simplify complex AML concepts for diverse audiences.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Experience with NICE Actimize SAM, UDM, ActOne or similar AML platforms.
* Familiarity with SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 MX payment messaging standards.
* Knowledge of correspondent banking, sanctions screening and financial crime risks in payments.
* Experience with data lakes, data hubs, cloud data platforms or real-time data integration.
* Exposure to data governance, metadata management and data lineage tools. Familiarity with BPMN/workflow engines (Camunda, Flowable).
* Certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), ICA AML or payments industry qualifications

Ability to synthetize / simplify
  
  
Ability to deliver / Results driven
  
  
Attention to detail / rigor
  
  
Creativity & Innovation / Problem solving

Ability to anticipate business / strategic evolution
  
  
Ability to understand, explain and support change
  
  
**Ability To Develop Others & Improve Their Skills**
Ability to set up relevant performance indicators
  
  
Analytical Ability
  
  
**Education Level**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level
  
  
At least 12 years
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. title: Video Platform Launch & Implementation Strategist
company: Sanjeev Tanna Education PVT Ltd.(STEPL) |NGN Learning| My Feeling Studio|
description:
**About the opportunity**

We are preparing to launch an educational video learning platform across schools in India. We seek a highly experienced, independent and execution-focused professional to evaluate launch readiness, anticipate obstacles, devise practical solutions, build a phased roadmap and guide teams through implementation and scale-up.

This is not a presentation-only advisory position. The consultant must challenge assumptions, separate launch blockers from desirable improvements, guide decisions and stay actively involved in execution.

**1. Product and platform readiness**

Independently assess platform features, architecture, reliability, usability, accessibility and overall maturity.

Test video playback, navigation, audio, synchronization and device performance on intended Windows and Android tablets.

Review online/offline functionality where applicable, poor connectivity, content delivery, storage, updates, licensing and access control.

Evaluate the experience from student, teacher, school administrator and technical support perspectives.

Identify missing capabilities, technical bottlenecks, critical defects and practical remedial actions.

**Expected deliverable:**
Product Readiness Audit with severity-ranked gaps and launch-readiness recommendations.

**2. School deployment feasibility**

Assess infrastructure across metropolitan, urban, semi-urban and rural schools, including connectivity, electricity and IT support.

Review device specifications, classroom displays, speakers, shared-device setups, maintenance and daily setup requirements.

Evaluate curriculum/timetable fit, teacher digital confidence and regional/language requirements.

Compare private, government, aided and school-chain deployment conditions and recommend appropriate models.

**Expected deliverable:**
School Deployment Feasibility Report with school segmentation, prerequisites and deployment models.

**3. Proactive risk and roadblock forecasting**

Identify technical failures: crashes, playback issues, device incompatibility, outages, update failures, security and hardware issues.

Identify operational failure points: logistics delays, training gaps, weak support, unclear ownership and multisite coordination.

Identify adoption risks: teacher resistance, low classroom use, weak engagement and gaps between procurement and actual use.

Identify business risks: pricing, sales cycles, acquisition and servicing costs, renewals and unsustainable scale economics.

Review applicable student privacy, child safety, intellectual property, contracts and education-sector compliance requirements.

For every material risk document likelihood, impact, early-warning signs, mitigation, contingency plan, owner and escalation trigger.

**Expected deliverable:**
Prioritized Risk Register, Early-Warning Dashboard, Mitigation Plan and Contingency Playbook.

**4. Launch strategy and rollout roadmap**

Phase 1: establish baseline readiness, critical corrections and validation standards.

Phase 2: select pilot schools, define success metrics, prepare devices, onboard staff and monitor field usage.

Phase 3: resolve pilot findings, refine training/support procedures and validate improvements.

Phase 4: prioritize regions and school segments, deploy regional resources and monitor operations.

Phase 5: expand to PAN India only when pilot and regional go/no-go thresholds are met.

Specify milestone dates, budget ranges, dependencies, staffing, accountable owners and decision gates.

**Expected deliverable:**
Phased Launch Roadmap, Resource Plan, Milestone Tracker and Go/No-Go Criteria.

**5. Technical testing and quality assurance**

Set the end-to-end QA approach for video quality, audio clarity, lip sync, navigation, device compatibility and reliability.

Define field scenarios for intermittent internet, shared devices, school hardware and concurrent usage where relevant.

Coordinate defect triage, developer fixes, retesting, release acceptance and escalation of unresolved blockers.

Create clear release-readiness checklists with pass/fail criteria and named sign-off owners.

**Expected deliverable:**
QA Framework, Defect Prioritization Process and Release Readiness Checklist.

**6. School onboarding, adoption and support**

Design school onboarding, teacher training, reference material and administrator enablement.

Define school coordinator responsibilities, helpdesk procedures, ticket escalation and service expectations.

Measure actual classroom usage, teacher readiness, satisfaction and ongoing adoption.

Use feedback from students, teachers and school management to refine deployment workflows.

**Expected deliverable:**
School Onboarding and Adoption Framework with Training and Support SOPs.

**7. Commercial and operational scalability**

Evaluate direct versus partner-led school acquisition, distribution, pricing, packaging and licensing models.

Estimate one-time and recurring costs per school, including devices, field deployment, support, training and maintenance.

Develop staffing and operational models for hundreds and thousands of schools.

Define unit economics, capacity constraints, renewal drivers and key management metrics.

**Expected deliverable:**
Commercial Feasibility and Scalability Assessment with scenario-based costs.

**8. Vendors, partners and team capability**

Identify and assess technology, implementation, logistics, training and service partners as needed.

Recommend outsourcing versus in-house responsibilities and vendor selection criteria.

Review scopes of work, service levels, ownership, fallback partners and critical dependencies.

Assess internal skills and capacity gaps that could delay deployment.

**Expected deliverable:**
Partner and Resource Strategy, Team Responsibility Matrix and Vendor Evaluation Criteria.

**9. Hands-on execution leadership**

Work with management, product, content, development, operations and field teams to convert plans into concrete actions.

Run structured implementation reviews, unblock dependencies and recommend practical alternatives when plans fail.

Track issue owners, due dates, completion evidence and decisions requiring leadership input.

Escalate emerging risks before they compromise launch dates, costs or school experience.

**Expected deliverable:**
Master Execution Tracker, Weekly Reviews and Decision/Escalation Log.

**10. Reporting and project governance**

Maintain milestone dashboards, risk and issue registers, quality metrics, budgets and resource utilization.

Report completed items, pending tasks, forecast problems, next decisions and recommended corrective actions.

Make readiness and rollout decisions traceable with written criteria and accountable sign-offs.

**Expected deliverable:**
Weekly Leadership Report and Stage-Gate Decision Pack.

**Required qualifications and experience**

8–15+ years in EdTech, educational technology deployment, product launch or large-scale implementation preferred.

Documented experience deploying technology solutions in Indian schools, ideally across multiple states or school networks.

Strong knowledge of Indian school operations, institutional procurement, classroom realities and digital adoption.

Working technical understanding of learning platforms, video delivery, tablets, QA and school IT constraints.

Demonstrated strength in risk management, project governance, operating budgets and cross-functional execution.

Ability to communicate difficult findings clearly and provide actionable solutions rather than generic advice.

**Strongly preferred experience**

Personally led or meaningfully owned deployment across 100+ schools or multiple states.

Worked with school groups, education departments or institutional school customers.

Launched video-based learning, digital classrooms, learning management systems or tablet-enabled programs.

Built repeatable pilot-to-rollout processes including teacher training, SOPs and field support.

Operated in low-connectivity environments and anticipated significant issues before launch.

**Success will be measured by**

Completeness and independence of product and school-readiness assessments.

Early discovery and prevention of launch-blocking technical, adoption and operational risks.

A realistic, costed roadmap with specific owners, dependencies and measurable milestones.

Validated pilot outcomes, issue resolution, teacher adoption and platform usage.

Repeatable, supportable deployment economics and evidence-based readiness for regional and national expansion.

**Application requirements**

Applicants should submit their professional profile, relevant deployments and measurable outcomes, school/state coverage, an example of a major anticipated or resolved rollout problem, an outline of their approach to this assignment, availability and expected fees or compensation.

**Application subject:**
Video Platform Launch & Implementation Strategist | PAN India

**Suggested engagement structure (for hiring team)**

**Weeks 1–3 | Independent audit:**
Product and operational assessment; critical risks; readiness baseline.

**Weeks 4–6 | Roadmap and pilot design:**
Prioritized fixes; pilot school criteria; budget; project governance and go/no-go gates.

**Weeks 7–12 | Pilot execution:**
Field testing; teacher onboarding; evidence collection; issue resolution and pilot evaluation.

**Post-pilot | Controlled expansion:**
Regional expansion with validated operating model; nationwide scale only after approval.

Planning windows are illustrative and must be validated after the initial audit.

**About Emeritus**

title: HCM Technical Delivery Lead
description: A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.OverviewThe HCM Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the end-to-end analysis, configuration, technical design, delivery and ongoing optimisation of Oracle Cloud HCM solutions across the organisation. The role partners with stakeholders to understand business strategy, processes, pain points and requirements, and translates these needs into secure, scalable and supportable solutions. Key areas of focus include Core HR, Recruiting, Time and Labour, Absence Management, integrations, reporting, data migration and emerging Oracle AI capabilities.Working closely with HR Systems team, People teams, Technology, Security, vendors and implementation partners, the role provides business, functional and technical leadership across the complete solution delivery lifecycle. This includes facilitating requirements analysis, documenting and validating requirements, designing and configuring Oracle HCM solutions, overseeing technical builds and integrations, leading testing and migration activities, managing releases and cutover, supporting production stabilisation, and maintaining solution documentation. Key Accountabilities and Main ResponsibilitiesStrategic FocusProvide technical leadership for the Oracle Cloud HCM roadmap, ensuring solutions align with People strategy, enterprise architecture, security standards and operational priorities. Analyse business strategy, processes, services and roadmaps, and translate business needs into practical HCM solution options that clearly identify assumptions, constraints, dependencies, risks, support impacts and expected benefits. Identify opportunities to simplify and automate HR processes through Oracle platform capabilities, integrations, reporting, digital assistants and approved AI features. Build a sustainable technical capability through reusable design standards, documentation, knowledge transfer and effective vendor management. Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership Lead end-to-end delivery of Oracle Cloud HCM initiatives, enhancements and releases, including requirements elicitation and validation, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and hypercare. Lead design reviews, code and configuration reviews, defect triage and root-cause analysis for complex system issues. Maintain traceability from requirements through design, testing, approval and deployment, with complete evidence for audit and operational assurance. Identify and escalate delivery, data, control and operational risks early, with clear impact assessments and practical mitigation options.
