title: Vice President – Entertainment Pricing, Planning, Supply & Ad Products
description:
**Job Summary**

As the Vice President – Entertainment Pricing, Planning, Supply & Ad Products, you will lead the end-to-end monetization strategy and product innovation for JioHotstar’s Digital Entertainment Ads business. The role will drive revenue growth through strategic pricing, supply planning, yield optimization, programmatic partnerships and the development of scalable advertising solutions.

You will work at the intersection of product, technology, sales and monetization, translating market opportunities and advertiser needs into innovative ad products and commercially impactful solutions.

**About the Team**

JioHotstar, under the JioStar umbrella, is India’s leading streaming platform, bringing together premium video content, live sports and entertainment at scale.

The Entertainment Product & Revenue Strategy (PRS) function plays a critical role in shaping the monetization of entertainment content. The team is responsible for pricing and packaging ad inventory, optimizing yield, strengthening supply architecture and introducing innovative advertising solutions that drive sustainable revenue growth for JioHotstar and deliver on customers changing objectives.

The function works closely with Product, Engineering, Ad Operations, Business Intelligence and Sales teams to build scalable solutions and strengthen JioHotstar’s position in the digital advertising ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Monetization, Pricing & Supply Strategy**

* Lead the pricing, planning and monetization strategy for the Digital Entertainment Ads business.
* Drive supply planning, inventory optimization and yield management to maximize revenue potential.
* Develop pricing frameworks, packaging strategies and commercial propositions aligned with advertiser needs and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve monetization across devices, formats, audiences and content environments.

**2. Ad Product Innovation & Roadmap**

* Own the roadmap for advertising offerings across devices and platforms, ensuring JioHotstar’s ad solutions remain competitive and future-ready.
* Drive the development and launch of innovative ad products, formats, targeting capabilities and advertising experiences.
* Translate market trends, advertiser requirements and business opportunities into scalable product initiatives.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to define priorities, manage dependencies and ensure timely execution.

**3. Programmatic Monetization & AdTech Partnerships**

* Drive programmatic monetization strategy, including partnerships across DSPs, SSPs, exchanges and other ecosystem participants.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen programmatic yield, supply access and private marketplace offerings.
* Evaluate and enable new advertising technologies, monetization models and ecosystem partnerships.
* Ensure alignment between programmatic initiatives, commercial objectives and operational capabilities.

**4. Cross-Functional Execution**

* Lead a high-performing team of individual contributors driving ad technology and product initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Ad Operations and BI teams to deliver business-critical initiatives.
* Coordinate pilots, A/B testing, feedback loops and phased rollouts to validate solutions before scaling.
* Proactively identify risks, resolve execution roadblocks and ensure effective stakeholder alignment.

**5. Sales Enablement & Commercial Solutions**

* Partner with Sales teams to develop and commercialize packaged propositions, custom solutions and strategic advertising offerings.
* Support strategic deals by translating product capabilities into compelling advertiser solutions.
* Work with relevant teams to resolve initial technology or implementation challenges and ensure smooth adoption.
* Enable Sales teams with clear positioning, product understanding and commercial use cases.

**6. Leadership & Governance**

* Provide concise and structured updates to senior leadership on program progress, key decisions, dependencies and risks.
* Establish effective governance mechanisms to track priorities, milestones and business outcomes.
* Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration and execution excellence within the team.
* Influence senior stakeholders across business, product and technology functions to drive outcomes in a complex and evolving environment.

**Skills & Attributes for Success**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline with 14–15 years of experience in digital media, AdTech, programmatic advertising, product strategy, monetization, pricing or revenue strategy roles or management consulting experience.
* Strong people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
* Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Ad product development and innovation
* Pricing and packaging
* Programmatic monetization
* Yield and inventory management
* New advertising formats and experiences
* Deep understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, header bidding, private marketplaces and targeting will be preferred.
* Experience in digital video advertising, connected TV, streaming platforms or entertainment monetization will be an advantage.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Ad Operations and BI.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate product and monetization levers into measurable revenue impact.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Structured problem-solving approach, strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational rigour.

**About Us:**

Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and streaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.

JioStar is an equal opportunity employer. The company values diversity and its mission is to create a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. The company ensures that the work environment is free from any discrimination against persons with disabilities, gender, gender identity and any other characteristics or status that is legally protected.

title: Product Launch Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role is responsible for supporting the successful preparation and coordination of new products, features, and capabilities through effective cross-functional coordination, stakeholder management, and operational planning.
  
  
The ideal candidate excels at bringing clarity to complex initiatives, proactively identifying risks and dependencies, supporting stakeholder alignment, and coordinating execution against agreed launch plans.
  
  
They are natural communicators, critical thinkers, and problem solvers who can navigate ambiguity and ensure the team is equipped for successful product adoption and operational readiness work effectively within a complex environment and support teams in achieving product adoption and operational readiness.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Product Launch Process Execution
* Coordinate and support the execution of the product launch process across assigned products, features, and capabilities, identifying opportunities for improvement
* Coordinate launch planning activities, working with relevant stakeholders to define and track milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables
* Coordinate cross-functional launch readiness reviews, track agreed actions, and follow up with participating teams
* Support consistent and efficient execution of launch activities in line with agreed objectives, processes, and best practices
* Monitor launch progress, identify potential blockers, and work with relevant stakeholders to address or escalate issues that may impact launch success
* Operational Readiness & Excellence
* Partner with Product Management, Delivery, Support, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, and Operations teams to identify and complete readiness requirements
* Support and coordinate the development and execution of readiness plans, including process updates, training, documentation, tooling, and support models
* Apply and maintain agreed readiness frameworks, standards, and best practices, and contribute suggestions for their improvement
* Maintain launch documentation and final deliverables repositories, supporting accurate audit records and history tracking
* Create and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, and stakeholder updates for assigned launch initiatives
* Identify risks, dependencies, process gaps, and operational challenges, and support the development and tracking of appropriate mitigation actions
* Support operational discipline by documenting and tracking actions, decisions, and commitments completion
* Use agreed measures to monitor launch effectiveness and readiness outcomes, and support post-launch performance reporting and lessons learned
* Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Engagement
* Build effective relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams to support alignment, transparency, and collaboration
* Act as a key coordination point for teams involved in assigned launch and readiness activities
* Support structured decision-making by providing relevant information, highlighting competing priorities and escalating conflicting requirements where appropriate
* Work effectively across teams without direct authority, fostering collaboration, and maintaining momentum against agreed actions
* Ensure stakeholders remain informed through clear, concise, proactive, and timely communications
* Process Optimization
* Analyze existing launch and readiness activities and identify opportunities for improvement
* Use data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to recommend improvements to operational efficiency and scalability
* Contribute to the development and adoption of repeatable approaches and best practices that improve consistency across product launches
* Use appropriate AI capabilities and tools, where suitable, to support efficient delivery and execution of launch activities
* Identify and escalate significant challenges, risks, and critical pain points through the appropriate governance channels

**Qualifications**

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Anthropic**
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
  
  
Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
  
  
**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
**Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:**
Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: APAC Portfolio (Sr.) Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**

We are looking for an independent, commercially minded professional to join our Portfolio team and own the identification, evaluation, and advancement of novel pharmaceutical opportunities for our APAC markets, taking each opportunity from first signal to a clear recommendation and driving the agreed next steps.

The role will focus on innovative and differentiated assets, including NCEs, 505(b)(2) products, and other value-added pharmaceutical opportunities, assessing their strategic fit, value, and timing across our key APAC markets to decide where our time and resources are best invested.

The individual will work cross-functionally with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Business Development, Finance, and other internal teams, integrating their input into a single Portfolio view of each opportunity and a clear recommendation the business can act on.

**Scope and Decision Rights**

The Head of Portfolio APAC sets strategy, priorities, and major portfolio decisions. Within that framework, this role independently drives its own analyses, opportunities, and projects, makes recommendations, and executes the agreed actions. It is expected to move work forward without step-by-step approval and to judge when to involve others:

* **Decides directly:**
  how to scope and structure an evaluation, which data and internal experts to draw on, when a first answer is sufficient, and which opportunities to screen out against agreed criteria.
* **Aligns with the Head of Portfolio APAC:**
  recommendations to advance, pause, or stop an opportunity, changes to priorities, and positions to take with potential partners.
* **Escalates:**
  matters with material financial, legal, IP, or reputational impact, and cross-functional disagreements that cannot be resolved at working level.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own an up-to-date view of the APAC opportunity pipeline across near-, mid-, and long-term horizons, flag gaps and imbalances, and recommend areas for expansion, investment, or rationalization.
* Proactively scan global markets, pipelines, and competitor activity to identify novel product opportunities relevant to APAC, and bring forward those worth pursuing with a clear rationale.
* Lead the evaluation of shortlisted opportunities end-to-end, integrating medical, clinical, IP, regulatory, development, commercial, competitive, and market-access perspectives with timing and economics, and scaling the depth of analysis to what the decision actually requires.
* Build a working understanding of treatment guidelines, clinical practice, patient pathways, unmet needs, and physician preferences in each market, and use it to judge whether an opportunity is genuinely differentiated against current and future standards of care.
* Assess competitive landscape, product differentiation, market potential, pricing, reimbursement, and positioning, distinguishing real, reachable opportunities from theoretical ones.
* Drive product evaluations to a conclusion with Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Market Access, Medical, and Business Development teams, involving the right people at the right time and reconciling conflicting inputs.
* Build patient-based forecasts, sales potential, and scenario analyses, making key assumptions explicit and identifying which of them drive the decision.
* Identify relevant companies and assets for partnering and licensing opportunities, and recommend, together with Business Development, which to prioritize and how to approach them.
* Plan and follow through on partnering conferences: prioritize target companies, products, and meetings beforehand, and turn outcomes into agreed next steps afterwards.
* Own follow-through on assigned opportunities, keeping evaluation status, partner interactions, and follow-up actions current, and making sure agreed actions are delivered.
* Present assigned areas in periodic portfolio reviews with management in decision-ready form, highlighting key risks, gaps, growth opportunities, the recommended course of action, and the decisions required.

**Ways of Working**

We are looking for someone who, given an objective and the context, works out how to get there: think, decide, act, and follow through. In practice, this means:

* **Own the outcome, not just the task.**
  Start from what needs to be achieved, structure the problem, find and analyze the information needed, reach a conclusion, and follow through until the agreed actions are delivered.
* **Useful answers, fast.**
  Produce a solid first answer quickly, be explicit about what is fact and what is assumption, identify what is missing, and go deeper only where it would change the decision.
* **Always a recommendation.**
  Analysis ends with a position, not a list of findings: “Based on this, I recommend X because Y, and the next step is Z.”
* **Proactive.**
  Spot risks and opportunities before being asked (in an asset, market, patent situation, launch opportunity, competitive development, or portfolio assumption), raise them early, and propose how to address them.
* **Independent, not isolated.**
  Move work forward without needing approval for each step, and know when to bring in Portfolio, BD, Commercial, Regulatory, IP, Medical, Finance, or other functions.
* **Constructive challenge.**
  Question assumptions, analyses, and proposed approaches when there is good reason to, explain why, and bring a better alternative.
* **Clear and concise.**
  Communicate across functions and geographies in a structured, commercially relevant way: what is happening, why it matters, what you think, and what we should do.

**Preferred Profile**

* Degree in Medicine, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field; MBA or equivalent business training is an advantage.
* Typically 5–8 years of experience in New Product Planning, Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Commercial Strategy, Medical Affairs, or pharmaceutical consulting, including a track record of taking evaluations or projects through to a decision or outcome.
* Strong ability to interpret clinical data and translate it into commercial implications and portfolio recommendations.
* Strong analytical and forecasting skills, combined with the judgment to separate what matters from what does not and to know when an answer is good enough to act on.
* Intellectual curiosity about pharmaceutical innovation and emerging assets, with the commercial sense to tell an interesting asset from a real opportunity for the company.
* Working understanding of how IP, regulatory pathways (including 505(b)(2)), development, and market access shape the value and timing of an asset; deep expertise in every area is not required.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and willing to take a position, defend it with evidence, and revise it when the evidence changes.
* Clear, concise communicator, effective with colleagues and partners across functions, cultures, and geographies.

description:
**Job Profile –**

* Product Lead, Personal Loans
* Product Manager / Specialist, Business Loans

**Role Purpose**
The Product Lead– Personal Loans / Business Loans is responsible for the end-to-end management of the PL / BL business, including product / program development, policy formulation, pricing strategy, portfolio management, process governance, profitability (P&L) ownership, and audit/regulatory compliance. The role focuses on driving sustainable portfolio growth while optimizing risk-adjusted returns, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product & Business Management**

* Develop and manage the Loan product lifecycle, including acquisition, servicing, and portfolio expansion.
* Define product propositions, customer segments, sourcing channels, and growth strategies.
* Drive business growth while maintaining portfolio quality and profitability targets.

**Credit Policy Management**

* Formulate and periodically review underwriting and credit policies for PL / BL
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend policy changes based on risk trends, market dynamics, and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with Risk, Analytics, and Business teams to implement scorecards, cut-offs, and eligibility criteria.

**Pricing & Profitability**

* Monitor product yields, spreads, net interest margins (NIM), and return on assets (ROA).
* Own product-level P&L and profitability metrics.
* Conduct competitor benchmarking and pricing reviews to maintain market competitiveness.

**Portfolio Management**

* Track portfolio growth, delinquency trends, vintage performance, and risk-adjusted returns.
* Drive initiatives to improve portfolio quality, reduce credit losses, and optimize customer lifetime value.
* Analyze customer behavior and recommend cross-sell, retention, and portfolio enhancement strategies.

**Process Transformation**

* Streamline customer onboarding and loan fulfillment processes.
* Coordinate with Operations, Technology, and Distribution teams for process implementation and enhancements.

**Audit, Compliance & Governance**

* Manage internal, external, regulatory, and compliance audits related to unsecured lending products.
* Ensure adherence to RBI guidelines, internal policies, and governance standards.
* Drive closure of audit observations and regulatory findings within stipulated timelines.
* Establish strong controls and monitoring mechanisms to mitigate operational and compliance risks.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Risk, Collections, Analytics, Finance, Operations, Digital, Technology, and Sales teams.
* Present portfolio performance, business reviews, and strategic recommendations to senior management.
* Work closely with channel partners and fintech ecosystems to enhance sourcing efficiency.

title: AVP Business - Transition Management / Transformation Projects - Asset Management
description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Hands-on responsibility to run projects on a day to day basis.
* Lead & drive projects to deliver on our India 2.0 ambition, with a focus on strengthening our existing capabilities & build new capabilities.
* Support in building capabilities both by breadth & depth, identify & transformational opportunities to simplify our operating model & also globalize process to support all regions (UK, Europe, APAC & US).
* Plan, Manage, lead & control End to End transition of business processes by adhering to minimum standards and guidelines. In partnership with Functional Leaders and all stakeholders.
* Build controls & test controls to ensure all transitions are successful and report back to governance team.
* Perform in-depth activity analysis for identified capabilities, document value streams, build high level process maps, KT Plan, Training plan & tracker, SOP’s, KPI’s, FMEA, etc.
* Responsible for all allocated business transitions till go-live and handhold to BAU
* Use strong problem-solving skills to address challenges across multiple functions, often navigating unclear scenarios to drive practical, strategic solutions.
* Collaborate with cross functional business teams and Technology to shape and deliver initiatives, ensuring cohesive execution across departments.
* Build positive relationships with business stakeholders within the organisation.
* Challenge the status quo, thinking differently and expressing new ideas.

Key Responsibilities in Allocated Projects
  
  

* Requirements Gathering:

+ Engage with stakeholders to understand business needs, specify requirements, and document these in a clear and comprehensive manner.
+ Conduct workshops, interviews, surveys, and observation sessions to elicit detailed information.

* Analysis and Documentation:

+ Analyse business processes to identify to offshore, automate, eliminate, inefficiencies and recommend solutions.
+ Develop functional and technical specifications, ensuring they align with business requirements.
+ Create and maintain documentation including process maps, workflow diagrams, system requirement, effort analysis, skill needs, licence, market data, etc..

* Solution Design:

+ Evaluate potential solutions and recommend the most effective approach by documenting As-is & To-Be operating models
+ Detailed effort analysis, transition plan & approach, timelines, etc.
+ Collaborate with business teams to create training materials, approach, plan etc.
+ Identify risks & propose mitigation plan

* Change Management:

+ Assist in change management efforts by ensuring stakeholders are informed and prepared for changes.

**Transformation Project Management:**

* Lead end-to-end medium to highly complex Asset management projects, including identifying key subject matter experts, cross functional stakeholders, deep understanding of business cases, build project objectives, charter, workstreams, scope, resources, dependencies, weekly delivery schedules, execution plan, risk logs, critical path, escalation metrics, management information, project meetings & any other project artifacts.
* Develop and maintain high-quality project plans with built-in risk mitigation strategies, ensuring responsibilities are assigned to project resources on daily/weekly basis.
* Building in-house frameworks for In-depth activity analysis, effort analysis, control environment, skill analysis, ideation, communication, team building, process excellence, knowledge management, escalation management, etc.
* Conduct regular lessons learned sessions during the project lifecycle and incorporate learnings for future projects. Build Knowledge bank & run books for future use.
* Adhere to governance standards, including Project Change Standard and guidelines, maintaining accurate RACI and RAID logs and other project records.
* Produce timely management information and ensure completion and sign-off of mandatory documentation, project artifacts for audit & control (e.g., business case, requirement documents/user stories, stage gates, test plans, change requests, closure documents) at appropriate stages.
* Build Summary MI to Monitor and report progress to stakeholders.
* Independently identify and manage issues, risks, and dependencies, making recommendations for mitigation and escalating as necessary to maintain project progress.
* Manage relationships with required teams (e.g., Technology, external suppliers, and other business functions) to achieve timely delivery.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Accountable for delivering projects with quality & timeliness, providing expert advice or services, utilizing specialist knowledge and subject matter expertise.
* Provide solutions for challenges to overcome
* Identify and anticipate the need for changes to continuously enhance the quality and efficiency of output.

**Knowledge & Skills:**

* Extensive knowledge of GCC capabilities, Centre of Excellence (COE) models, business transformation, and technology transformation within asset management industry.
* Experience in documenting lifecycle, process mapping (L1 to L5), As-is & To-Be models, Process controls-KCA’s-CTP-CTQ, FMEA, Process metrics/KPI, data mining, and understanding various business needs, regulatory jurisdictions, and proposition design.
* Experience in Design thinking tools & techniques
* Hands-on Experience in Project management & transition management (PMP preferred)
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and apply critical thinking to complex issues.
* Proven experience in leading projects focused on delivering improvements and building capabilities.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present ideas and project updates to senior leadership.
* Commitment to fostering a work environment that embraces and values diversity.
* Attention to detail and the ability to articulate complex ideas and concepts to stakeholders.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8+ years of management experience out of which 5+ years specifically in leading transformation & change projects preferably in asset management industry (buy side) or capital markets.
* Demonstrable track record of end to end delivery of projects including transition management
* Experience of managing business transformation projects, working with both internal and external stakeholders within business function.
* Working effectively with stakeholders at different levels including executive, global leaders, Investment teams and external parties.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Graduate in any discipline, preferably in Finance or management
* PMP, Six Sigma, CI, Lean, Business Transformations, Agile certification is an added advantage.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
**Technical Consultant – Fraud & Security Intelligence**
**About The Role**
Help leading financial institutions across Asia Pacific solve complex Fraud and Financial Crime challenges through innovative analytics, AI, and enterprise technology.
  
  
As a Technical Consultant within SAS's Fraud & Security Intelligence practice, you'll work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, lead discovery workshops, design enterprise solutions, and deliver successful transformation programmes across the region.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise with business consulting while building trusted customer relationships and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead customer workshops to understand business, functional, and technical requirements.
* Design, implement, and optimize Fraud, Financial Crime, and Compliance solutions that address customer business and regulatory requirements.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs and implementation approaches.
* Deliver end-to-end solution implementation, from requirements analysis and solution configuration through testing, deployment, and post-production support.
* Lead technical workstreams and collaborate with customer business and technology teams to solve complex implementation challenges.
* Build trusted customer relationships by providing technical leadership and consulting throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop reusable delivery assets, best practices, and innovative approaches that improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to the growth of the regional consulting practice.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of consulting, enterprise software implementation, or solution delivery experience. Strong candidates with slightly less experience may also be considered.
* Experience delivering enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions within Banking, Financial Services, FinTech, or Payments organizations.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and working directly with customers, business stakeholders, and technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within regional and global delivery teams.
* Willingness to travel across Asia Pacific as required.

**Technical & Domain Expertise**

* Experience implementing enterprise Fraud, Financial Crime, or Compliance solutions.
* Experience with Financial Crime platforms such as SAS, NICE Actimize, Oracle FCCM, FICO, Quantexa, Symphony AI NetReveal, or equivalent enterprise solutions.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, Linux/Unix, ETL, APIs, cloud technologies (including Kubernetes), and enterprise application integration.
* Understanding of Fraud and Financial Crime domains including Payment Fraud, Card Fraud, Digital Banking Fraud, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), and Financial Crime Investigations.

**Who You Are**
**You are someone who:**

* Enjoys solving complex business and technology challenges.
* Takes ownership and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.
* Builds trusted relationships through professionalism, credibility, and collaboration.
* Communicates confidently with customers, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Has a growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning and mastering new technologies.
* Thrives in collaborative, multicultural consulting environments.
* Is passionate about helping customers combat fraud and financial crime.
* Aspires to become a Solution Architect, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader.

**Career Growth**
At SAS, you'll work on some of the largest Fraud and Financial Crime transformation programmes across Asia Pacific while collaborating with industry experts and leading financial institutions.
  
  
This role provides an excellent opportunity to build deep expertise across Fraud & Security Intelligence solutions while progressing towards Solution Architect, Project Lead, Consulting Manager, or Practice Leader roles within SAS Professional Services.
  
  
You'll be encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, continuously develop your expertise, and contribute to the growth of one of Asia Pacific's leading Fraud & Security Intelligence consulting practices.

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
  
  
Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7+ years of leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise-level IT engagements

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**JOB TITLE - SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER – ENGAGEMENT, PERSONALISATION & AI**

**LOCATION: NAVI MUMBAI, INDIA (GHANSOLI)**

**OUR STORY:**

JioSaavn is South Asia’s leading audio streaming service to access, discover, and listen to favourite songs & Podcasts across languages and genres. We blend digital technology, data analysis (which we have affectionately coined Music Science), and a strong, fearless business acumen to reach all corners of the globe. Our award-winning mobile products, partnerships, innovations and thought leadership have been featured in some of the world’s leading publications, from The New York Times, to The Wall Street Journal, The Economic Times to Forbes, and many more.

**OUR CULTURE:**

At JioSaavn, we ignite passion and performance to work towards a collective goal: creating the perfect mobile entertainment ecosystem that delivers the best possible music experience to millions of listeners around the world. Our default mode is that of perpetual innovation. Together, we form a concerted rhythm that goes beyond borders. We don't just go with the flow, we create it.

JioSaavn offers a dynamic and unconventional work environment, full of fun wholesome experience. We believe creativity and technology blend together like sweet melodies. When you choose JioSaavn, you join a diverse world of high-calibre techies, artists, and inventors hailing from companies like Yahoo!, Twitter, LinkedIn, Google, Qualcomm, HBO, Microsoft, Flipkart, Amazon, Paytm, Quikr etc.

Our value-based, people-first work culture is about empowering every individual in our team to be catalysts for change in this dynamic digital world. Every day is an opportunity to bring your vision to life, and to expand, learn and grow. No idea is left unconsidered. No voice is left unheard.

JioSaavn prides itself on being an equal opportunity employer. We have committed ourselves to creating a safe environment with fair and equal access and opportunities, sans discrimination. We encourage everyone to be open to experiences and perspectives beyond their normal; divergent thinkers create differentiated products, and even better music.

If our vibe matches with yours, we'd love to hear from you.

**ROLE:**

JioSaavn is looking for a Senior Product Manager to enhance our personalization and recommendation systems. You’ll collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to create a world-class engagement experience. Your mission is to help our AI deliver the most relevant content recommendations on the Homepage and Player, ensuring a seamless and personalized user journey.

This role demands deep expertise in data-driven decision-making and customer experience. You’ll drive experiments, launch impactful features, and continuously refine engagement strategies to create delightful, personalized listening experiences. If you thrive on data, user insights, and innovation, this is the role for you.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Strategy & Vision –**

* Define and communicate a clear product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and user feedback to identify growth opportunities.
* Establish and track key engagement and personalization metrics to measure success.
* Champion customer-first thinking, ensuring product decisions enhance user experience.
* Drive alignment across leadership and cross-functional teams to prioritize high-impact initiatives.
* Challenge the status quo—question everything and never settle.

**Execution & Optimization –**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation to launch and continuous optimization.
* Translate business goals into implementable features and solutions.
* Work closely with AI leads to identify gaps and enhance Homepage & Player recommendation systems.
* Leverage engagement data to uncover user behaviors, trends, and insights that strengthen recommendations.
* Design and execute A/B tests to optimize personalization and maximize engagement.
* Balance short-term quick wins with long-term strategic improvements to drive sustainable growth.

**Processes-**

* Maintain clear, structured documentation for product requirements, roadmaps, and updates.
* Streamline product development workflows, ensuring efficiency and cross-team collaboration.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and iteration.
* Ensure seamless stakeholder communication and alignment across departments.
* Implement Agile best practices to enhance team productivity and execution speed

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science from a Tier 1 institution.
* 6+ years of experience, including 4+ years as a Product Manager and 2+ years in Recommendations or Personalization features.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML models, concepts, and data science related to recommendation systems.
* Proven experience in building B2C products or features focused on Engagement and Retention.
* Expertise in designing and executing A/B tests to drive data-backed product decisions.
* Intermediate proficiency in SQL/NoSQL for data analysis.
* Experience in user research and behavioral analysis.
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and execution-focused.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies and JIRA.

**Bonus:**
Ideally, you’ll also meet at least a few of the following requirements

* Experience working directly with AI/ML teams to build and optimize recommendation models.
* Background in data science and complex querying.
* Previous experience with Music, OTT, or Entertainment products.
* Understanding of front-end and back-end development processes.
* Ability to design user-friendly interfaces and wireframes for enhanced engagement.

**BENEFITS AND PERKS:**

At JioSaavn, we blur work and play, and you get all the perks of a global company. You will get to work with a dynamic group of entrepreneurs, who are delivering results and working zealously to make a difference in the way the world experiences music.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Master Data Management
description:
**Sr. Product Manager – Master Data Management**
Ingram Micro is looking for an experienced Sr. Product Manager to drive the roadmap and execution of key master data initiatives that shape the foundation of how our business operates. This is an important role in Ingram Micro's company-wide master data transformation journey — helping build the data structures, governance frameworks, and product experiences that power trusted, consistent, and scalable data across the enterprise.
  
  
The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to shape and deliver a product roadmap for their domain, prioritize initiatives informed by data, and drive execution in partnership with data engineering, enterprise architecture, and business operations stakeholders.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Drive the product roadmap and execution for one or more master data domains by deeply understanding business needs, data quality challenges, and the evolving enterprise data landscape.
* Advance a unified approach to master data — including product, customer, vendor, and financial data domains — ensuring consistency, accuracy, and accessibility across the organization.
* Design and improve data governance processes, data stewardship workflows, and master data lifecycle management experiences that empower business users and reduce friction.
* Collaborate with Experience Design, Engineering, Analytics, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Business Operations teams to define, develop, and launch master data solutions and capabilities.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement to eliminate data quality issues, reduce manual data handling, and deliver measurable business outcomes such as time savings, cost reduction, and improved decision-making.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to understand how master data flows across systems, identify gaps, and lead initiatives that improve data reliability and trustworthiness across the enterprise.
* Monitor and analyze the health and adoption of master data products, using insights to inform the ongoing transformation roadmap.

**You Have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in product management, with a strong preference for experience in data, platform, or enterprise product domains.
* 3+ years of experience building products or platforms for B2B environments, ideally with exposure to data management, ERP systems, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience working with cross-functional go-to-market and operations teams to drive adoption of internal data products and capabilities across business units.
* Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts, data governance frameworks, and data quality principles strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of analytics tools such as Looker or Adobe Analytics, as well as data pipeline or integration concepts, preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable product decisions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and business teams.

description:

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting & Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support & Regulatory reporting. CFO Change Automation team, which is part of CFO COO group in involved in various analytics, automation and reporting & governance needs that helps the CFO group analyze and address key challenges & provide relevant solutions using ET or any other relevant technologies. description:

**Position Summary**
**SAP PaPM - Tax Technology Services Consultant II**
Join Deloitte’s Tax Management Consulting team and support global clients as they modernize tax operations through SAP-enabled transformation. As an SAP PaPM -Tax Technology Services Consultant II, you will help translate tax and business requirements into scalable technology solutions that support complex business change. This role offers the opportunity to work across large transformation programs, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and contribute to the design and delivery of tax technology solutions within SAP environments.

* Evaluating client tax and business requirements to define SAP PaPM and broader tax technology solution designs
* Translating functional requirements into system design specifications and supporting configuration, build, testing, and deployment activities
* Assessing current-state processes, supply chains, and systems landscapes to identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities
* Coordinating with client stakeholders, internal teams, and systems integration partners to communicate status, resolve issues, and support project delivery
* Contributing to demos, solution assets, and internal accelerators that support Deloitte’s S/4HANA Tax Value Proposition

**The team**
Tax Management Consulting brings together consulting, technology, tax, and tax reporting experience to help organizations address multi-jurisdictional tax operations, compliance, reporting, tax technology, and tax risk management. Within this practice, the S/4HANA Tax Value Proposition supports SAP-enabled business transformation by helping clients design and implement tax solutions that align with broader enterprise processes. Professionals on this team work across complex transformation programs with Deloitte practitioners and client stakeholders to deliver practical, scalable tax technology solutions.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad / Bangalore / Gurgaon / Mumbai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
Regular business hours
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Taxation; or MBA; or Chartered Accountant qualification
* 3-7 years of experience in SAP or SAP S/4HANA

title: Sr. Manager - Platform Products
description:
**Synopsis of the role:**
As the Platform Product Manager, you will be the product owner of Equifax India’s core data and decisioningplatforms. Your customers are both internal product teams (Retail, Commercial, Workforce Solutions) and external developer teams at top banks and FinTechs who consume our APIs. You will manage the lifecycle of our high-scale API gateways, tokenization registries, entity resolution (identity matching) algorithms, and orchestration engines. This role demands a deeply technical product leader who can bridge the gap between complex cloud architecture and commercial product usability, ensuring our platforms are scalable, reliable, and compliant.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and execute the roadmap for Equifax India's underlying data platform infrastructure. Modernize and scale the platform to handle multi-tenant cloud deployments, high-throughput batch loads, and sub-second real-time API performance.
* Standardize and manage Equifax India's API architecture, developer portals, and software development kits (SDKs). Ensure seamless, secure, and developer-friendly onboarding for external B2B clients.
* Prioritize platform architectural upgrades, security patching, and scalability.
* Define and track core platform KPIs such as API Uptime (SLAs), Latency (p99 metrics), and Match Rates.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects, Cloud Engineers, Infosec, Data Science, and Application Product
* Managers to ensure the underlying platform seamlessly supports new product launches.
* Embed data governance, access controls, data localization frameworks, and compliance policies (such as the DPDP Act and RBI guidelines) directly into the platform architecture by design.
* Maintain a continuous pulse on the global Equifax product portfolio.
* Proactively evaluate global platform capabilities and determine their feasibility for the Indian market.
* Translate global technology features into tangible business solutions for the Indian BFSI ecosystem.
* Partner with local business units to build business cases and pilot frameworks for imported global assets.
* Represent Equifax India in global platform governance councils. Articulate the region's technical requirements, market urgency, and regulatory mandates (such as the DPDP Act and RBI directives) to secure global engineering bandwidth and funding.
* Own the local sprint execution, API strategy and data orchestration frameworks.
* Ensure that local modifications gracefully co-exist with global core platform architecture without creating technical debt.
* Act as the single source of truth for global platform updates within Equifax India.
* Conduct regular enablement sessions for local product managers, sales engineers, and leadership to keep them aligned with upcoming global capabilities.

**What Experience You Need**

* 8+ years of professional experience, with at least 4+ years as a Platform/Technical Product Manager operating within a global cross-functional setup.
* Proven experience working across international time zones and collaborating with distributed engineering and product hubs (specifically US or European counterparts).
* Strong understanding of global cloud-native infrastructures (AWS or GCP), microservices architecture, enterprise API management, data lakehouse designs, and real-time event streaming.
* Demonstrated ability to take a global enterprise product or software capability and successfully modify,localize, and commercialize it for a distinct regional market.
* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a highly quantitative discipline.

**What Could Set You Apart**

* Exceptional stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to influence global engineering leaders and corporate executives to prioritize regional initiatives without having direct reporting authority over them.
* Ability to articulate complex, localized Indian financial market nuances (e.g., the Account Aggregator network, UPI volumes, localized bureau data formatting) into generalized technical concepts that global teams can easily grasp.
* Experience working with Scaled Agile Frameworks (SAFe) or managing complex dependencies across multiple global Jira backlogs and CI/CD deployment release cycles.
* Clear understanding of Indian data residency, localization mandates, and data privacy principles governed by the DPDP Act.

You will champion an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology from a management perspective, tracking program health, team velocity, and delivery efficiency.

title: Strategy Leader
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As a Strategy Leader within Grid Technologies and a key member of the Strategy & Sustainability team, you will shape the direction of one of the world’s most critical energy businesses. You will drive high-impact strategic projects across our global GT portfolio, working closely with business leaders and operational units to translate business needs into actionable initiatives.
  
  
Your day is a mix of solving complex problems, working with cross-functional teams, engaging senior stakeholders, and challenging how we operate today to build what the grid needs tomorrow. This role offers an exceptional springboard for a global career within Siemens Energy after +2 years in the Strategy team.

* Drive preparation for Executive Board decisions through management reviews, strategy updates, and external presentations.
* Support special strategic initiatives and one-off projects requiring fast problem solving and senior stakeholder engagement.

* Develop continuously through on-the-job learning, coaching from senior colleagues, and dedicated trainings and job-shadowing programs.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in Strategy, with a strong track record in strategic initiatives, market analysis, and end-to-end project management.
* At least 2 years experience in the Energy sector, ideally within Grid Technologies or adjacent segments, with strong understanding of industry dynamics and current trends.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and organizational layers, mobilizing resources and driving alignment in complex environments.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and build compelling, data-driven recommendations.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* High-performance orientation—you consistently meet or exceed objectives and thrive under tight deadlines.
* Solution-driven mindset with a willingness to “go the extra mile” and deliver results with ownership and autonomy.
* A collaborative team spirit, enjoying the opportunity to work with highly motivated colleagues and possessing strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

**About The Team**
Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Opportunity for remote/flexible work

* Professional development opportunities within the company

description:
***About MetaMorph:***

We at MetaMorph, empower startups to scale and innovate by placing people at the center of their strategy. With a proven track record of supporting over 220 startups, we specialize in aligning talent with organizational needs, enhancing employee skills, and transforming employer brands. We are pre-revenue and launch within the next quarter, with Amazon and quick commerce as core

launch channels. These channels are also where margins are won or lost, through ad spend, fees, fulfilment and discounting. We need one senior owner who has taken brands from zero on these platforms and can give every brand a shared playbook, the right team and open doors at the platforms. This person designs the playbook and the org behind it, and does not run campaigns

day to day.

title: Sr. Product & Automation Lead
description:
**Company:**
Scale100x.ai by Expertrons

**Location:**
Mumbai (Work from Office)

**Compensation:**
Between ₹15 LPA to 20 LPA (Fixed + Variable) + ESOPs + milestone-based compensation growth

**Experience:**
5+ years

**About Scale100x.ai**

Scale100x.ai is the world's first AI-powered growth accelerator helping consumer brands scale through partner expansion. Built by the founders of Expertrons, we are serial entrepreneurs and IIT Bombay alumni who have built and exited ventures and scaled 300+ franchise networks across industries.

We partner with high-potential brands to:

* Build 100+ offline outlets/partners per year
* Use AI agents to supercharge sales and marketing execution
* Improve profitability through data-driven operations
* Support fundraising, investor relations and IPO readiness

In the last year we've driven scale for brands across EV, F&B, Salon, Retail, EdTech, Play Areas and more, including helping one brand close a $5.4M Series A. Our sales engine runs on high-volume, WhatsApp-first lead flow, and we are rebuilding it to be AI-native.

**The Role**

We are moving from LeadSquared to an AI-native CRM and want to put AI agents at the center of how we sell, follow up, onboard and report. You will own that transformation end to end: choosing the platform, migrating without losing a single lead, and building the agents and automations that run on top of it, across our different verticals.

This is a builder's role. You will work directly with the founders, and you should be as comfortable in a CRM admin panel or an n8n workflow as in a leadership review.

**What You'll Own**

**1. CRM selection and migration (LeadSquared → AI-native CRM)**

* Evaluate AI-native CRM options against our needs (cost, WhatsApp and telephony support, agent capabilities, integrations) and make a clear recommendation.
* Plan and run the migration: data cleanup and mapping, pipeline redesign, integrations, cutover and parallel run.
* Drive team adoption so that data quality and usage improve after the switch, not just the tooling.

**2. AI agents and automation across verticals**

* Map the lead-to-onboarding journey (enquiry, qualification, commercials, agreement, onboarding) and identify what agents can own and where a human must stay in the loop.
* Build and deploy agents and automations for lead qualification, follow-ups, call summaries, CRM updates, reminders and reporting.
* Adapt and reuse these workflows across verticals such as EV, F&B, Salon, Retail and EdTech, and over time package them for client brands.
* Measure every automation on time saved, response time and conversion impact.

**3. Integrations and systems**

* Connect the CRM with WhatsApp Business API, telephony/IVR, e-sign, email, finance and internal tools using APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code platforms.
* Own reliability: monitoring, fallbacks and documentation.

**4. Analytics and ROI**

* Build dashboards for pipeline health, leakage by stage, agent performance and revenue outcomes.
* Build the business case for each initiative and report results to the founders.

**5. Ownership and execution**

* Run projects from problem definition to rollout with clear milestones and accountability.
* Work with sales, operations, product and tech teams, and flag risks and dependencies early.

**Must-Haves**

* 5+ years in CRM implementation, business systems, revenue operations, product operations or automation-led roles.
* Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a CRM (LeadSquared, HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar), including at least one full data migration and cutover.
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM-based automations in production. Please share a workflow you built and its outcome.
* Fluency with APIs, webhooks and no-code/low-code tools (n8n, Make, Zapier or similar).
* Experience integrating WhatsApp Business API and telephony/IVR into a sales workflow.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define metrics, build dashboards and quantify ROI.
* Ability to work independently with founders and cross-functional teams, with clear written and verbal communication.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with AI-native CRM platforms.
* Background in high-volume, lead-driven businesses such as franchising, edtech, real estate or D2C.
* Exposure to product strategy or product operations, and to financial modelling.
* Startup, consulting or SaaS experience.

**What We Expect**

* **Ownership:**
  you drive initiatives without continuous supervision.
* **Execution:**
  you move from recommendation to live implementation.
* **Business sense:**
  you connect every system and automation to a measurable outcome.
* **Structured problem-solving:**
  you frame the problem, test quickly and iterate.

**Who Should Apply**

Builders from CRM, revenue operations, automation, product operations or business systems backgrounds who have shipped real migrations and real automations, and want to do it at the intersection of AI, growth and franchising.

title: Associate - Global Program Management
description:

You will define and translate Finance requirements by partnering with Finance subject matter experts to develop functional specifications and communicate needs to technology teams. * Produce crisp written updates and executive-ready status reporting, and facilitate meetings effectively
* Identify, assess, and mitigate risks and issues with a control-minded approach to delivery

title: Want to Build the Technology that could Reinvent 3PL & E-COMMERCE / Q-COMMERCE Supply Chains?
