**Senior Software Engineering:**

**E-Commerce Marketplaces & AI Supply chain & Logistics Tech Product Build**

**Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd. - www.goldfishh.com**

We’re looking for a senior technology builder who doesn’t just want to maintain software — but wants to
**architect and build technology products from the ground up.**

Goldfishh operates at the intersection of
**Supply Chain, Warehousing, 3PL, E-Commerce and Marketplace Commerce**
. As we scale our physical and digital ecosystem, we are embarking on an ambitious technology journey to build
**AI-powered platforms that can fundamentally change how businesses manage warehousing, fulfilment, logistics and marketplace commerce.**

We are looking for an experienced
**Software Engineering / Product Technology leader**
who wants to be part of this journey from an early stage.

**What You Will Build**

You will play a key role in architecting and developing technology platforms across:

•
**N2N / Multi-Sided Digital Marketplaces**
connecting businesses, service providers, infrastructure and supply-chain capacity.

•
**E-Commerce & Marketplace Technology**
integrating marketplaces, D2C platforms, OMS, WMS, inventory, fulfilment, advertising, pricing and revenue optimisation.

•
**Warehousing & 3PL Technology**
for distributed warehouse networks, fulfilment operations, inventory visibility and supply-chain orchestration.

•
**AI-Native Products & Agents**
using Generative AI, LLMs, machine learning, intelligent automation and agentic workflows.

•
**Data & Decision Intelligence**
capable of converting large volumes of operational, commercial and marketplace data into actionable recommendations.

•
**APIs & Integrations**
connecting ERP, WMS, OMS, TMS, marketplaces, e-commerce platforms, logistics partners and enterprise systems.

The objective is not simply to digitise existing processes.

**We want to rethink them.**

**Who We Are Looking For**

You should ideally have:

•
**10–15+ years of software engineering / technology product development experience.**

• BE / BTech or equivalent engineering degree, preferably from a
**premier engineering institution**
.

• Strong hands-on experience architecting and building
**scalable technology products**
, preferably within technology startups or high-growth product companies.

• Proven experience with
**N2N / B2B / B2C marketplaces, e-commerce platforms or multi-sided digital ecosystems**
.

• Strong understanding of modern
**cloud-native architecture, APIs, microservices, databases and scalable distributed systems**
.

• Practical experience designing or building products using
**Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, machine learning or AI-driven automation**
.

• Ability to think simultaneously as a
**Product Architect, Software Engineer and Technology Innovator**
.

• Experience taking products from
**concept → architecture → MVP → production → scale**
.

Most importantly, you should still enjoy
**building**
.

We are not looking for someone whose role has become entirely managerial. We want a senior technologist who can define architecture, make critical engineering decisions, work with developers and remain close to the product and the code.

**Technology Stack & AI-Native Architecture**

We intend to build Goldfishh’s technology platform as a
**cloud-native, API-first, modular and AI-native architecture designed for an Agentic AI future**

. The preferred technology ecosystem will include
**Python and TypeScript/Node.js**

, modern web frameworks such as
**React/Next.js**

,
**PostgreSQL and NoSQL/vector databases**

, containerised microservices using
**Docker/Kubernetes**

, and scalable cloud infrastructure on
**AWS/Azure/GCP**

. The AI layer will leverage
**LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, embeddings, vector search, knowledge graphs, MCP, tool/function calling and multi-agent orchestration frameworks**

, with the flexibility to work across leading foundation models and open-source models rather than becoming dependent on a single AI provider. The architecture should enable autonomous AI Agents to securely interact with our
**futuristic N2N Marketplace, WMS, OMS, TMS, ERP, e-commerce, logistics and external partner systems through APIs and event-driven workflows**

. We are looking for an engineer who can help us make the right technology choices in discussion with the core team while designing an architecture capable of evolving towards
**AI Agents that can reason, plan, execute, collaborate and automate increasingly complex supply-chain and commerce workflows.**

**Why Goldfishh?**

Goldfishh is 6 year old Tech stratup building at the intersection of two enormous ecosystems:

**Physical Supply Chains × Digital Commerce.**
Our operating businesses across warehousing, 3PL, logistics and e-commerce give us something particularly valuable for technology innovation:
**Real customers. Real warehouses. Real inventory. Real transactions. Real operational problems to solve.**

Our ambition is to convert that operating experience into
**disruptive, scalable technology products for the supply-chain and commerce ecosystem.**

**Our founding team comprises BITS Pilani / IIT alumni, bringing deep domain expertise, entrepreneurial experience and strong technology-product DNA. We are now preparing for our first institutional VC fundraise to accelerate the next phase of growth.**
We deliberately stayed away from VC funding in our formative years—choosing to first build the business, prove the model, acquire customers and generate revenues. Now, we believe the time is right to scale with external capital.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to look back a few years from now and say:

**“I helped architect and build that from Day One.”**

**This role could be right for you if…**

You have spent years building technology products, but your next chapter is not about joining another large engineering organisation.

You want
**ownership, experimentation, speed and the opportunity to create something genuinely new.**

If that sounds interesting, we would like to talk.

**Experience:**
10–15+ years

**Domain:**
SaaS | Marketplaces | E-Commerce | Supply Chain | AI

**Education:**
BE / BTech or equivalent, preferably from a premier engineering institution

**Company:**
Goldfishh Supply Chain Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

**Website:**
www.goldfishh.com

title: Entrepreneur in Residence ( Fresher )
description:
About Clinderma

Clinderma is a tech-first teledermatology and prescription skincare company, incubated at IIT Madras. We've treated ~4,000 patients for acne and pigmentation — most of them came to us after nothing else worked.

We pair an AI skin system that learns each person's skin over time with real dermatologists and a human skin-coach layer. The goal: become the lifelong system of record for a person's skin, from acne to pigmentation to anti-aging.

Retention is strong — people stay once they're in. The problem we need solved is getting more of the right people in the door.

The role

You'll own Clinderma's growth engine end to end — acquisition, brand and content — and build it into a repeatable machine. This is a founder-level seat, not a marketing-manager role: you set strategy, run experiments yourself, and lead the content and marketing team.

Why EIR: we want someone who has built or wants to build a company, and who treats this as their own P&L. Strong performers can graduate into a leadership role or lead a new business line we incubate together.

What you'll own

**Acquisition (organic-first)**

* Build and scale organic channels — Instagram Reels (Hindi/Hinglish), YouTube, SEO, WhatsApp, community and referrals
* Grow and optimise the free AI skin test as our main lead magnet, and the funnel from test → consult → paid plan
* Run partnerships and offline channels: creators, clinics, colleges, corporate wellness
* Set up paid acquisition when budget opens up, with compliance for prescription-adjacent skincare (Meta policy, ASCI, NMC, CCPA)

**Brand and positioning**

* Sharpen how Clinderma stands - dermatologist-grade care, skin health beyond acne
* Own the brand voice through the shift to a warmer, more playful tone
* Build a face for the brand that isn't the founders: doctors within compliance, UGC creators, patient stories

**Content engine**

* Set the content strategy, pillars and calendar; lead the marketing manager and video editor
* Turn 4,000+ patient journeys into proof — before/afters, case stories, behind-the-scenes
* Ship hooks, scripts and formats fast; kill what doesn't work

**Growth systems**

* Own the funnel dashboard: CAC by channel, test-to-consult, consult-to-paid, payback
* Run a weekly experiment cadence and report learnings to founders
* Work with product on growth loops in the app and website

title: Expert - Sourcing Tools
description:

**SUSTAINABLE, AGILE, CONNECTED, FORWARD LOOKING**

**Job Purpose:**

Drive successful deployment, user adoption, and continuous improvement of CLM tools and integrations, ensuring compliance with procurement standards and policies. Act as the primary point of contact for system administration, run support, and change management, delivering service excellence.

Document business requirements with BPOs and translate them into automated tool workflows. **Roll-out Management:**

* Coordinate within Procurement the release management, change requests, and incident handling to ensure business continuity.

**Run Administration:**

* Act as system administrator for CLM applications, managing configurations, workflows, and integrations. In charge of the application governance.
* Monitor system performance, manage ticket triage, and implement measures to reduce incidents.
* Conduct service reviews and ensure SLA compliance for support activities.

**Continuous Improvement & Governance:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify process optimization opportunities.
* Maintain governance of templates, clauses, and metadata in CLM systems.
* Drive automation initiatives and apply AI/LCNC tools to enhance efficiency.
* Explore and define use cases of new/additional CLM modules

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Act as liaison between Global Project Managers, Business Process Owners, IT teams, and external providers.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships and influence adoption of best practices.
* Coach stakeholders on advanced automation and contract AI solutions; propose improvements for system usage and process efficiency.
* Represent Procurement in technical alignments at the CLM platform level.

**Your profile:**

* Strong knowledge of Contract Lifecycle Management and S2C processes.
* Expert knowledge in configuring and testing contract lifecycle management tool
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Ability to manage complex projects in a global environment with minimal supervision.
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and with the ability to present technical details to a non-technical audience
* Proficiency in MS Office, integration technologies, and automation tools (Power Automate).
* Fluent in English;
* Strong understanding of contract management processes, including contract analysis, extraction, and lifecycle management.
* High self-motivation, solution-oriented thinking and creativity
* Ability to stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies in CLM, AI and automation.
* Service mindset to continuously delivery excellent service.

**Experience Level:**

* More than 3–5 years in procurement digitalization, CLM/eSourcing tools
* Hands-on experience with CLM platforms (e.g., Sirion Labs, Jaggaer).
* Proven track record in managing IT projects in matrix organization and support processes.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead and drive initiatives from conception to implementation and within scope/costs/quality.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor degree, ideally also Master degree (preferably in business administration, IT, Data Science, Technology, science) or equivalent
  
  
**We offer:**

* Great opportunity to work for the biggest logistics company in the world
* International and virtual environment

DHL Group is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
**Description**
*Position at Ziff Davis*
Product Support Specialist
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
We are seeking a Product Support Specialist to act as the bridge between Dwell subscribers and our engineering team. In this role, you will report to the director of revenue products. In this hybrid role, you will spend part of your time leading high-touch customer support and relationship management, and the other part translating those frontline insights into the product roadmap. You understand user pain points firsthand because you talk to customers every day, and you have the technical and strategic skills to build permanent solutions into our software or service offerings.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Customer Service & Advocacy
  
  

* Customer Support Response Management: Handle approximately 200 customer support tickets per week for Dwell brand subscribers, including email tickets and phone support for customer voicemails
* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience
* Third-Party Coordination: Collaborate with Dwell Magazine's fulfillment partner, CDS Global, to resolve complex customer issues that cannot be addressed through Stripe's platform capabilities
* Client Enablement: Create and update customer-facing knowledge bases, release notes, training materials, and troubleshooting guides.
* Relationship Management: Build trust-based relationships with subscribers, gathering qualitative feedback on product experience.

Product Management
  
  

* Feedback Synthesis: Analyze support ticket trends, churn reasons, and customer feature requests to identify systemic product gaps.
* Roadmap Prioritization: Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing urgent customer fixes with long-term strategic product goals.
* Requirements Definition: Write Product Requirements Documents and user stories for the engineering and design teams.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate with engineering, QA, and marketing to guide features from concept through launch, ensuring the support team is fully trained before release.
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) including Customer Satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Retention/Churn, and Feature Adoption Rates.
* Report monthly insights to executive leadership regarding how product updates impact customer happiness and business revenue.

* Experience: 3+ years of combined experience in customer service management, customer success, or technical support, alongside 2+ years in an associate product manager or product-adjacent role.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Customer Empathy: Exceptional listening, patience, and written/verbal communication skills with a proven track record of de-escalating frustrated clients.
* Product Sense: Ability to look at a repetitive customer complaint and conceptualize a scalable, software-driven solution.
* Experience using modern helpdesk software (e.g., Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud) and product management tools (e.g., Jira, Productboard, Linear, Asana).
* Preferred: basic technical literacy (familiarity with API logs, SQL, or web technologies) to effectively communicate tradeoffs with engineering teams.

title: Senior Manager/ Manager - Process Excellence
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance**

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear: to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution, and people who want to build what's next. If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here.

**About the Role**

**This isn't a typical process or operations role.**

You will build and own the Process Excellence function within CoinDCX's Customer Experience organisation: the discipline that decides why CX processes break and how they get fixed for good, not just how a single ticket gets resolved. This is a high-impact role that sits at the intersection of process governance, root cause analysis, and regulatory risk, directly shaping how millions of Indian customers experience crypto. You'll define the standards the frontline operates against, run the root cause discipline that turns escalation patterns into structural fixes, and hold a formal line into Risk and Compliance, making this one of the most foundational roles in our Customer Experience function.

**What You'll Do**

**Process Governance & SOP Ownership**

* Own the single source of truth for CX SOPs and playbooks, including version control and audit trails.
* Run staleness audits to ensure SOPs are updated within a defined window of any related policy or product change.
* Chair the Process Governance Forum with Product, Ops, Tech, and QA to review and approve process changes before rollout.

**Root Cause Analysis & Structural Fixes**

* Analyse escalation, repeat contact, and complaint data to identify root causes, using structured problem-solving methods such as DMAIC, 5 Whys, or fishbone analysis.
* Convert findings into structural fixes and route them to the correct owner in Product, Ops, or Policy, tracking each one through to closure.
* Own RCA cycle time as a core performance metric, and drive down repeat contacts tied to process, not agent, causes.

**Process Mapping, Value Stream Analysis & Automation**

* Map and continuously refine CX process flows end to end, identifying redundant handoffs, manual steps, and friction points.
* Identify and prioritise automation opportunities, building the business case in partnership with Tech and Engineering, who own build and deployment.

**Risk & Compliance Process Governance**

* Run a standing monthly review with Risk and Compliance on process gaps carrying fraud, AML/KYC, or regulatory exposure.
* Ensure no process change affecting a Risk or Compliance-tagged workflow goes live without sign-off from that review.

**Data Analysis & Insights**

* Perform deep-dive analysis on escalation trends, complaint drivers, SOP staleness, and automation ROI.
* Build and maintain a KPI tree covering SOP coverage, RCA cycle time, escalation reduction, and automation throughput.
* Translate insights into a prioritised, quantified roadmap rather than a running list of observations.

**Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership**

* Collaborate closely with QA, Ops, WFM, Product, Tech, and Risk & Compliance to keep process ownership clean and non-overlapping.
* Lead adoption tracking, training handoff, and post-launch adherence checks for every process rollout, since a change that isn't adopted isn't a fix.
* Act as the bridge between what leadership expects and what actually happens on the ground, and be direct when the two don't match.

**You'll Excel in This Role If You**

* Think in root causes, not symptoms, and build systems to prevent problems rather than waiting for them to escalate.
* Are obsessed with data and evidence, and use it to decide what to fix first, not instinct alone.
* Thrive in ambiguity and can bring structure to processes that today only live in people's heads.
* Communicate with precision, equally credible in a Risk and Compliance review and a frontline training session.
* Have a strong bias for action and a track record of shipping fixes, not just documenting problems.
* Can balance systems thinking (governance, frameworks, standards) with hands-on execution (process maps, SOP rewrites, RCA deep dives).
* Are comfortable being the person who challenges the status quo across teams that don't report to you.

**You'll Know You're Winning When**

**Key Success Metrics for the First 6 Months**

* A full SOP inventory is live with staleness flags, and the highest-priority SOPs are updated and version-controlled.
* The top 10 escalation themes by volume and cost are diagnosed with root causes identified, and at least two to three structural fixes are shipped.
* The Process Governance Forum and the Risk & Compliance Joint Review are stood up and running on a defined cadence.
* A live, prioritised automation opportunity pipeline exists with quantified impact.
* You've built trust-based working relationships with QA, Ops, Product, Tech, and Risk & Compliance leadership.

**Why This Role Matters & What's In It For You**

Process is the backbone of trust at CoinDCX. In a high-stakes, regulated, and fast-moving industry like crypto, a process that breaks isn't just a customer experience problem, it's a fraud vector or a compliance finding waiting to happen. This role gives you the mandate to build that backbone from the ground up, with direct visibility into leadership decisions, a formal seat in Risk and Compliance conversations, and the rare opportunity to design how CX processes work as CoinDCX scales, rather than inheriting someone else's system.

**What You'll Need**

* 6 to 8 years of experience in process excellence, continuous improvement, or operational excellence, preferably within customer experience, contact centre, or BPO environments.
* Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or DMAIC.
* Demonstrated track record of owning SOP or knowledge base governance and running root-cause-to-fix cycles, not just producing analysis.
* Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, or dashboards to interpret complex data.
* Experience building process flow diagrams using tools such as LucidChart, Miro, or Visio.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional change and secure process adoption from teams that do not report into this role.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including comfort presenting to senior leadership, Risk, and Compliance.
* Working familiarity with CRMs like Sprinklr, FreshDesk, ZenDesk, or similar platforms.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in fintech, crypto, or high-growth startups.
* Prior exposure to AML, KYC, or fraud risk processes in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of automation, workflows, or RPA-driven process redesign.
* Exposure to tools like SQL, Power BI, or other data visualisation platforms.

**Hiring Process**

Here's what your journey with us looks like:

* Application Review: We assess for skills, process depth, and intent.
* Recruiter Connect: A short conversation to understand you better.
* Functional Round(s): Deep dive into your approach to process governance, root cause analysis, and stakeholder management [2 rounds]
* Culture & Values Discussion: A conversation about our ways of working and how you thrive best.

**Where We Work**

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed, and trust come alive when teams share the same space. With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office, with occasional travel for process audits where required.

**Perks That Empower You**

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle.
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need.
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources.
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities.

**Ready to Build What's Next?**

If you're looking for a role that gives you the mandate to build a function from scratch, direct ownership of how CoinDCX's CX processes hold up at scale, and a seat in the room where Risk, Product, and Leadership make decisions, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

title: Product (AM) - Source-to-Pay (S2P)
description:
**Role Overview**
The SAP Process Owner(S2P) is an in-house leader answerable for end-to-end operational and business outcomes across procurement, supply chain, warehouse management, and accounts payable. Rather than acting as a single-module specialist or coordinator, this role translates business problems into structured requirements, conducts functional design reviews, and oversees cross-module execution across SAP MM, PP and EWM
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

**Outcome Ownership:**
Own business deliverables across the S2P stream, taking accountability for final business results rather than closed tickets. 
**Requirement & Design Authority:**
Author structured business requirements covering business context, scope boundaries, success criteria, and effort- impact cases and approve vendor functional designs prior to build. 
**Cross-Functional Architecture**
: Drive integration across MM, EWM, and FI- AP, eliminating process friction between procurement, inventory, and payables. 
**Vendor Governance & Screening**
: Technical/functional gatekeeping of vendor consultants, including interviewing proposed resources and evaluating delivery against scorecards.
  
  
**Technical &Functional Expertise Required**

**SAP MM Core & Advanced:**
Deep expertise in Vendor Master Management, Material Master Management, Purchasing, Stock Transport Orders (STOs), and Subcontracting/Third-Party Manufacturing. 
**SAP EWM / Logistics:**
Inbound/outbound process flows, warehouse structure, stock transfers, physical inventory, and integration with MM/SD. 
**Accounts Payable (FI-AP):**
Procurement-to-Pay integration, 3-way matching, invoice verification, park/post workflows, and payment runs. 
**Integration Points:**
Seamless hands-on knowledge of MM-FI (automatic account determination / OBYC), MM-PP (MRP and material staging), and MM-SD (intercompany & STO movements).
  
  
**Eligibility & Prerequisites**

**Work Experience**
: 4+ years of hands-on SAP functional consulting experience. Prior experience in Big Four or Tier-1 IT/Management Consulting (e.g., Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, Accenture) is strongly preferred. 
**Educational Background:**
MBA, Post-Graduate, or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, Business Management or Supply chain, from recognized institutions preferred
  
  
**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Principal PMT - International, Prime Video Personalization & Discovery
description:

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.
  
  
Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.
  
  
As a Prime Video Tech PM, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.
  
  
We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Principal Product Manager Tech to own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for personalized content discovery for various international markets. You will operate at the intersection of machine learning, customer experience, and business strategy, leading fast-paced, high-impact projects and partnering with experts in data science, ML engineering, and customer experience to ship ML-powered features at scale.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* The ideal candidate would have demonstrably thrived in a high growth environment and delivered broadly adopted technology products or services
* They would be a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and compellingly with stakeholders, partners and leaders, and understand how to drive a high level of focus and excellence
* They would have keen business sense together with a deep understanding of technology
* They would have experience defining products, mapping requirements to engineering functional specifications, leading large cross functional and cross organizational efforts, and delivering at high scale
* 10+ years of technical Product Management experience, or 7+ years of PM experience and 3+ years of Engg experience.
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

description:
Marsh is seeking a Data Domain Lead to support the strategy, development, and adoption of enterprise data products within an assigned domain. **What can you expect?**

* A highly collaborative role working across architecture, engineering, governance, and operational stakeholders
* The ability to contribute to how data is trusted, reused, and activated across the organization

* A key contributor role in advancing Marsh's data strategy

* Collaboration with colleagues and cross-functional teams

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for an assigned data domain

* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity while driving measurable outcomes

**What makes you stand out?**

* Experience in insurance, risk, benefits, financial services, or another complex regulated industry

You sit with their teams, work out what should be built, design it, build and ship parts of it yourself, and make sure hundreds of people actually use it. Stand-ups with business teams to agree priorities and blockers.Tuesday: Building. Backend endpoints, data migration scripts, an AI extraction flow, or a Figma screen.Wednesday: On the floor or at a site. Watch people use what shipped, demo it, capture what’s wrong.Thursday: Review the engineers’ code, test on real data, deploy, and fix what breaks.Friday: Write next week’s specs, then review with our founders and client leadership.What you’ll doScope the right thingRun discovery across departments and map how work, material and money actually flow.Separate what people ask for from what they need. Decide what is configuration, what is a one-off, and what becomes a product feature.Turn findings into a prioritised monthly scope with clear acceptance criteria, and say no to things that would fragment the platform.Own the client relationshipBe the single point of contact for everyone from frontline supervisors to the MD.Run weekly working sessions, fortnightly reviews and monthly scope meetings, and keep one tracker of every request and decision.Explain trade-offs, delays and risks plainly, before they become surprises.Design the systemOwn the system design: the data model, integrations with existing ERPs and accounting systems, and roles and permissions.Decide where AI belongs (document reading, matching, alerts, copilots) and where plain software is enough.Build, verify and deployWrite backend code yourself: APIs, integrations, and data migration from Excel and legacy systems.Review every pull request from your engineers, and test on the client’s real data before anything ships.Run releases and own incidents and fixes in production.Set up evals for AI features so accuracy is measured, not assumed.Design the experience and drive adoptionDesign screens in Figma for people who don’t type much: offline-first, in Hindi and English, for low-cost Android phones.Test designs with real users before the team builds them. Train users and write simple guides.Watch usage, find where people drop off, and fix it.What you need3–6 years building and shipping software, including at least 2 years in a client-facing, founding-engineer, product-engineer or forward-deployed role.Strong backend skills in Python or TypeScript/Node: REST APIs, PostgreSQL or similar, and SQL you write yourself.Hands-on experience with LLM applications: prompt design, document extraction, retrieval, tool-calling agents, and evaluating output quality.Able to read, review and reject code. Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, Docker and one cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure).Product sense: you can write a clear spec, prioritise with explicit trade-offs, and design a usable screen in Figma.Able to run a workshop with a site supervisor in the morning and an MD in the afternoon, and you write plainly.Fluent Hindi and English.Willing to work from client offices and travel to sites, daily in the first month or two of an engagement.Nice to haveYou’ve built ERP, HRMS, accounting or operations software, or you know Tally, GST, TDS or payroll.Experience with construction, infrastructure, manufacturing or field-operations businesses.You’ve shipped a mobile app (React Native or Flutter), ideally offline-first.You’ve led data migration from Excel and legacy systems.You speak a regional Indian language beyond Hindi.Who succeeds hereYou have high agency and low ego, and you’re comfortable when the plan changes. You’ve shipped something real, whether at a startup, a hackathon or on an on-call rotation, and you’d rather fix the problem than write about it. You stay calm while a client watches you fix something live.Work setupLocation: Hybrid, at client offices in India. Daily for roughly the first 1–2 months of an engagement, then about 3 days a week.Travel: Regular visits to client sites.Team: You lead a remote AI engineer, full-stack engineer and mobile engineer.Reports to: Tuning Research founders.Engagements: Typically 12-month programmes, with the chance to roll out across the client’s group companies.What success looks like30 days: You’ve met every department and mapped how work and money move. The first monthly plan is agreed and the build is under way.90 days: The first module is in use at pilot sites, the engineers ship every week, and the key build-vs-integrate decisions are made with the client.6 months: Core modules are live and client leadership treats you as part of their team.12 months: One platform runs the client’s core operations, and leadership sees the numbers daily.How we hireIntro call (30 min): Your background and why this role.Discovery role-play (60 min): One of us plays a client’s department head describing a messy problem. title: Product Owner
description:
****Who We Are****
Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.
  
  
****What We Offer****
Location:
  
  
Mumbai,IND
  
  
You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.
  
  
At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.
  
  
As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.
  
  
**Product Owner:**
This position is within the process diagnostics and control (PDC) group and is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and driving LINK data products and AI-enabled solutions from concept through field deployment. The role acts as the bridge between customers, field application teams, Product Management, R&D, Algorithms, and tool business units.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****
*Product Strategy & Roadmap*

* Translate customer needs, Voice of Customer (VoC), competitive insights, and field learnings into product requirements.
* Define and prioritize product backlog and roadmap.
* Drive feature prioritization balancing customer demand, product quality, reliability, and technical debt.

*Product Requirements & Execution*

* Own epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with architects, software engineering, QA, and algorithm teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Participate in PI planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and release planning.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, and customer focused.

*Customer Success & Field Engagement*

* Act as escalation point for strategic customer requirements and product gaps.
* Work with field application engineers and customers to validate solutions.
* Convert customer pain points into roadmap initiatives.
* Support beta programs, early adopters, and key field deployments

*Cross Functional Leadership*

* Drive alignment among Product Management, R&D, QA, Algorithms, Applications, Marketing, and Tool teams.
* Lead product reviews, design discussions, and roadmap reviews.

****What We Offer****

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge semiconductor technology and products.
* Direct collaboration with customers and global R&D teams
* A role with real product influence — your field learnings shape the roadmap
* A culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous learning

****What You Bring****

* Master’s / Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, VLSI, or a related field
* 9+ years of experience in semiconductor process and defectivity, with hands-on knowledge of CAD and design-based inspection concepts
* Comfort with GenAI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for code generation, debugging, and documentation
* Willingness to travel ~30% to leading fabs globally
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams
* Excellent communication skills — equally effective with customers, field teams, and R&D engineers

****Additional Information****
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Yes, 25% of the Time
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
Yes
  
  
Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

description:

Welcome to
**MetaGO**
, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change

.

.

**MetaGO app**

**Where the GO of MetaGO happens!**
This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.
  
  
You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.

title: Product Manager - India
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
As a
**Product Manager,**
to be located at Navi Mumbai, India, you will be responsible for driving product portfolio competitiveness, profitability, supply flexibility, and growth enablement across the India Consumer Solutions business. The role serves as a key business leader responsible for evaluating and executing strategies that optimize manufacturing footprint, external contract manufacturing (ECM), sourcing options, product supply networks, and overall value chain performance.
  
  
This role operates at the intersection of commercial strategy, product management, manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, and finance. The incumbent is responsible for assessing and recommending make-versus-buy, buy-sell, external manufacturing, and strategic partnership opportunities that improve profitability, increase supply resilience, support growth, and strengthen long-term competitiveness within India.
  
  
The Product Manager translates business strategy into actionable initiatives, governs value chain improvement programs, and drives disciplined execution through cross-functional teams. The role requires balancing short-term operational requirements with longer-term portfolio, manufacturing, and investment decisions while ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer commitments.
  
  
Working closely with regional Product Management, Commercial, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Technology, and external manufacturing partners, the Product Manager provides thought leadership and decision support for strategic initiatives that maximize value creation across the India business.
  
  
The role requires strong business acumen, financial analysis capabilities, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence complex decisions across a matrixed organization without direct authority.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead product portfolio competitiveness initiatives across India by identifying and executing opportunities that improve profitability, supply reliability, operational flexibility, and long-term growth.
* Develop and maintain an India-focused manufacturing and sourcing strategy that evaluates internal production, external manufacturing, buy-sell arrangements, and strategic partnerships to optimize business performance.
* Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships and external manufacturing opportunities that support market growth, improve flexibility, and strengthen supply network competitiveness. (Derived from the strategic partnership mandate you described.)
* Lead and govern Value Chain Management Team (VCMT) initiatives by establishing accountability, monitoring key performance indicators, tracking progress, and ensuring timely delivery of business commitments.
* Partner with Commercial, Manufacturing, Procurement, Supply Chain, Technology, and Finance functions to identify and implement opportunities that improve cost position, product availability, service performance, and margin expansion.
* Conduct financial and business analyses to identify profitability gaps, competitiveness challenges, hidden cost drivers, and value creation opportunities across the portfolio.
* Develop business cases and recommendations for manufacturing footprint optimization, strategic partnerships, and supply network improvements that support future business growth.
* Influence regional product, supply, manufacturing, innovation, and investment strategies to ensure alignment with India business priorities and market opportunities.
* Communicate strategic recommendations, business risks, opportunity assessments, and execution updates effectively to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering/Mechanical /Production Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business, Finance, or related discipline.
* Minimum 6-10 years of relevant experience in Product Management, Commercial, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Strategy, Business Operations, Procurement, or related business roles.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex business decisions involving profitability, competitiveness, sourcing, manufacturing, supply strategy, or external partnerships.
* Strong understanding of business economics, product profitability, cost structures, supply-demand balancing, and value chain optimization.
* Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams within a matrixed organization.
* Strong analytical and financial evaluation capabilities with demonstrated ability to translate data into business decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or Master's Degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or related field.
* Experience with External Contract Manufacturing (ECM), toll manufacturing, contract manufacturing, or third-party supply partnerships.
* Experience in product portfolio management, manufacturing economics, asset utilization, and supply network optimization.
* Experience evaluating make-buy, sourcing, footprint optimization, or strategic partnership decisions.
* Lean Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Project, Program, or Portfolio Management certification preferred but not required.

**Your Skills**

* Strategic Business Leadership
* Financial and Commercial Acumen
* External Partnership Management
* Cross-Functional Leadership and Influence
* Product Portfolio Management
* Strategic Decision Making
* Program Governance and Execution
* Executive Communication

**Additional Notes**

* Ability to support and collaborate across multiple global functions and time zones.
* Periodic domestic and international travel may be required.
* Relocation support is not provided for this role.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).

+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)

Join our team, we can make a difference together.
  
  
**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science-based products and solutions in high-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
  
  
A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
  
  
As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

title: Growth Manager
description:
**Position:  Growth Manager** 




**Function: Growth / D2C / Marketing (Retention\+ CRM\+ P\&L)** 




**Industry Preference: D2C, FMCG, Nutrition, Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Lifestyle** 




**Location: Mumbai** 




**Experience: 7–10 years** 




**Reporting To: Director** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven Growth \& Retention leader who can own the complete D2C growth charter with a strong focus on revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, retention, repeat purchases and P\&L management.
 



 The role will be responsible for building and scaling the D2C business by combining performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer segmentation, loyalty, CRO, analytics and commercial decision\-making.
 



 The ideal candidate should have experience working with a consumer\-facing brand, preferably within D2C, FMCG, nutrition, wellness, beauty, personal care or lifestyle, and should be comfortable operating at the intersection of growth, marketing, technology, analytics and business P\&L.
 



  





**1\. D2C Growth \& P\&L Ownership** 




 ·       Own the overall D2C revenue and P\&L, including revenue growth, gross margins, contribution margins, CAC, LTV and profitability.
 



 ·       Develop and execute annual and quarterly D2C growth strategy aligned with business objectives.
 



 ·       Identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, customer value and channel efficiency.
 



 ·       Own monthly growth targets and develop actionable plans to achieve them.
 



 ·       Monitor Revenue, AOV, CAC, LTV, ROAS, repeat rate, retention and contribution margin.
 



 ·       Drive data\-led decisions on marketing investments, product mix, promotions and customer segments.
 



  





**2\. Customer Acquisition \& Performance Marketing** 




 ·       Lead performance marketing across Meta, Google and other relevant acquisition channels.
 



 ·       Scale acquisition while maintaining a healthy CAC\-to\-LTV ratio.
 



 ·       Work with performance marketing teams/agencies to optimise campaign performance.
 



 ·       Develop strategies for customer acquisition and efficient media spends.
 



 ·       Diversify acquisition through organic, partnerships, SEO/AEO/GEO, referral and other growth channels.
 



 ·       Establish clear attribution and measurement frameworks.
 



  





**3\. Retention \& CRM** 




 ·       Own the complete customer retention and lifecycle marketing charter.
 



 ·       Increase repeat purchases, customer frequency, retention and LTV.
 



 ·       Develop lifecycle journeys for new, repeat, dormant, high\-value and churn\-risk customers.
 



 ·       Drive CRM through Email, WhatsApp, SMS, push and other relevant channels.
 



 ·       Build journeys covering onboarding, first\-to\-second purchase, replenishment, cross\-sell/upsell, win\-back, loyalty and VIP customers.
 



 ·       Use RFM, cohort and behavioural segmentation to personalise communication.
 



 ·       Track cohort\-level retention and identify opportunities to improve LTV.
 



  





**4\. Loyalty \& Monetisation** 




 ·       Build and scale loyalty, rewards, referral and membership programs.
 



 ·       Increase customer frequency and basket size.
 



 ·       Develop monetisation strategies that improve customer value without negatively impacting contribution margins.
 



 ·       Analyse loyalty adoption, repeat behaviour and profitability.
 



  





**5\. Growth Analytics \& Optimisation** 




 ·       Establish a growth dashboard covering the customer funnel.
 



 ·       Analyse cohorts, acquisition sources, retention curves and LTV.
 



 ·       Conduct A/B testing and CRO across website, landing pages, product pages, checkout and customer journeys.
 



 ·       Identify funnel drop\-offs and work with Product/Tech to improve conversion.
 



 ·       Build forecasting models for revenue, acquisition, retention and marketing spends.
 



 ·       Translate data into business recommendations for leadership.
 



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 ·       Work closely with Brand, Product, Creative, Technology, Analytics, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations.
 



 ·       Align growth initiatives with inventory, launches, pricing and promotional calendars.
 



 ·       Partner with Finance to track P\&L, contribution margins and marketing ROI.
 



 ·       Work with Product and Tech to improve D2C customer experience and conversion.
 



 ·       Lead internal teams and external agencies/vendors across growth, CRM, performance and partnerships.
 



  





**7\. Organic \& Emerging Growth Channels** 




 ·       Explore emerging acquisition channels beyond traditional paid media.
 



 ·       Develop SEO, AEO and GEO strategies to increase organic discovery and reduce dependence on paid acquisition.
 



 ·       Track traffic, conversion and revenue from organic and emerging search surfaces.
 



 ·       Identify new digital platforms, partnerships and consumer touchpoints contributing to D2C growth.
 



  





**Key KPIs** 




 ·       D2C Revenue Growth
 



 ·       P\&L / Contribution Margin
 



 ·       Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 



 ·       Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
 



 ·       LTV:CAC
 



 ·       Repeat Purchase Rate
 



 ·       Customer Retention
 



 ·       Revenue from Existing Customers
 



 ·       New Customer Acquisition
 



 ·       AOV
 



 ·       Purchase Frequency
 



 ·       ROAS / Marketing Efficiency
 



 ·       CRM Revenue Contribution
 



 ·       Conversion Rate
 



 ·       Cohort Retention
 



 ·       Loyalty Program Adoption \& Revenue
 



 ·       Organic Revenue Contribution
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 ·       7–10 years of experience in Growth, D2C, CRM, Retention, Performance Marketing or related consumer businesses.
 



 ·       Owned or significantly contributed to a D2C P\&L.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience in customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
 



 ·       Experience managing performance marketing budgets and understanding CAC and ROAS optimisation.
 



 ·       Strong understanding of LTV, cohorts, RFM, retention and customer segmentation.
 



 ·       Experience building CRM automation and lifecycle journeys.
 



 ·       Strong commercial mindset and understanding of growth, revenue and profitability.
 



 ·       Comfortable working with data and making decisions based on analytics.
 



 ·       Experience managing cross\-functional teams and external agencies.
 



 ·       Able to operate in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with high ownership.
 



  





**Preferred Industry Background** 




 D2C \| FMCG \| Nutrition \| Health \& Wellness \| Beauty \| Personal Care \| Food \& Beverage \| Lifestyle \| Consumer Internet \| E\-commerce
 



 Experience with a high\-frequency or repeat\-purchase consumer category would be an added advantage.
 



  





**Preferred Tools / Platforms** 




 Shopify \| CleverTap \| MoEngage \| WhatsApp Business API \| Meta Ads \| Google Ads \| GA4 \| Unicommerce \| Marketing Automation \& CRM Platforms
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The person in this role will be expected to build a profitable and scalable D2C growth engine, where acquisition and retention work together—driving new customer growth while continuously increasing repeat revenue, LTV and contribution margins.
 



 This role is not a pure Performance Marketing or CRM role; it requires someone who can connect Growth \+ Retention \+ Analytics \+ Commercial/P\&L ownership into one business charter.

 **hr@aceblend.com**

title: Strategy & Operations Associate
description:
**About the Role** 




 Limese is a Korean beauty distribution company operating across India, the UAE, and Europe, and we're launching our own brands alongside distribution. We're looking for someone who can take a messy, half\-defined problem, figure out what needs to happen, and drive it to done across teams.
 



  





 This is a high\-exposure role. You'll work closely with leadership on the company's top priorities, but you'll also be embedded in the team and accountable like everyone else. There's no fixed lane. You'll start across many projects, and over time the areas where you're strongest become yours to own.
 



  





**What you'll actually be doing** 



* Running cross\-functional projects end to end, such as a new brand launch, a new market entry, a marketplace rollout, or a process that's broken
* Turning leadership priorities into clear plans, owners, and timelines, then following up until they ship
* Tracking business performance across channels and markets and pulling together the numbers that drive decisions
* Preparing analysis, briefs, and decks for partner, brand, and internal reviews
* Spotting gaps between brand, ops, warehouse, and finance, and fixing them
* Getting hands\-on when something needs doing, whether that's vendor calls, partner onboarding, or sorting out a stuck shipment



  





**Who this is for** 



* You're structured in your thinking but comfortable with ambiguity
* You're strong with Excel and numbers, and you write clearly
* You can influence without authority. You get things done by earning trust with teams, not by title
* You act without waiting for instructions and close loops without being chased
* You want to eventually own a business vertical, not stay a coordinator
* 2–5 years of experience in consulting, a startup, e\-commerce, or a founder's office type role is a plus but not required



  





**One honest note** 




 This role sits close to leadership, but it isn't a layer above the team. You'll report into our leadership structure like everyone else and be measured on what you deliver. Much of the work is unglamorous execution. If you're looking for a strategy\-only role or a title, this isn't it. If you want to learn how a multi\-country business actually runs and earn your way to owning part of it, you'll fit in well here.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Email careers@limesecos.com with your realistic salary expectations, why you're leaving your last role, and one project you drove end to end: what was broken, what you did, and what changed.
