title: HRIS Lead - Workday | Mumbai
description:
**Please Note:** 
**This is a hands\-on configuration \+ integration leadership role.** 
 Payroll processing, HR operations and oversight profiles
 **will NOT BE considered.**
**What we’re looking for?**
 Argus Media is looking for an HRIS Lead \- Workday to act as the global functional owner and strategic adviser for Workday and its connected HR technology ecosystem. Based in Mumbai, you will support stakeholders across the US, UK/Europe and APAC and will be accountable for solution design, complex configuration, reporting, security, integrations, releases, annual HR processes and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role. You will remain hands\-on in Workday, manage and develop a Senior HRIS Analyst, partner with our AMS provider and translate business requirements into secure, scalable and user\-friendly solutions. You will also collaborate on HR automation, analytics and AI\-enabled improvement initiatives.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
**Workday configuration and functional ownership**
* Own functional design, configuration, testing and production readiness across Core HCM, Integration, Advanced Compensation, Business Processes, Absence, US Benefits, US Payroll, Security, Reporting and EIBs.
* Personally resolve complex configuration and functional issues, assessing cross\-module, data, security and downstream impacts before changes are approved.
* Maintain configuration decisions, process documentation, SOPs and knowledge articles to reduce key\-person dependency.


**Annual HR processes**
* Lead enterprise\-wide annual cycles from planning to closure, including global merit and bonus reviews, performance cycles, US benefits open enrolment, ACA\-related reporting and annual absence or calendar updates.
* Own configuration, eligibility rules, security, test scenarios, reconciliation, issue resolution, stakeholder communications, training and post\-cycle review.


**Security, compliance and governance**
* Own the Workday security model, including role\-based, domain, business\-process, intersection and segment\-based security where applicable.
* Apply least\-privilege access, segregation of duties, appropriate approvals, testing, periodic reviews and audit\-ready change records.
* Act as a strategic adviser by challenging access or configuration requests where the business need, risk or control is not clear.


**Integrations and data quality**
* Own the functional health of Workday integrations with payroll, benefits identity and reporting platforms.
* Troubleshoot integration issues using integration events, exception outputs, reference IDs, security, schedules, file delivery and downstream dependencies.
* Partner with technical teams and vendors on integration creation, modification and support; strong experience with EIBs, Core Connectors, APIs, SFTP or similar patterns is desirable.
* Establish data\-quality controls, reconciliation reports and corrective\-action governance across worker, organization, compensation, absence and security data.


**Releases, projects and change adoption**
* Own both Workday release cycles, including feature evaluation, impact analysis, preview\-tenant validation, UAT, regression testing, stakeholder decisions, communications and production verification.
* Lead global Workday projects such as manager self\-service, new modules, process redesign, security improvements and reporting modernization.
* Prepare clear project plans and business cases covering objectives, scope, options, costs, benefits, risks, dependencies, localization, testing, adoption and success measures.
* Translate Workday terminology into practical recommendations for HR and non\-technical senior stakeholders.


**Service, vendors and leadership**
* Priorities operational support, compliance issues, enhancements and strategic initiatives using business impact, risk, effort and dependency criteria.
* Manage AMS and Workday relationships, including service quality, tickets, contracted support, renewals and implementation estimates.
* Coach and develop the Senior HRIS Analyst through clear accountability, regular feedback, one\-to\-one support, cross\-training and structured development.
* Work effectively as a hands\-on individual contributor while leading the HRIS function and collaborating across global time zones.


**Skills And Experience**
* At least 7 years of substantial hands\-on Workday experience, with evidence of complex configuration rather than only coordination, support or ticket triage.
* Deep capability in Core HCM, Business Processes, Security and Reporting, plus strong hands\-on ownership of at least three of the following: Advanced Compensation, Absence, Performance, US Benefits, US Payroll and Integrations.
* Experience leading at least one enterprise\-wide annual Workday cycle from configuration and testing through launch, reconciliation and closure.
* Experience managing Workday releases end to end in a lead team, including personally performing UAT and regression testing.
* Ability to troubleshoot and functionally govern Workday integrations and collaborate effectively with technical specialists and vendors.
* Experience leading a global or multi\-country Workday project from discovery and business case through deployment and adoption.
* Strong understanding of security governance, segregation of duties, data privacy, controls and audit evidence.
* People\-management, coaching or team\-lead experience, combined with a willingness to remain hands\-on.
* Excellent stakeholder, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to non\-technical audiences.
* Ability and willingness to work from Mumbai under the company hybrid\-working arrangement.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Workday Pro or equivalent certification in HCM, Security, Reporting, Integrations, Compensation or another relevant module.
* Experience in both an in\-house Workday environment and consulting or AMS delivery.
* Experience with Workday audit controls, SOX or similar governance requirements.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Automate, Copilot Studio or AI\-enabled HR workflows.
* Graduate or postgraduate qualification in HR, technology, business or a related field; project\-management training or certification is an advantage.


**What’s In It For You**
* Global mandate — US, UK/EU and APAC scope from day one.
* Leadership \& execution — own architecture, governance and roadmap, not just configuration.
* Build a team — grow and coach a Workday Analyst function; shape careers.
* AI\-in\-HR agenda — own Copilot Studio agents,
* Transformation runway — redesign the security model and rationalise integrations.
* Modern set\-up — hybrid working, senior stakeholder access, and genuine investment in HR tech.
* Competitive salary
* Hybrid Working Policy (3 days in Mumbai office/ 2 days WFH once fully inducted)
* Group healthcare scheme
* 18 days annual leave
* 8 days of casual leave
* Extensive internal and external training


**Hours**
 This is a full\-time position operating under a hybrid model, with three days in the office and two days working remotely. Office hours are Monday through Friday from 09:00\-18:00, with a one\-hour lunch break.
   

  

 Argus is the leading independent provider of market intelligence to the global energy and commodity markets. We offer essential price assessments, news, analytics, consulting services, data science tools and industry conferences to illuminate complex and opaque commodity markets.
   

  

 Headquartered in London with 1,500 staff, Argus is an independent media organisation with 32 offices in the world’s principal commodity trading hubs.
   

  

 Companies, trading firms and governments in 160 countries around the world trust Argus data to make decisions, analyse situations, manage risk, facilitate trading and for long\-term planning. Argus prices are used as trusted benchmarks around the world for pricing transportation, commodities and energy.
   

  

 Founded in 1970, Argus remains a privately held UK\-registered company owned by employee shareholders and global growth equity firm General Atlantic.

 Nasdaq is continuously revolutionizing markets and undergoing transformations while we adopt new technologies to develop innovative solutions, constantly aiming to rewrite tomorrow. This role is critical to ensuring the platform remains scalable, secure, and fit for enterprise use while supporting increasing client adoption and advanced use cases across global banks and financial institutions.

 Join the FinTech P\&SE organization, which sits at the intersection of platform engineering, product strategy, cloud enablement, and client engagement. The team works closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Sales, CS, QA, and Support. The team leads the platform evolution, integration, and delivery efforts in support of new product development engineering.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
 As a Lead Platform Product Manager, your focus will be driving platform delivery and roadmap execution, including research, build, and cloud readiness. Besides working closely with your colleagues in Mumbai, you will also work closely with Nasdaq teams in other countries.

 Translates platform strategy into clear, actionable product requirements and achievements.
   

  

 Acts as the primary product contact for platform topics for clients, Support, Presales, and Client Services. Participates in customer workshops, demos, critical issues, and roadmap discussions.
   

  

 We need someone with a highly self\-motivated, consultant\-like mentality—someone who proactively engages collaborators, drives timelines, and pushes for measurable outcomes with minimal oversight.
   

  

**We expect you to have: (Minimum Qualifications)**
 Experience Level: 6–8 years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, or a closely related role.
   

  

**Expert Experience In Requirements Gathering And Writing Requirements Documents**
 Experience delivering platform, infrastructure, or integration\-heavy products, ideally in FinTech or capital markets environments.
   

  

 Solid understanding of digital assets concepts, including tokenization and blockchain infrastructure.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and familiarity with SaaS operating models.
   

  

 Strong ability to communicate sophisticated technical topics to both technical and business collaborators.
   

  

**Good to have (Secondary Skills?**
 Experience with Calypso or similar capital markets platforms.
   

  

 Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot or AI\-assisted product and engineering tools.
   

  

 Public cloud certification or hands\-on delivery experience.
   

  

**Does it sound like you?**
 As the selection process is ongoing, please submit your application in English as soon as possible. We will get back to you in 2\-3 weeks.

 Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information or any other status protected by applicable law.

* Demonstrated marketing competency
* Proven technical aptitude
* Entrepreneurial drive to take ownership of our marketing/product strategy and execution to achieve our growth goals
* Strong leadership skills \- must be able to work across departments and regions, including internationally
* 3\-5 years previous product management/product marketing experience
* A strong business sense – person needs the ability to create segment marketing/product strategy from market analysis
* A strong customer orientation with a “how can I help” approach
* Must be a team player with the ability to work across multiple disciplines and geographies
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Travel will be required – 30%
* Ability to create and edit PowerPoint presentations required
* Must have above average Excel and numerical analysis skills


**Desired Talents**
* Curiosity
* Confident
* Analyzing/synthesis
* Systems thinking
* Emotional intelligence (empathy)
* Logical
* Persistent
* Risk\-taker
* Creative
* Problem solver


**Job Responsibilities** 
  

  

* Full product line ownership for the assigned segment/customers:
+ Create and execute strategic marketing plan to drive sales and profit growth
+ Measure product quality and drive continuous improvement
+ Executing product life cycle initiatives for the segment
+ Maintain segment/customer portfolio roadmap
+ Define user/buyer personas for products \- be the expert in their area
+ Write product requirements and use scenarios
+ Manage pricing and profitability

* Discover and validate market problems (both existing and future customers)

title: Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
**Role Summary** 




**Eze Perfumes** 

 is looking for a data\-obsessed, results\-driven
 
**Marketplace Growth Manager** 

 to join our Mumbai\-based global operations team. Your primary mission is to own the P\&L and scale our brand presence across major
 
**US marketplaces** 

 , with a primary focus on
 
**Amazon (FBA)** 

 and
 
**Walmart (WFS)** 

 .
 





 This role requires a unique individual who can sit in Mumbai but think like a US consumer. You will be responsible for the entire marketplace lifecycle—from strategic inventory planning and cross\-border logistics to high\-performance PPC advertising and AI\-driven listing optimization. You will act as the "CEO" of our US marketplace channels, ensuring Sawai’s heritage\-rich fragrances become a household name in the North American market.
 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Strategy \& P\&L Ownership** 



* **Revenue Accountability:** 

 Own the end\-to\-end P\&L for US marketplaces, including top\-line revenue, contribution margins, and platform\-specific fees.
* **GTM Execution:** 

 Develop and execute the Go\-To\-Market strategy for new product launches in the US, ensuring optimal pricing, positioning, and initial review velocity.
* **Growth Roadmaps:** 

 Build monthly and quarterly growth plans that balance aggressive customer acquisition with sustainable profitability.



**2\. Amazon \& Walmart Channel Mastery** 



* **Listing Excellence:** 

 Own the creation and optimization of SEO\-rich product listings, including titles, bullet points, and backend keywords tailored specifically to US search intent.
* **A\+ Content \& Storefronts:** 

 Work with the content team to ensure Amazon A\+ content and Brand Stores reflect a premium, luxury fragrance aesthetic.
* **Account Health:** 

 Monitor and maintain "Gold Standard" account health metrics, managing IPI scores, buyer\-seller messaging, and compliance with platform policies.



**3\. High\-Performance Advertising (PPC)** 



* **Campaign Management:** 

 Direct and optimize Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display ads to maintain a target ACOS/TACOS.
* **Competitor Conquesting:** 

 Implement aggressive keyword\-bidding strategies to capture market share from competitors in the premium fragrance and essential oil categories.
* **DSP \& External Traffic:** 

 Explore and manage Amazon DSP or external traffic drivers (Social to Amazon) to boost ranking and BSR.



**4\. Cross\-Border Logistics \& Inventory Planning** 



* **Demand Forecasting:** 

 Coordinate with the Mumbai and Silvassa teams to forecast US demand, ensuring stock is manufactured and shipped in time to avoid stockouts.
* **FBA/WFS Management:** 

 Manage shipments from India to US 3PLs or Amazon/Walmart fulfilment centers.
* **Efficiency:** 

 Optimize "Inventory Age" and minimize storage fees through strategic liquidation or promotional pulses.



**5\. AI\-Driven Operations** 



* **Automation:** 

 Implement AI tools for automated keyword research, sentiment analysis of customer reviews, and competitive price monitoring.
* **Content Scaling:** 

 Use LLMs to rapidly iterate on ad copy, A/B test listing titles, and automate routine reporting tasks.
* **Sentiment Analysis:** 

 Leverage AI to decode "Voice of Customer" data from reviews to inform the R\&D team in India for future product iterations.



**Technical Proficiencies \& Tools** 



* **Marketplace Core:** 

 Amazon Seller Central and Ads (Expert), Walmart Seller Center, eBay.
* **Analytics \& Research:** 

 Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or Viral Launch.
* **Advertising Tech:** 

 Amazon Advertising Console, Pacvue, or Perpetua.
* **AI Stack:** 

 ChatGPT/Claude (for SEO \& Copy), Midjourney (for creative ideation), and Excel/Google Sheets (Advanced formulas \& Pivot Tables).
* **Operations:** 

 Experience with ERPs and cross\-border shipping documentation (ShipStation, etc.).



**Core Strengths** 



* **The "Global\-Local" Mindset:** 

 Ability to translate Indian manufacturing excellence into a brand voice that resonates with US luxury buyers.
* **Analytical Rigor:** 

 You don’t make guesses; you make data\-backed decisions based on click\-through rates, conversion rates, and session data.
* **Agility:** 

 The US marketplace landscape changes weekly (algorithm updates, fee changes); you must be able to pivot strategy instantly.



**The Ideal Fit** 



* You have a proven track record of managing a $1M\+ ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) portfolio on Amazon US.
* You are comfortable working hours that overlap with the US East Coast/West Coast to coordinate with partners and monitor live sales events (e.g., Prime Day).
* You have a passion for the fragrance/beauty industry and understand the nuances of selling "scent" through a digital screen.



**How to Apply** 





 If you are ready to take a heritage Indian brand to the global stage, send your resume and a summary of your biggest marketplace "win" to
 
**hr@incredibleindriya.com** 

 .
 




**Eze Perfumes** 

 is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate the intersection of Indian craftsmanship and global digital commerce.

Our trading desks specialise in understanding flows across interest rates and FX in G10 and emerging market currencies, including: government bonds, agency and supra\-sovereign bonds, commercial paper, interest rate derivatives (including structured products), inflation\-linked products, cross currency derivatives, spot foreign exchange, foreign exchange forwards and options.

title: Software Engineering - Executive Director - Parametric
description:
**About Morgan Stanley**
 Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions, and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
   

  

**About Parametric**
 Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what's important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
   

  

 This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
   

  

**About Team**
 The Core Operations Platform is designed to build, integrate, and support a unified technology ecosystem that enables efficient, scalable, and controlled execution of Client and Market Operations processes.
   

  

 It serves as the central backbone for operational workflows, consolidating fragmented systems into a single, orchestrated platform that improves data integrity, reduces manual effort, and enhances operational transparency. This aligns with the broader vision of moving from multi\-system, manual processes to a unified, workflow\-driven model
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director, Software Engineering is responsible for providing technical leadership, project management, process development, training, support, and a technology vision for the Core Operation Platform. This team is responsible for multiple business processes namely Account Onboarding, Activities, Reconciliation and Reporting. The role will work with Data Services and Portfolio Management technology teams across the Direct Indexing business priorities, to design and develop technology solutions, and to improve business processes. This spans across core services to enable onboarding through our partners as well as business facing websites to allow the efficient onboarding and management of Accounts. These services will help streamline the rule\-based portfolio analytics, order generation and straight through processing allow for exception driven portfolio management.
   

  

 The Director will work closely with the Client Relationship Group and Market Operations for designing efficient applications to onboard accounts while minimizing risk. They will also work with the Digital Team developing services to that will be used by our Financial Advisor portal. In this role, the candidate will develop the appropriate software strategy, striking a balance between: (1\) alignment with the growth objectives of the Business; (2\) higher performance and consistently high quality; and (3\) cost effective application structure and use of new technologies.
   

  

 This leader will shape the long term product vision, drive engineering excellence, partner closely with business stakeholders, and ensure scalable, intuitive user experiences across operational teams.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role accountable for setting direction, executing delivery, and building a high performing team that modernizes how users interact with operations platform and supporting data systems.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Vision**
* Define and execute the technology roadmap for the Core Operations Platform, aligning investments and capabilities with business priorities and long\-term growth objectives.
* Drive architecture and technology decisions that promote scalability, resiliency, security, and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to and help advance the AI and automation strategy for the Core Operations Platform, focusing on practical use cases that improve efficiency and decision\-making.


**Product \& Delivery Execution**
* Lead the design, development, and delivery of technology solutions supporting account onboarding, operational workflows, reconciliation, reporting, and client servicing.
* Champion engineering best practices, including software quality, automation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.


**Business Engagement \& Stakeholder Partnership**
* Partner closely with Operations, Client Relationship Group, Digital, Data Services, and Portfolio Management Technology teams to identify and deliver high\-impact solutions.
* Translate business needs into technology strategies that improve user experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.


**People Leadership \& Organizational Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent while supporting career development and succession planning.


**Governance, Risk \& Operational Excellence**
* Ensure technology solutions adhere to regulatory, security, and operational risk standards while maintaining platform stability and reliability.
* Establish strong governance, support, and change management practices that enable effective delivery and continuous operational improvement.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science
* Asset management industry experience preferred.
* 15\+ years of hands\-on development experience managing all aspects of technical projects with a proven track record of delivering well architected and well written software solutions.
* 7\+ years of Experience supervising and guiding software development teams and fostering an engaging, collaborative environment.
* 10\+ Years of Experience developing scalable solutions with advanced programming languages including .Net and Java framework.
* Proven track record of becoming a subject matter expert in areas related to current assignments.
* Strong leadership skills including:
+ Vision and strategy
+ Influencing and consensus building
+ Communication
+ Total quality commitment
+ Ownership and accountability
+ Project management

* Successful track record of development and implementation of an innovative strategic vision and plans, and competence in building strategies to deliver technology to meet business goals and objectives. Ability to transform strategy into tactical plans and delivery.
* A creative, self\-confident self\-motivator with a "can do" orientation, along with the ability to function both independently and as a member of a team. Can work well in a fast paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Passionate, forward thinking and creative individual with high ethical standards and integrity.
* Ability to collaborate and partner as a business professional. The ability to facilitate, gain compromise and/or consensus within diverse teams.
* Assertiveness balanced with a sensitivity toward and concern for people. The ability to create strong work ethics and committed teams, foster open dialogue, and promote individual and team success.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills in customer and internal environment.
* Experience identifying and implementing AI and automation use cases to improve operational efficiency and decision\-making.


 Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our client services.
   

  

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
   

  

 To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
   

  

 Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
   

  

 For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo.

title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real\-time cross\-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
   

  

 Co\-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11\-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
   

  

 It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
   

  

 Our payout network spans 190\+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 \+ corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40\+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross\-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross\-Border Payments Companies list.
   

  

 In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1\.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high\-growth company.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Nium moves billions in payments every month for some of the world’s most demanding companies — banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms operating across 100\+ countries. We built that on fiat rails. The next layer is digital currency: stablecoins, on/off\-ramps, and card products that let customers spend, settle, and move value in USDC as naturally as they do in dollars or euros.
   

  

 We’re hiring a Staff PM – Digital Assets to own that build. Not the strategy document — the actual product. If you’ve shipped a stablecoin wallet, a crypto\-funded card, or a fiat\-to\-digital conversion flow and you understand what it takes to get that through compliance, engineering, and go\-live in a regulated environment, this is your rol
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own stablecoin\-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi\-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off\-ramp flows — fiat\-to\-digital and digital\-to\-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin\-based cross\-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production\-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal


**Requirements**
* 7\+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off\-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross\-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no\-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high\-ambiguity, high\-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign\-off


**How We’ll Measure Success**
* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins \+ payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin\-funded card products
* On/off\-ramp conversion rate and time\-to\-settlement
* Time\-to\-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product


**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:** 
 Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
   

  

**We Care for Our Employees:** 
 The wellness of Nium’ers is our \#1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year\-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
   

  

**We Upskill Ourselves:** 
 We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role\-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
   

  

**We Celebrate Together:** 
 We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company\-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
   

  

**We Thrive with Diversity:** 
 Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18\+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
   

  

**Beware of recruitment scams:** 
 Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
 **Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments** 
 . Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Define pricing, brokerage, subscription, and monetization strategies that enhance customer value while improving business profitability.

* Continuously benchmark the US Stocks offering against domestic and global competitors.
* Track industry trends, customer behavior, regulatory developments, and emerging investment products.
* Recommend strategic initiatives to strengthen competitive positioning and create differentiated customer value.

* Lead cross\-functional teams to execute strategic priorities with speed and excellence.

* 3\-5 years of experience in business leadership, general management, strategy, product management, category management, or P\&L ownership within fintech, wealth management, capital markets, broking, asset management, or digital financial services.

title: Lead – Technical Solutions & Projects
description:
**About Inaara NeoFoods** 




 Inaara NeoFoods is building India’s first farm\-to\-formulation platform for plant derived functional nutrients for everyday food by partnering with F\&B companies (domestic as well as exports) to develop scalable, clean\-label and commercially viable food solutions. Inaara operates at the intersection of agriculture, advanced processing, applied food science and computational nutrition.
 




  





 The founding team has deep expertise across agriculture, food systems, supply chains, technology and consumer businesses. Having built and scaled successful ventures in the agri\-food ecosystem, the founders bring a unique combination of entrepreneurial vision, operational excellence and industry relationships, positioning Inaara to build a globally relevant nutrition platform from India.
 







**Role: Lead – Technical Solutions \& Projects** 




 Inaara NeoFoods is creating a category\-defining business at the intersection of food, agriculture, nutrition and technology. The opportunity involves collaborating with global experts to pioneer next\-generation, nutrient\-rich food formulations from ground\-up.
 







 We are seeking a first\-principles problem solver who is deeply driven by purpose and comfortable navigating a fast\-evolving, dynamic environment. If you are inspired by the prospect of shaping the global future of nutrition from India, you will thrive here. We value curiosity, ownership, resilience and a long\-term vision over hierarchy and established playbooks.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Reporting to the
 **Head of Applications/R\&D** 
 and working in close strategic partnership with the Commercial
 
 team, the
 **Lead – Technical Solutions \& Projects** 
 operates across two pillars:
 






1. **Technical Core (In the Lab):** 
 A hands\-on food application scientist who anchors rapid customer prototype development at the bench, runs functional and textural characterization, leverages lab technicians, and validates pilot\-to\-plant scale\-up parameters.
2. **Customer Interface \& Project Management (Market Solutions):** 
 A customer\-facing technical consultant who translates client briefs into application roadmaps, owns projects end\-to\-end, drive timelines, demonstrates scientific and cost\-in\-use advantages to external R\&D teams to enable Sales.



  





**Location** 





 Mumbai, India
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Master’s or PhD in Food Technology, Food Science, or related field
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on formulation and application development experience
* Dual capability in bench\-top prototyping and experience managing technical projects
* Hands\-on familiarity with functional and textural characterization (texture analysis, colour, rheology)
* Experience running outsourced analytical programs through NABL\-accredited labs
* Familiarity with industrial food processing equipment and scale\-up workflows.
* Knowledge of FSSAI regulations, global food standards, labelling and nutrient\-claim requirements



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**(a) Technical Core:** 
 Bench Formulation, Prototyping \& Scale\-Up
 







* **Hands\-on Bench Prototyping** 
 : Formulate finished food prototypes across priority formats (bakery, extruded snacks, functional beverages, ready\-to\-mix powders, and plant\-based matrices)
* **Functional \& Sensory Characterization:** 
 Conduct functional, rheological, and textural characterization (viscosity, emulsion stability, texture profiling, water activity) to optimize sensory benchmarks.
* **Trial Iterations** 
 : Execute rapid reformulation cycles to troubleshoot technical issues and shortening turnaround times.
* **Pilot \& Plant Scale\-Up:** 
 Transition approved bench formulations into pilot and commercial\-scale factory trials, partnering with manufacturers to validate process parameters and line runnability.
* **Data \& Regulatory Compliance:** 
 Codify trial and formulations data, ensuring every prototype complies with FSSAI standards, export regulations, and nutritional \& clean\-label targets.



  





**(b) Technical \& Commercial Interface:** 
 Market Solutions \& Project Delivery
 







* **End\-to\-End Project Management:** 
 Own customer innovation projects across the development lifecycle \- orchestrating timelines, trial milestones, cross\-functional dependencies and risk resolution from initial brief to plant sign\-off.
* **Brief Translation \& Solution Scoping:** 
 Act as the lead technical interface for B2B client briefs; deconstruct brand targets, nutritional benchmarks, and sensory parameters into, time\-bound application sprints.
* **Client Engagement \& Co\-Development:** 
 Lead technical workshops, customer tasting sessions, and co\-creation workshops with brand teams. Articulate the functional advantages with scientific clarity.
* **Cost\-in\-Use \& Value Engineering:** 
 Model client formulation systems to demonstrate dosage efficiency, functional parity/superiority, and cost\-in\-use benefits within the customer's target cost envelope.
* **Technical Qualification \& Win\-Rate:** 
 Maximize client trial success rates by securing technical validation, sensory clearance, and factory trial approvals, delivering complete application dossiers.
* **Proactive Application Concepts:** 
 Monitor market shifts in functional foods to build proactive "push" concept kits and demonstration prototypes that enable the commercial team to unlock new clients.



  





  





**Remuneration** 



* Market Competitive
* Fixed \+ Variable

title: Jewellery Merchandiser - Andheri, Mumbai
description:

 The Merchandiser will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing jewellery product assortment across retail stores and online platforms. * Inventory \& Stock Management
* Monitor inventory levels across stores and warehouse.
* Coordinate with inventory and production teams to ensure stock availability.
* Track fast\-moving and slow\-moving jewellery products and recommend replenishment or liquidation strategies.

* Work closely with design and production teams to develop new jewellery collections.
* Coordinate product launches and ensure timely availability of collections in stores.
* Monitor production timelines and ensure delivery schedules are met.

* Ensure stores have the right product assortment based on store performance and customer demand.
* Support store teams in product selection and merchandising strategies.
* Assist with visual merchandising and display planning to enhance product presentation.
* Sales \& Performance Analysis
* Analyze sales data, margins, and product performance.
* Identify top\-selling designs and underperforming SKUs.
* Recommend actions such as reorders, product rotation, or promotional strategies.
* Vendor \& Production Coordination
* Coordinate with manufacturing vendors and internal production teams.
* Track order status and ensure timely delivery of jewellery products.
* Maintain accurate documentation related to product orders and deliveries.
* Reporting \& Merchandising Insights
* Prepare weekly and monthly merchandising reports.
* Track key metrics such as:
+ SKU performance
+ Inventory turnover
+ Sell\-through rate
+ Stock availability

* Provide insights to improve product assortment and sales performance.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong merchandising and inventory planning skills
* Understanding of jewellery product categories and collections
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills
* Excellent coordination and communication skills
* Knowledge of retail sales trends and consumer behavior
* Proficiency in MS Excel and merchandising reports
* Ability to manage multiple product categories simultaneously


**Experience**
* 2–5 years of experience in merchandising, preferably in jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, or retail brands.
* Experience in retail merchandising and product planning is preferred.


 Educational Qualification
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Fashion, Merchandising, Business, or a related field.
* Certification in retail merchandising or supply chain management is an added advantage.

title: Junior Product Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nerve Solutions is a technology\-driven company focused on real\-time risk management and surveillance solutions for financial markets. Its products enable market participants to detect and quantify risk and anomalies in live markets and respond at sub\-second speeds. The team also builds automated trading systems that support high\-performance, data\-intensive decision\-making. Over time, Nerve Solutions has become a trusted technology partner to several major financial services organizations in the region, offering robust, scalable, and reliable market technology. The company values engineering excellence, innovation, and close collaboration with financial institutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Junior Product Manager will support the end\-to\-end lifecycle of financial technology products, from discovery and requirements gathering through delivery and ongoing optimization. In this full\-time on\-site role based in Mumbai, the Junior Product Manager will collaborate with engineering, design, and business stakeholders to define features, write user stories, and prioritize the product backlog. Daily responsibilities include analyzing user and market data, monitoring product performance, preparing documentation, and coordinating with cross\-functional teams to ensure timely releases. The role also involves assisting with product roadmaps, participating in client meetings, and helping translate complex market and technical concepts into clear product specifications. The successful candidate will contribute to continuous improvement of risk management and automated trading products while learning best practices in modern product management.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to work with cross\-functional teams, collaborate with engineers, designers, and business stakeholders, and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, including comfort with quantitative data, market analysis, and interpreting metrics to inform product decisions.
* Foundational understanding of product management practices such as user research, requirements gathering, backlog management, and release coordination.
* Interest or background in financial markets, trading systems, or risk management technology; prior exposure to capital markets or fintech is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency with productivity and documentation tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation software, project tracking tools) and willingness to learn new product tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on\-site in Mumbai, manage multiple tasks in a fast\-paced environment, and take initiative under guidance from senior product leaders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and a commitment to inclusive, ethical, and user\-centric product development.

* Expertise in analyzing business problems to define detailed requirements and translate them into user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria to support technology delivery and user adoption.
* Self\-starter mindset, with demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problem spaces and drive execution with minimal oversight.
* Strong project/program management capability, delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives end\-to\-end.
* Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, aligning senior partners across Product, Technology, Operations, and Controls, including across regions and time zones.
* Hands\-on knowledge of data architecture, including data modelling, data lineage, and data quality.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce clear documentation and translate complex concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Highly organized, with strong prioritization and delivery discipline.

This role is accountable for the commercial success of the GenAI portfolio across EMAP, including revenue growth, monetization strategy, and market adoption. You will operate as a "mini‑GM", owning both product direction and business outcomes, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

You will focus on embedding Generative AI capabilities into core products, reimagining customer propositions, accelerating innovation and converting innovation into scalable, revenue\-generating offerings, and driving adoption across diverse EMAP markets.

**Cross‑Functional \& GTM Collaboration**

**What Success Looks Like**
* GenAI capabilities embedded into EMAP products at scale, not isolated pilots
* Tangible improvements in customer decision quality, speed, and usability
* Clear revenue growth and monetization of GenAI portfolio
* Successful launch of commercial GenAI offerings
* Increased attach rates, upsell, and client adoption tied to economic value

title: Senior Manager - New Product Development
description:
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a dedicated Product Lead for each of our owned beauty \& personal care brands at Purplle. The brand team writes the brief this person runs the network to land the product on shelf as fast as humanly possible.
   

  

 You are the execution engine behind every launch. Once a brief lands, you decide where to build it (in\-house R\&D or third party), drive every node of the network in parallel R\&D, packaging dev, procurement, QA, supply and compress calendar time wherever it can be compressed. Post\-launch you own reorders, inventory health, and quality for the brand's SKU base.
   

  

 If you live and breathe BPC ,if you know why the cushion foundation category exploded, why K\-beauty actives are rewriting the skincare aisle, and why a 30ml serum sells 10x better than a 50ml one this is a role where your obsession translates directly into speed\-to\-market. Speed is the product.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Run the launch — brief to shelf
* Take the brief from the brand team (benefit, format, actives, claims, shade architecture, price point, MRP) and convert it into an executable launch plan with a named target shelf date.
* Run every NPD phase at speed: feasibility → sampling → BOM finalisation → PPS → artwork → KLD → first dispatch. Own the critical path and remove blockers the moment they appear.
* Run the network in parallel, not in series. R\&D, packaging dev, procurement, regulatory, QA — all working the brief at the same time wherever the sequence allows it.
* Typically 25–40 SKUs live across stages at any time per brand. You are the single throat to choke on timelines.
* Drive a crisp weekly cross\-functional standup with R\&D, Packaging Dev, Procurement, Regulatory, Brand, Supply Chain, and Quick Commerce Ops. Publish ETAs, hold owners accountable, escalate early.
* Shop \& deploy — in\-house R\&D or third\-party
* Make the build\-vs\-buy call for every SKU — either deploy a formulation from the Purplle in\-house R\&D team or shop it from a qualified third\-party manufacturer.
* Scout, shortlist, and onboard third\-party manufacturers across formulation and filling. Evaluate on tech capability, MOQ, pricing, lead time, and compliance.
* Negotiate commercial terms — per\-unit cost, mould ownership / IP, exclusivity clauses, MOQs, payment terms, and capacity lock\-ins.
* Manage development timelines with vendors. Zero tolerance for launches slipping because of avoidable back\-and\-forth on samples, shades, or artworks.
* Reorder \& inventory health
* Own reorder planning for the brand's full SKU base — forecast demand at SKU x channel level, place POs, and track inbound against promised ETAs.
* Keep inventory days\-on\-hand inside agreed bands. Attack stock\-outs on hero SKUs and aged / slow\-moving stock with equal intensity.
* Partner with Quick Commerce Ops (dark stores), marketplace, and D2C web teams to make sure the right SKUs sit at the right nodes.
* Build the monthly S\&OP view for the brand — demand, supply, inventory, launches, promos — and drive the review with leadership.
* Quality — non\-negotiable
* Be the brand's quality conscience. Every batch that leaves a vendor warehouse or in\-house line for a Purplle customer reflects on you.
* Set and enforce incoming QC, in\-process, and finished\-goods quality standards with vendors. Drive CAPA on any consumer complaint, return, or shelf\-life issue.
* Own packaging quality — carton integrity, leak tests, drop tests, colour match on tubes / bottles / secondary packs.
* Work with Regulatory to keep every SKU compliant on labelling, claims, and ingredient declarations.


**What We Are Looking For Experience \& Background**
* 3 – 7 years of total experience — in NPD, sourcing, or category management.
* Education from a top\-tier B\-School (IIM A/B/C/L/K, IIM Mumbai (NITIE), ISB, XLRI, FMS, MDI, SPJIMR) or an IIT / BITS undergraduate programme. We are explicitly looking for pedigree here.
* Bonus if you have worked at a digital\-first brand, or run your own D2C product brand. The non\-negotiable — you have to be crazy about BPC
* You should be the person who notices the new launches before the brand's own email hits your inbox.
* You should have strong instincts on formats (stick vs liquid, cushion vs compact), actives (niacinamide vs alpha arbutin), and what is genuinely hard vs easy to execute in BPC.
* You should know the vendor ecosystem — or be hungry to learn it fast. Who can do what, where, at what MOQ, and in what lead time.
* Appetite to learn the full product stack is more important than already knowing everything. If you are hungry, we will teach.


**Hard Skills**
* Comfort with BOM / COGS / MRP maths, margin stacks, and landed\-cost calculations.
* Strong vendor negotiation — commercials, timelines, exclusivity.
* Inventory and S\&OP basics — reorder points, DoH, forecast accuracy.
* Working fluency in Excel / Sheets; comfortable reading a P\&L.
* Ability to read a stability report, a CoA, and a regulatory label without needing a translator. Ways of working
* High ownership. This role has no hiding place — if the brand's product engine misfires, it is on you.
* Operator mindset. You are equally at home in a vendor factory in Baddi, on a call with R\&D, or in a review with the founder.
* Fast iteration. We ship, learn, and course\-correct — we do not wait for perfect.


**Why Purplle**
* One of India's largest beauty platforms (online and offline), building a genuine portfolio of owned brands with category\-defining intent.
* You own a brand's product engine end\-to\-end from day one — this is not a role where you wait three years for the real work to start.

title: New Product Development Manager
description:
**Location:** 
 Vikhroli West, Mumbai (with regular travel to our Nasik plant)
 



  




 About SCANDALous Foods
 
 SCANDALous Foods (ADITOF Pvt. Ltd.) is a one\-stop shop for India's most\-loved mithais — reengineered into
 **6\-month shelf life, single\-serve 95g cups** 
 built for the HORECA ecosystem: hotels, restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, and Qcom players. We own the
 **post\-meal impulse mithai** 
 moment.
 



 Today we ship
 **3 lakh cups a month across 6 cities** 
 , manufactured out of our Nasik facility. Tomorrow — a lot more, in a lot more formats.
 



  




 The Role
 
 You are the person who takes a "wouldn't it be cool if…" and turns it into a
 **shelf\-stable, HORECA\-ready, mass\-produced SKU** 
 — on brief, on cost, on time.
 



 You'll own our innovation funnel end\-to\-end: from spotting the next category, to lab benchwork with our consulting chefs and food technologists, to pilot batches, to full\-blown scale\-up in Nasik. If a product ships from SCANDALous, your fingerprints are on it.
 



 This is not a "recipe writer" role. This is a
 **product\-market\-manufacturing** 
 role.
 



  




 What you'll own
 * **Category foresight:** 
 Predict the next 3–5 categories SCANDALous should play in — mithai, frozen, ambient, indulgence formats — before the market catches on
* **Concept → prototype:** 
 Brief and coordinate with consulting chefs, food technologists, flavour houses, and ingredient suppliers to build 20\+ prototypes a year
* **Product engineering:** 
 Nail down
 **texture, shelf life, mouthfeel, taste, aromatics** 
 across ambient and frozen formats — not by feel, but by spec
* **Pilot to plant:** 
 Take a bench\-top winner and scale it to Nasik — process definition, machinery selection, yield, costing, QC parameters, and SOPs
* **Packaging \& format:** 
 Stay ahead on packaging innovation, machinery, and formats — cups, pouches, tubs, frozen packs, single\-serve, sharing — with a bias for HORECA \& Qcom fit
* **Trend engine:** 
 Live inside the latest — global culinary trends, food service menus, HORECA insights, quick commerce data, packaging tech, ingredient breakthroughs
* **Cost \& commercial:** 
 Own product cost sheets and margin gates — no product moves to launch without hitting them
* **Cross\-functional glue:** 
 Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with Founder, Sales, Ops, QC, and Marketing to make sure launches actually land



  




 You are
 * **Technically trained** 
 — B.Tech / M.Tech / M.Sc in
 **Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Tech, or equivalent or a chef with years of technical experience.**
* 3–5 yrs in NPD in
 **FMCG food, frozen foods, dairy, bakery, desserts, or QSR** 
 — with real SKUs launched under your name
* Deep, working understanding of
 **frozen food behaviour** 
 , ice\-crystal control, freeze\-thaw, staling, moisture migration, water activity, emulsions, shelf\-life extension, natural preservation, and clean\-label formulation
* Have taken products from
 **10\-batch pilot to 10,000\-unit production runs** 
 — and know exactly where scale\-up breaks
* Fluent in the language of
 **consulting chefs AND food technologists** 
 — and can translate between them
* Obsessed with
 **eating, tasting, and dissecting** 
 food — Michelin to street to supermarket shelf
* Sharp on
 **packaging machinery, filling lines, sealing tech, cold chain, and ambient logistics**
* Have a strong POV on where Indian food formats are going — and receipts to back it



  




 Bonus points
 * Have launched a shelf\-stable Indian sweets / desserts / dairy SKU
* Have worked with a food manufacturing co, cloud kitchen, QSR chain, or Qcom\-first brand
* Have hands\-on experience with frozen desserts, mousses, or single\-serve indulgence formats
* Understand FSSAI, nutritional labelling, and export\-grade compliance


- 

 What we don't want
 * A pure R\&D scientist who doesn't want to see a shop floor
* A chef who can't read a shelf\-life study
* Someone who needs a 40\-person team to ship one SKU
* "Reference recipe" copy\-paste innovators



  




 Why this role, why now
 * You'll build
 **the innovation engine** 
 of a category\-defining brand — from a clean slate
* You'll answer to the Founder directly — no innovation\-committee theatre
* You'll ship. Fast. To real HORECA customers who reorder.
* You'll get to place bets on the
 **next big Indian format** 
 — and see it in 3 lakh\+ cups a month, in 6\+ cities, growing weekly



 If you've spent years watching your best product ideas die in someone else's PowerPoint — this is your exit.
 



  




 Apply
 
 Send your CV \+ a one\-pager on
 **the last product you launched (what, how, scale, learning)** 
 to:
 



**jobs@scandalousfoods.in** 
**Subject: NPD Manager – \[Your Name]** 




 Bonus: tell us
 **one Indian food category you think is about to explode in the next 24 months, and why.** 
 That'll open the door faster than a CV.

title: Vice President, Chief Product Office (CPO) - Business Management
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
**Shift timings: 5\.30 pm \- 3\.30 am IST (applicable for India)**
 The Vice President, CPO Business Management plays a critical role in the day‑to‑day business management, operational reporting, and strategic communication of the Product organization. This role sits at the intersection of content, business management, and execution, supporting the Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) for the CPO.
   

  

 The role is responsible for driving operational rigor and transparency across the CPO through business management reporting, headcount and capacity tracking, risk and control support, OKRs, operating model documentation, and monthly business review (MBR) commentary, while continuing to own and govern Product content and narrative.
   

  

 The individual will bring strong execution discipline, analytical insight, and structured thinking to help Product leadership navigate complex priorities, trade‑offs, and operating challenges with clarity and pace.
   

  

 This role partners closely with the Product CAO and Product leadership to ensure that Product strategy, performance, and risks are clearly articulated, consistently governed, and effectively communicated.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines strong strategic judgment, executive communication expertise, and operational discipline, with the ability to lead content at scale in a complex, fast‑paced environment.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
 As Product continues to scale in size, complexity, and strategic importance, there is a growing need for strong business management capabilities alongside content and narrative leadership.
   

  

**This Role Ensures That**
* Product leadership has clear, reliable insights into performance, capacity, risks, and priorities
* Strategic decisions are supported by consistent reporting and analysis
* Product operates with discipline, transparency, and accountability
* Messaging to senior stakeholders reflects both strategy and operational reality


 This position is foundational to sustaining operational excellence and execution maturity across the Product organization.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
**Product Business Management \& Reporting**
* Own and facilitate business management reporting for the Product organization, including dashboards, scorecards, and executive‑level summaries
* Produce monthly business review (MBR) materials and commentary, translating data into clear insights, risks, and actions for leadership
* Support OKR definition, tracking, and reporting, ensuring alignment between strategy, execution, and outcomes
* Develop and maintain operating model documentation, including roles, responsibilities, governance forums, and decision rights


**Headcount, Capacity \& Resource Management**
* Partner with Finance, HR, and the Product CAO to support:
+ Headcount tracking and reporting
+ Capacity and utilization analysis
+ Workforce planning inputs and hiring approvals

* Maintain transparent views into resource allocation and constraints across Product


**Product related Strategic Narrative and data gathering**
* Review Product content and narrative, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with strategic and operational priorities. Write commentaries, where necessary.
* Translate Product strategy, performance, and risks into clear, compelling executive‑level commentaries
* Coordinate across teams for content creation for senior forums, leadership updates, and cross‑functional communications
* Act as a liaison between the Product Office and partner teams to ensure messaging accuracy and consistency


**Employee Engagement, Talent \& Culture Enablement**
* Partner with the Talent, Learning \& Culture (TLC) Council and related workstreams to support employee engagement, learning, and culture initiatives within the Product organization.
* Coordinate Product participation in enterprise and BU‑level engagement programs, ensuring alignment with Product priorities and capacity.
* Track and report on engagement‑related metrics, actions, and outcomes, including follow‑through on survey results, action plans, and leadership commitments.
* Support leadership with materials, reporting, and updates for TLC Council forums, engagement reviews, and related governance meetings.
* Write commentaries for quarterly internal newsletters and internal social media posts


**Risk, Controls \& Governance Support**
* Support Product leadership in risk identification, issue tracking, and control remediation, including coordination with Operational Risk, Compliance, and Audit
* Assist with documentation and tracking of control actions, governance decisions, and remediation plans
* Help embed consistent governance and operating discipline across Product initiatives


**Execution \& Cross‑Functional Coordination**
* Manage and support strategic, tactical, and ad‑hoc initiatives on behalf of Product leadership
* Act as a trusted partner to the Product CAO helping drive follow‑through on commitments, decisions, and action items
* Coordinate with Marketing, Sales Support, Finance, HR, Risk, and other CAO functions to ensure aligned execution


**Operational Excellence \& Enablement**
* Drive continuous improvement in business management processes, leveraging tools, templates, and automation where appropriate
* Leverage AI tools (including Copilot) to improve reporting efficiency, insight generation, and content quality
* Mentor junior team members and help build a strong bench of business management and content talent
* Support ad hoc strategic initiatives and projects as needed


**What We Value**
 These skills will help you succeed in this role
   

  

* Demonstrated experience in business management, CAO, chief of staff, or strategy support roles
* Strong ability to translate data into executive‑ready insights and narratives
* Experience with headcount, financial, and workforce data, and comfort working across Finance and HR partners
* Proven ability to operate in a matrixed, fast‑paced, and highly regulated environment
* Strong execution rigor with an ability to manage ambiguity and competing priorities
* Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills; familiarity with AI‑enabled productivity tools (e.g., Copilot)
* High emotional intelligence, sound business judgment, and discretion when supporting senior leaders
* Ability to act as a trusted advisor, balancing challenge with partnership


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Overall, 15\+ years of work experience.
* 8\+ years of relevant business/product experience; prior experience in CAO, business management, strategy, consulting, or transformation roles strongly preferred
* Experience supporting senior leaders within Product, Investment Services, or adjacent financial services functions a plus
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint


**Minimum Salary**
 zł282,000 Annual
   

  

 The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.
   

  

 Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self\-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non\-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.
   

  

 In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance\-based awards.
   

  

**We Offer**
* Permanent contract from day one
* Additional holidays (Birthday Day Off, 3rd and 5th year anniversary Day Off)
* Gold Medical Package for employees and their families (partner and children)
* Premium life insurance package and private pension plan
* Wide range of soft skills training, technical workshops, language classes and development programs
* Opportunities to volunteer your time to company\-driven initiatives, employee networks or organizations of your choice
* Variety of well\-being programs
* Additional benefits available depending on the seniority of the role


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

description:
